job.title: Project Manager for 2 wheeler projects - ADAS sensor/radar
job.description:
About ContinentalWith sales of €40.5 billion in 2016, Continental is among the leading automotive suppliers worldwide and currently employs more than 230.000 employees in 56 countries. Continental Engineering Services (CES) is a subsidiary of Continental AG. With more than 1,500 engineers and specialists, we design and manufacture complex high technology mechatronic products and systems for small series and niche applications at 15 locations around the world. Depending on our customer needs, we can either develop bespoke products from initial concepts, or we have the unique opportunity to access and modify the proven large-scale production technology of Continental AG for individual solutions. Manufacturers of sports cars and special-purpose vehicles as well as a variety of industrial customers are among those who benefit from our services. We work in the areas of Chassis & Safety Control, Interior Electronic Functions, Vehicle Electrification, and Engine & Transmission Management. Are you ready for an exciting future? Apply now!

Job DescriptionProject coordination as a front office 
- Clarification of customer requirements associated to ARAS (ADAS for Motorcycle) 
- Define the use cases to be considered for ARAS in collaboration with the customer 
- Present to customer team the evolution of Vehicle architecture / HW and SW / safety concept defined by Continental 
- Provide to Continental team the comments / evolutions requested by customer on Vehicle architecture / HW and SW / safety concept. 
- Obtain agreement from customer on Continental Vehicle architecture / HW and SW / safety concept proposal 
- Analyze the impact of vehicle architecture on the ECU integration / mechanical design of the ECU 
- Present to customer team the ECU evolutions defined by Continental 
- Provide to Continental team the comments / evolutions requested by customer on ECU specification 
- Obtain agreement from customer on Continental ECU specification 

Components and Vehicle test 
- Coordinate components and vehicle test at Continental in Japan or customer site 
- Clarification of test cases, conduct the test and documentation 

Others 
- Support radar related topics / businesses in other area (ADAS, Off-highway etc.), including support for other department in Continental 
- Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders 
- Establish and maintain relationship with third parties/vendors 
- Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation

Requirements

- 3~5 years Project Management experience 
- 5 years working experience at JOEM and/or auto parts supplier 
- 5~10 years of engineering experience 
- Experience with radar / lidar for ADAS is preferred 
- Motorcycle driver license (unlimited) is mandatory

job.title: System Validation & Test Engineer
job.description:
[Product]
Automotive Lighting Products

[Job Description]
You will be in charge of software development and evaluation for automotive electronic control units (ECUs). Working closely with domestic and international R&D bases, you will be involved in a wide range of tasks from design to verification and quality improvement.

[Main Responsibilities]
・Design and development of automotive software and execution of technical solutions
・Execution of software validation, as well as various evaluations and testing
・Analysis of test results, investigation of root causes for defects, improvement proposals, and quality enhancement activities
・Creation and management of design specifications, evaluation reports, and technical documentation
・Comprehension of English design documents, specifications, and technical paperwork created by overseas R&D bases, and adapting/documenting them for the Japanese market
・Technical communication and coordination with overseas branches and development teams regarding design details, technical specifications, and evaluation results
・Driving forward design and evaluation tasks based on internal design standards and development processes
・Driving efficiency and process improvement in development by leveraging digital tools
・Analysis of technical issues, quality improvement activities, and proposals for new technologies and methodologies
・Contribution to the creation and proposal of intellectual property (patents, etc.)
・Technical support and knowledge sharing for junior engineers
・Execution of development and evaluation tasks with awareness of project progress and budget

[Job Appeal / Rewards]
・Opportunity to lead tasks with autonomy as a core team member
・Involvement in global projects while communicating with overseas team members
・Future career advancement opportunities toward management roles, such as Team Leader or Assistant Manager
・Career options to deepen technical expertise and become a specialist in system validation

[Team Structure]
The team is mainly composed of engineers in their 20s and 30s.

[Work Style]
・Principally working on-site (at the office)
・Business trips to OEMs (approx. 4?5 times a year)
*Occurs when evaluation using actual vehicles is required.

[Work Environment]
・The work location in Isehara is rich in nature, offering a peaceful environment to focus on your work.
・Accessible in about 1 hour to major areas like Shinjuku and Yokohama.
・While surrounded by nature, having a car provides easy access to all necessary daily amenities, making it a comfortable place to live.
・Housing subsidy system available.

Requirements

[Requirements (Must Have)]
・5+ years of knowledge/experience in system validation
*Candidates who can independently design and execute test methods
・Experience using CANoe
・Experience with automotive components
・Knowledge of CAN protocol
・English: Conversational to Business level (Must be comfortable working in English)
*Will communicate with overseas Valeo branches (China, France, etc.)
・Japanese: Business level
*Required for internal meetings, creating documents in Japanese, and communicating with Japanese OEMs

[Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)]
・Academic background in Telecommunications or Electronics / Practical experience using CAN
・Engineers currently working in System Design who want to transition into System Validation are highly welcome

[Ideal Candidate Profile]
・Proactive individuals who can execute tasks independently
・Problem-solvers who actively seek improvements and drive projects forward

job.title: Senior Account Manager (Driveline)
job.description:
Overview:

Our client is a global supplier with manufacturing, R&D centres in the region.

Lead designated elements within a global account team to achieve an effective customer relationship and Company business objectives.

Products are heavy / metal related also including some mechatronics.

Key Responsibilities:

Internal:

  • Represent the customer providing the necessary information to the relevant functions and tracking responses to customer issues

  • Maintain a customer database (pricing/contracts,..) and communicate/cooperate with relevant internal functions

  • Provide input to the RFI/RFQ and program management business processes.

  • Check customer RFQ and related documents and forward to relevant functions for specific checks (feasibility study, contractual check of documents, ...) and documentation thereof (present/support ISO Audit), prepare Quotations and technical and commercial offers.

  • Provide input to the account planning process, e.g. 5YP, budget process, demand planning

  • Maintain account sales performance data and investigate variances to budget; Propose and manage improvements.

  • Review and understand the implications of customer agreements, license agreements and other contracts/agreements; request internal legal support when required

  • Adhere to internal authorization processes. Priorities and escalation of critical items to be agreed with the Account Director

  • Manage specific tasks as requested by the Account Director

External

  • Support the development and execution of the customer strategy

  • Develop and maintain an in-depth and up to date understanding of the customer and technical requirements, including market position, vehicle strategy, purchasing strategy, competitor activities, organisation, etc.

  • Utilise opportunities to be involved in broader vehicle activities (system supply, product segments,...) of the customer across all Company product segments (in line with customer strategy)

  • Participate in/lead customer negotiations such as design changes, changes in the supplier base, move of production, material recovery or contract/annual pricing negotiations and new businesses. Prepare and agree sales plan/tactics ahead of negotiations (i.e. price reconciliation, supporting documents, technical explanations ...).

  • Lead in VAVE activities.

Requirements

  • University Education with a relevant technical or commercial degree or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum 10 years sales experience in the automotive industry, ideally with a proven track record at a tier 1 supplier.

  • Candidates should be able to effectively manage, challenge, analyse and summarise multiple-dimension data (cost, budget, and market data).

  • Comfortable preparing business cases and analysing financial scenarios.

  • Excellent Excel and systems skills.

  • Knowledge of Demand Management, Budgeting, Pricing and Cost Interrogation.

  • Candidates should have an aptitude for working with detailed data.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Customer-facing experience.

  • Be able to negotiate using detailed cost models.

job.title: Senior Manager, Program Management
job.description:
Overview:

  • The Senior Manager, Program Management will own global product engineering for automotive products customer base.
  • In this role, the senior program manager will orchestrate successful engineering customer interfaces and will be the escalation path for the customer.
  • With their global cross-functional team, he / she will be responsible for planning, managing, and completing the engineering development of automotive products.
  • This position will drive world-class engineering development to meet customer deliverables and prototype deliveries while managing the team to adhere to high quality processes / standards that ensure zero customer defects.

What You Will Do

  • Manage customer interface and direct customer communication strategy with Japan OEMs. Ensure assignments from Japan OEMs are well understood, distributed to core teams, and reasonable for success.
  • Build and manage customer relationships.
  • Work with customer interface teams to manage issues
  • Represent product engineering team in new business opportunities by interfacing with core team /customer / sales. Drive business case inputs and product engineering engagement on new technologies.
  • Build and maintain a customer interface team – responsible to manage the customer from the entry-level to the senior-level. Evaluate and develop team members.
  • Serve as internal expert on Japan OEM development processes
  • Analyze and negotiate program schedules with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure product costing targets are achieved for each product. Maintain records of BOM costs compared to targets; escalate within company when targets are not achieved. Ensure design actions are implemented to recover any cost variance in BOM cost target.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering best practices / processes and facilitate creation of new best practices as appropriate
  • Own and maintain the resource budget and cost of external resources.
  • Ensure engineering teams have equipment and facilities needed to meet customer requirements. This includes budget as well as acquisition.
  • Back up engineering colleagues in Japan Office and program management team as appropriate.
  • Oversee decisions regarding product content, budget and timing to ensure the product is on-time, on-schedule, on-quality, and meets all customer acceptance criteria (Performance and Features).
  • Manage product risk proactively, identify engineering risks and coordinate meetings with the PM and multi-discipline functions to address risks before they become issues.
  • Evaluate engineering processes and metrics to track and measure engineering success. Update processes where needed to address customer-specific requirements. Ensure all engineering disciplines are designing per company processes and customer processes.
  • Ensure customer requirements are communicated throughout internal engineering teams. Ensure customer requirements are met with the product designed. Manage customer interface teams to clarify requirements when needed

Requirements

What You Need

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Masters preferred
  • 8+ years related technical experience
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership or technical program management
  • Proficient in Japanese language
  • Able to communicate in English (spoken and written)
  • Experience as a supplier to Japanese carmakers
  • Experience managing global teams
  • Experience in consulting and/or client-facing role is preferred
  • Must have general knowledge of automotive engineering.
  • Must be able to articulate vision and influence decision making outcomes with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and the customer.
  • Must have a "whatever-it-takes" attitude using diplomatic leadership skills within a collaborative teamwork environment to accomplish the necessary results.
  • Proven and effective communication, analytical, judgment, initiative and execution skills.

job.title: Sales Specialist
job.description:
Description & Requirements

About the Role

This position is responsible for supporting all commercial and account-related activities as well as business growth strategy for S-OEM, in collaboration with other sales management team members.

The role will support the planning and execution of sales management for Harman Automotive products, including Car Audio, TCU, IVI, Digital Cockpit, ADAS, and future products.


Your Team

This position reports to the Sales Director and does not have direct reports.

 

What You Will Do

  • Major responsibilities are:    
    • Seamless sales management from pursuit phase to M3 gate + Change requests
      • Build, coordinate and manage internal relationship between supporting teams (SBUs, Program Managers, Engineering, etc.)
      • Maintain short term Sales plan and update the data in Salesforce
      • Lead First Enquiry Check (process) for RFx decision meeting
      • Support RFx responses & workshops by interfacing with customers & collaborating with internal cross functional team
      • Manage day to day communication with customer for any commercial related topics
      • Support change request management from commercial view points
      • Support prototype delivery and pricing, tooling cost & development cost reimbursement

  • The scope of the role is within Japan.
  • Strong interpersonal skills in Japanese and English are required, along with a good level of technical knowledge to learn Harman’s products after joining.
  • Key competencies include result-driven mindset and strong collaboration skills.

 

Requirements

What You Need

  • Self-Management skill for business development activities and opportunity identification
  • Strong communication skills to effectively convey customer requirements to internal teams
  • Interpersonal skills to build relationships with customers as well as to be team player in Harman by Native-level Japanese and Business-level English.
  • Negotiation skills to find solutions that work for both customers and Harman

 

What Makes You Eligible

  • Business experience working with Japanese OEMs
  • Bachelor’s degree with at least 5 years working experience in Japanese automotive industry
  • Be willing to work in an office in Ota, Gunma or Tokyo
  • Be willing to travel up to 25%, domestic and international travel

 

What is Nice to Have

  • Sales experience in Tier 1 supplier working with JOEMs
  • Engineering background (SW, HW or ME)

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology 

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

job.title: Sales Manager - EPC/Oil&Gas - Generator - Tokyo
job.description:
Sales Manager

 

Description

 

No, this isn’t one of those ordinary jobs.

 

Cummins is a team of dependable, innovative thinkers, who are empowered to generate and deliver solutions for customers, community and environment. Our employees develop their careers through the challenges only a diverse, global innovator can promise. This is a collaborative culture where thinking beyond your desk is more than part of the job. It is the job.

 

This is what we call Working Right.

 

Cummins, a global power leader, is a corporation of complementary businesses that design, manufacture, distribute & service engines, fuel systems, controls, air handling, filtration, emission solutions, power generation systems and all related technologies.

 

We are committed to building partnerships with our people, our customers, our environment and our communities.

 

Our Vision is "making people's lives better by unleashing the power of Cummins" and it is carried out by our employees around the world who give of their time, talents and resources to improve the communities in which we live and work. More than 150 Community Involvement Teams worldwide work with the Company's Corporate Responsibility Corporate Responsibility organization and senior management to strengthen our communities with a focus on education, the environment and social justice.

 

Cummins, a Fortune 150 company, has been recognized by national and international organizations for our employees and Cummins’ unique working culture such as World’s Most Ethical Companies by the Ethisphere and awarded a perfect scored in the 2013 Corporate Equality Index by the Human Rights Campaign as part of its Best Places to Work initiative.

 

This is an exciting opportunity in Tokyo for a Sales Manager. Cummins Generation Technologies (CGT) in Japan is where Sales Manager can Manages and develops customer relationship to achieve sales goals within an assigned sales territory. He/she to promote products, execute sales and marketing plans to meet company’s objectives and customer needs.

 

Thinking Beyond Your Desk Includes

 

Country / Account Management

•               Maximize profitability and increase sales by supplying superior products and value packages, which meet or exceed customer expectations

•               Assess effectiveness of distribution channel from time to time to meet business targets

•               Review credit standing of Delivery Partner and new customers

•               Assess new market/potential. Pursue key prospects, negotiate, support potential sales

•               Make business review trips in assigned countries and submit summary reports

•              

Sales / Marketing

•               Lead order intake and backlog to enable management to have full visibility of the latest financial status

•               Coordinate, participate and/or lead seminars and trade shows

•               Feedback customer comments to respective departments and follow-up on NPS survey

•               Involve in Pricing activities for CGT Asia pacific comprises of price communication to distributors, pricing process management and price analysis against competition

•               Analyze measure and track competition & distribution performance

•              

Other Functional Role

•               Technical as well as Sales presentation and training

•               Support Finance with periodical planning, forecasting and reporting requirements

•              

Corporate Citizen

•               Embrace corporate driven initiatives around COS and Core values

•               Project good company image when interacting with Distributors, customers and colleagues

•               Work cross-functionally with colleague/counterpart. Cover duties as necessary in absence of other BMs or Director

•              

•              

Qualifications Required

 

Qualifications

•               Engineering diploma/degree or equivalent with > 3 years of Regional sales experience in industrial products or diesel engine industry

•               Able to work independently, prioritize and develop initiatives

•               Strong analytical, problem solving skills and work cross functionally

•               Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

•               Application software skills, especially MS Words and MS Excel

•               Willing to travel within the region and work in different environment

•              

•              

Compensation And Benefits

 

Compensation. Base salary commensurate with experience plus Variable bonus.

 

Benefits. Cummins Japan provides a full package of Social Insurance (Welfare Pension, Health Insurance – Medical & Dental, Unemployment Insurance Policy). Cummins Japan also provides Retirement Benefit, full commutation allowance and Cummins Japan supports “Benefit-One”, third party operated fringe benefit program.

 

At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons.

 

Ready to think beyond your desk? Apply for this opportunity and start your career with Cummins today.

job.title: Program Development Leader
job.description:
The Program Development Leader (PDL) is in charge of the complete engineering of the product and process, in compliance with Quality, Cost, Timing, Performance and People objectives and within PMS (Program Management System) requirements.

Scope of work & time frame:

  • His/her scope of responsibilities goes from concept design received from Concept Engineering to Start-Of-Production + 3/6 months (once quality standards have met customer specifications), from PMS phase 2 to phase 4 when in development

  • Builds the internal engineering schedule to match with the customer master schedule and industrialization / purchasing constraints.

  • All tasks are done with the appropriate tools and in compliance with the PMS work-packages, company standards & 8-Quality-Basics, in support of functional milestone “time to pass” objective.

  • Reporting: Monthly report summary of design progress (on PRC(Program Review Committee)-template), including corresponding action plans.

Product definition:

  • The PDL formally releases/approves internally the DATA-levels that are given to the customer

  • Leads completion of CAD to ensure compliance to requirements (acceptance of customer product specification including geometry convergence together with his design team on site and off shore

  • Makes the functional analysis when required, develop the DFMEA(Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and complete the action plan, support the PFMEA(Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and define the key characteristics.

  • Leads the action plan to solve all technical issues (including perceived quality problems)

Process definition:

  • Ensures the feasibility of the process customers in line with best practises and GTS standards & guidelines, including ergonomics standards.

  • Checks process feasibility for BOP (validate feasibility studies of sub-suppliers)

  • Defines tool specifications with the support of PTE and approve tool design release through the tool launch process, involving PML and GTS

Validation:

job.title: Software Product Owner
job.description:
DETAILS

Mission

Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.

Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe.

Visteon Culture

If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

Responsibilities

Key Objectives of this Role:

  • Establish and maintain coherent plan across system, software and functional validation in a product backlog utilizing RTC work packages/vFIP for original scope and change requests (including supplier deliverables).
  • Drive work item status update in the central planning database (RTC work packages) as work is completed but at least prior to the progress tracking meeting.
  • Monitor progress of deliverables through periodic meetings using dashboards of live data with the focus of status, scope, priority and re-planning.
  • Ensure lower-level work items (epics/stories/tasks) are created by involving the relevant system, software and functional validation stakeholders.
  • Participate in SW scrum ceremonies sprint planning, daily scrum (optional), sprint reviews and retrospection.
  • Provide progress updates to project stakeholders (including OEM) regarding the status of systems, software and functional validation teams through vFIP.
  • Facilitate dependencies management between systems, software, functional validation, and other disciplines (through PDTL).
  • Escalate RIOs concerning system, software development and functional validation that may require next level of attention to Chief Engineer / CRE Leader.
  • Ensure discipline specific strategies are created and maintained mainly for system, software, functional validation, and hardware (though PDTL).
  • Drive process compliance and deliverables quality of system, software, and functional validation teams.
  • Ensure the requirements impediments/issues are resolved by involving the appropriate teams (including OEM) on time.
  • Coordinate with the systems, software, and functional validation team for technical impact, estimates and schedule for PICs (customer change requests) supporting PDTL.
  • Ensure the defined level of traceability and consistency between system, SW development and functional validation work products is maintained.
  • Review the test coverage and test status report to ensure all applicable systems and software requirements have been tested prior to release (Test coverage includes all levels test of from system “V” cycle).
  • Lead SW release readiness and approval process.
  • Triage, prioritize and forecast defects from customer or functional validation teams (In large projects, this may be done by a dedicated defect manager role supporting the SW PO).
  • Lead the resolution of time sensitive showstopper issues resulting from system, software and functional validation by raising alerts to the concerned teams.
  • Manage non-functional requirements with work packages (e.g. software related certification requirements android auto / car play, SW re-flash strategy definition).

 

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS:

Required

  • Solid experience in embedded software development for 8-10 years preferably with Automotive background - Cluster/Infotainment/Platform software.
  • Quick decision-making and negotiation skills.
  • Excel in Teamwork and relationship management with Customer.
  • Communication skills - Verbal and Written.
  • Experience in problem solving (8D, 5-Why, Fish Bone…) and process improvement.
  • Strong analytical & debugging skills.
  • Japanese language skill. Business level of Japanese and English
  • Preferred
  • Experience working with Toyota
  • Formal Product Owner Training and Certification.
  • Experience in Product Development using Agile methodologies.

job.title: Senior Program Manager
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Program Manager

JOB TITLE:
REPORTS TO:
LOCATION:
Department: Program Management Office

Position Summary: Plan, monitor and implement JCI Automotive Experience product development and launch programs. Meet all internal and customer targets and objectives. Interface with all levels of internal and customer management on all aspects of planning, scheduling, organizing, directing and controlling the program.

Specific Functions/Responsibilities:

Leadership: Represent the Simultaneous Development Team (SDT) in a professional way to the customer and JCI management. Motivate the team to meet commitments to the established timing. Build team technically and personally through mentoring and coaching. Resolve conflicts between team members, departments and the customer. Negotiate with internal and external groups, vendors and customer. Ability to identify root cause of a problem, develop corrective action and lead team to resolution.

Simultaneous Development Team (SDT) Management: Act as the central communication point for the SDT to ensure that each SDT member is aware of their deliverables and timing commitments at all times. Trains and coaches the SDT in JCI Product Launch process to ensure compliance. Manages the SDT to meet timing, cost, manufacturing, quality and cost targets. Establishes the SDT meeting cadence and monitors attendance to assure the correct team members are present at each meeting. Creates agenda, schedules meetings and keeps the meeting on task. Provides team information needed to perform tasks. Actively includes suppliers as a member of the team.

Director Program Management, PM Japan Yokohama

Scope Management: Communicate the impact of scope changes to the customer and SDT in a timely manner in terms of cost, timing, product, quality of execution and impact on the program. Publish the SOW and SSOW and ensure all scope changes are captured in the documents. Utilize the PD3 approval process for internal and customer scope changes. Differentiate scope changes from engineering changes. Manage the risk of scope changes and keep management informed of change and affect on the program. Ensure that financial performance is protected and enhanced by customer driven scope changes.

0-0-100-100-30 Planning: Attain 0 recordable accidents, 0 rejected parts per million, 100% delivery on time, 100% of Capital Appropriation Request at 30 days post launch. Anticipate risk caused by late tasks and changes by developing mitigation strategy. Establish a documented implementation plan and containment action for engineering changes at launch. Work with suppliers to ensure all necessary resources are in place for launch. Provide on-site plant support throughout pre-production builds. Follow up on MSO to ensure plant material functions are ready. Foster effective working relationship between Plant launch team and CBU team. Maintains and manages scope changes within one year of launch. Bundle late changes into pre-launch and post-launch buckets to keep risk manageable.

Financial Roadmap & Financial Reporting: Schedules Finance SDT meeting once a month, from Development Start through Post Launch. Meet the financial targets of the program and manages Financial Roadmap dates, action and cost. Solid financial base to understand how to utilize SDT to impact financial measures and the relationship between financial measures. Ensures the product(s) is designed to meet BOM cost targets by facilitating between engineering and finance to meet targets.

Timing: Ability to create work breakdown structure (WBS) with customer milestones/deliverables used as the foundation. Gate timing developed from timeline that meets JCI and customer firewalls. The timeline and related timing documents, i.e. prototype schedule, CAD schedule, part matrices, etc. are consistent. Program timeline is utilized in weekly SDT to clearly communicate deliverables and due dates. Responsible for Gate exit reviews being held on time, regardless of whether or not exit can be achieved. Create issue lists that are clear and concise with due dates and deliverables.

Product: Responsible for leading team to meet Craftsmanship objectives, action plan to address gaps. Audit customer samples for customer satisfaction via Customer Shipping Approval Review. Manage CAD schedule, prototype build schedule, and testing schedule and ensure any gaps are addressed to meet timeline. Audit ED, DV, and PV testing results and manage timing and

corrective action to support launch. Facilitates change management meeting. Meet applicable product requirements including specifications, functional expectations and FMVSS requirements.

Customer Satisfaction: Fosters an effective personal working relationship with appropriate customer contacts. Maintain JCI and personal credibility with customer. Recognized by customer as key contact for program implementation. Meets dates and commitments via customer open issues list which directs team for prompt responses. Communicate with data for scope changes with cost, quality and timing impact. Gain internal consensus on scope changes prior to communicating to customer. Archive and retain key customer correspondence and documents. Maintain regular contact with customer to communicate problems early. Does not avoid difficult issues or decisions. Understand customer’s organization and procedures in detail.

Global Management Skills: Function in a different culture while matching his/her interpersonal style to the culture they are working in. Has awareness and respect for different culture. Demonstrate an interest in other cultures.

Education Required: Technical Undergraduate Degree (or equivalent degree based on regional education system). Masters Degree in Business strongly desired. PMP Certification desired. Problem solving and negotiation class experience desired.

Experience Required:

Five (5) years working experience in one or more of the following areas: Engineering
Manufacturing/Quality
Finance

Five (5) years management experience in one or more of the following areas: Program Management
Engineering Management
Manufacturing Management/Quality Management

Demonstrated leadership experience or completion of JCI Leadership Development Program

Three (3) years of working experience in the Automotive Industry including at least one vehicle launch. Demonstrated knowledge of automotive design/launch process.
Working knowledge of Program Management process and tools.

job.title: R&D Engineer - ASR
job.description:
We are looking for a Language Modelling Engineer for our ASR R&D team to work on challenging research problems that have a concrete impact on real-world applications – the work you do will impact real users across the world. Come and join our team of talented engineers and help us to shape the future of AI!

You will perform a role mixing both research and development of cutting-edge technologies by staying current on state-of-the-art algorithms in related fields; evaluating the usage patterns of customers via big data analysis; building models to improve core ASR accuracy of individual products and contributing to the model building codebase.

Principal duties and responsibilities

  • Conduct experiments to assess the quality of language models and study the effect of language modelling variants and ancillary natural language processing technology on speech recognition accuracy
  • Identify, optimise and cluster training data
  • Analyse product usage data to identify areas of possible improvement or enhancement of language modelling processes, methods and NLP techniques.
  • Implement improved training recipes and NLP prototypes utilizing primarily Python and/or Perl
  • Discuss and present ideas, progress, and results within the research team.
  • Improve language modelling performance on Japanese as the focus language

Knowledge, skills and qualifications

Education: Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in computer science, computational linguistics, applied mathematics, or a related field

Required skills:

  • Background in speech technology, computational linguistics, statistical machine translation and/or natural language processing
  • If recently graduated, then relevant experience or internship
  • Good software engineering skills, knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. shell scripting, Perl, Python) and experience working under both Linux and Windows
  • Solid written and oral communication skills in English
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Japanese

Preferred skills:

  • Explicit (industry or academic) experience with large vocabulary speech recognition
  • Expertise in one or more of the following areas: machine learning, statistical modelling, information retrieval, deep learning, data mining, linguistics.
  • Fluent in a third, non-English language

job.title: SW DQE Manager
job.description:
Job Description

At Bose Automotive, we are obsessed with transforming the driving experience, where our customers experience something special in every car we’ve touched. We are looking for an enthusiastic, technically strong Software Test Systems to lead the team of SW Test engineers in our rapidly growing global team. You will have the opportunity to lead the team to work on exciting next generation experiences in some of the world’s leading automobiles.

The successful candidate will enjoy working with high-caliber, cross functional teams to develop high quality software program team. They will have the chance to make an impact and shape the development process going forward with key leadership in a highly visible role. They will also have a proven record of SW test delivering for new and challenging software features, ideally in an embedded environment. This individual will enjoy collaborating with a diverse team, establishing strong relationships with other leaders, while learning and sharing knowledge.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager, SW Test Systems & Automation to lead our BOSE AUTOMOTIVE JAPAN (BAGK) local SW test team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the development and implementation of SW test systems, automation processes, and infrastructure working with 3rd party Engineering Service Provider (ESP) company in India.

Job Responsibilities

Leadership and Management

Develop and execute strategic plans for the design, implementation, and maintenance of software test systems and automation processes.
Direct teams of software test engineers in both BAGK and the ESP. Foster a high-performance culture across team members by promoting collaboration, integrity, inclusion, transparency, accountability, and compassion.
Manage approximately 10 offshore engineers (primarily based in India) from ESP and several Japan-based direct team members, ensuring alignment with project goals and quality standards.
Oversee and align budgets and staffing demands across global software test system & automation teams in coordination with Bose stakeholders.
Lead the development of talent pipelines and succession plans to ensure a robust and skilled workforce for the future.
Drive cross-functional collaboration and communication across teams, ensuring that information and best practices are shared effectively.
Provide advice, guidance, encouragement, and constructive feedback to team members and other functional managers.
Implement organizational practices for staffing, diversity, performance management, development, reward and recognition, and retention.
Ensure compliance with ASPICE process areas SWE.4 (Software Unit Verification), SWE.5 (Integration Testing), and SWE.6 (System Testing).

Budgeting, Finance and Administration

Collaborate with Customer SW Delivery, E2E Test, Engineering SW application Development and lead forecast budgetary requirements for annual planning rounds.
Develop and execute financial strategy for test system development & automation, aligning budgeting efforts with the long-term goals of the organization and the specific needs of project management team.
Implement financial controls and reporting mechanisms to monitor expenditures, ensuring that budgets are adhered to across hardware development teams.
Drive financial transparency and accountability across teams.
Define initial budgets and project definitions for strategic technology initiatives, prioritizing approved initiatives across teams.

Software Test

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration of test systems and automation processes.
Define and establish best practices, standards, and procedures for test systems and automation.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize test processes, increase efficiency, and reduce cycle times.
Identify and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance test systems and automation capabilities.
Foster innovation within test system and automation teams to explore emerging technologies and methodologies that can enhance product quality and efficiency.
Hands-on experience in SW automation development and deployment.

Requirements

Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of relevant experience of SW test development, SW automation engineering.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience in the automotive industry.
     

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
     

Desired Education

  • Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
     

Required Skills/Experiences

  • SW Test and SW automation Technical Leadership skills
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking
  • Supervisory and management skills
  • Experience in developing SW Test strategies and on time delivery of SW Test & Automation
  • Communication skills - interpersonal, presentation and written in both Japanese and English
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
  • Excellent organization and delegation skills
  • Strategic/visionary minded.
  • Project Management skills
  • Proficiency in managing global team members, including offshore resources.
  • Detailed knowledge and expertise in test methodologies, test automation frameworks, and test equipment
  • Hands-on experience in SW automation programming languages (Python), or C/C++.
  • Experience with automotive networks, such as CAN, A2B, MOST, and RS-485.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Solid understanding of hardware/software integration, embedded systems, and electronic components
  • Able to manage team differences within a culturally diverse environment.
  • Skill in optimizing resource allocation, including personnel, budget, and technology, to achieve goals efficiently and cost-effectively.
  • ASPICE expertise (SWE.4, SWE.5, SWE.6).
     

Desired Skills

  • Working knowledge of Digital Signal Processing
  • MatLab expertise
  • Tier-1 product development in partnership with Japanese automotive OEMs.
     

Work Flexibility

  • Hybrid working model.(3 days wokring at office)
  • Travel to worldwide locations required, less than 15%.

job.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
job.description:
DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS

About the Role

This position is within HARMAN’s Automotive Engineering department, the primary responsibility is to provide hardware and software applications support of audio systems and drive solutions for improving vehicle system-level interactions. Also, the position will be the bridge between the customer and internal engineering teams. The Engineering team is looking for the ultimate team player that thinks positive, loves customers, and can manage projects independently. The successful candidate will be highly flexible in finding solutions for our customer’s needs and will have a demonstrated track record of success with audio systems engineering and customer facing interaction.

What You Will Do

  • The HW SME for amplifiers plays a pivot role in the Car Audio Strategic Business Units. The business unit markets, designs, engineers, and manufactures advanced audio amplifiers, speakers, and microphones for most of the OEMs (Toyota, Honda etc.).
  • You will interact with customers around the globe, engineering centers in China, India and Mexico, Program Managers, and other stakeholders to develop Car Audio products.
  • You will be involved in the design review of HW work products following the project lifecycle. Some examples are Customer Requirements Analysis, Design Verification plan, HW Block Diagram, Schematics, DFMEA & DRBFM, Worst Case Circuit Analysis, PCB Layout, Design Verification, etc.
  • You will hold a centric position during the request for quotations by technically leading the HW portion of the concept freeze and concept approval in RFQ and RFI. It includes specifications review, HW architecture, effort estimation, and stakeholder’s alignment.
  • You will mediate in deep technical HW issues between the customers, suppliers and engineering centers. It requires the coordination, definition, troubleshooting and communication of critical issues to the stakeholders.
  • You will participate in advance development projects (ADP) with special impact to customer products and HW platforms. 

 

Requirements

What You Need

  • 5 or more years of experience in HW development for automotive embedded systems.
  • Experience with HW design tools, such as Cadence/OrCAD, Pspice, Mentor Graphics, MathCAD, etc. and testing tools like, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, power supplies, audio analyzer, etc.
  • Familiar with HW embedded systems around SoC, MCU, and DSP, using electronic communication busses such as A2B, CAN, AVB, I2C, SPI, etc.
  • Knowledge of audio products in automotive applications.
  • Fluent communication in Japanese and English

 

 

What is Nice to Have

  • Hands-on electronics system debug experience.
  • Following experience preferred.
    • Automotive CAN
    • Automotive EAVB
    • Automotive A2B
    • AUTOSAR
  • Ability to use common electronic trouble-shooting tools such as oscilloscopes, CAN log trace tools, current clamps, spectrum analyzers, soldering iron, etc preferred.
  • Embedded system software development in C/C++ and model-based familiarity desired

 

What Makes You Eligible

  • Willingness to travel 10% of the time.
  • Willingness to work at local Harman office in Nagoya / Ariake.
  • Successfully complete a background investigation/Aptitude Test as a condition of employment.

 

What We Offer

  • We offer an authentic diverse, equal, and inclusive work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development in a truly global organization.
  • You will work on products and services that touch people’s lives and will change the industrial standards, being a part of the transformations in our industry.
  • Our work environments are fast paced, challenging, empowering, collaborative, flexible and exciting.
  • We offer our own HARMAN University with regular updates on the new technologies and trends by utilizing various sessions organized by Self Learning and Development Trainings to help grow and advance talent.
  • We offer competitive compensation/benefit programs and recognition programs.

 

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

job.title: System Engineer (Manager)
job.description:
Our client is a top Tier 1 automotive supplier and leader in electrification. They have an international office environment and a flexible work office system.

To support continued expansion, they are hiring a System Engineer (Manager level) as a newly created position.

Overview:

The System Engineer serves as the key technical liaison between customers and internal development teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment. This role involves analyzing, refining, and documenting stakeholder requirements while facilitating collaboration among technical experts to define and validate a product system architecture that effectively meets project needs.

Position Description:

  • Develop and document the Product System Requirement Specification.

  • Serve as the primary technical interface for customers while collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Test Engineers, Software Engineers, Hardware Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, and Requirements Management Engineers.

  • Define and document both external and internal system interfaces.

  • Analyze and refine stakeholder requirements to ensure clarity and feasibility.

  • Resolve ambiguities in requirements by:

    • Engaging with customers to clarify unclear or conflicting stakeholder requirements.

    • Collaborating with internal stakeholders and Requirements Engineers to address inconsistencies in derived requirements.

  • Break down and derive system requirements based on validated stakeholder inputs.

  • Categorize requirements as functional or non-functional, considering potential environmental impacts.

  • Identify and resolve requirement defects to maintain system integrity.

  • Conduct impact analysis for customer-driven product change requests.

  • Define system safety requirements based on the Functional Safety Concept, incorporating necessary safety mechanisms and safe states.

  • Establish system cybersecurity requirements derived from the Cybersecurity Concept.

Requirements

  • Bachelor of Engineering: Electronics or Software

  • Knowledge of Software/embedded design is MUST (electronics design is a plus)

  • Knowledge of the System Requirements Engineering procedures established in the organization and project.

  • Knowledge of the traceability procedures

  • Knowledge of the Requirements management tools used in the organization & project (i.e. DOORS)

  • Knowledge of the Requirements management system & strategy established in the project

  • Knowledge of the change management tools used in the organization & project (i.e. ALM)

  • Knowledge of the problem resolution tools used in the organization & project (i.e. ALM)

  • Knowledge of System Requirements writing methodology and best practices

  • Knowledge of the ISO 26262 standard

  • Knowledge of the FMEA Method

  • Knowledge of the FTA Method

  • Knowledge of the ISO 21434 standard

システム/ソフトウェアエンジニアは、顧客が発行したすべてのチケットを処理し、内部チケットを監視することにより、プロジェクトでシステムとソフトウェア開発プロセス、方法、およびツールチェーンを円滑に実行する責任があります。

job.title: Director Customer Quality
job.description:
Responsibilities

Role Overview

The Customer Quality Leader will be responsible for driving customer satisfaction through proactive quality leadership across existing customers in Japan. This role will serve as the central escalation interface for customer quality concerns, lead a customer quality team to drive cross-functional problem-solving, and manage quality program execution through safe launch. The ideal candidate will foster a culture of quality excellence, collaborate with OEMs, and ensure seamless integration of quality processes across engineering, manufacturing, and supplier ecosystems.

 

Key Objectives of this Role:

•Manage customer quality scorecards, and ensure timely, accurate communication of quality data and reports.

•Develop and maintain Customer Quality Roadmaps aligned with strategic goals to meet performance indicators.

•Drive program-level quality management engineering, plant teams and suppliers to resolve quality issues and implement corrective actions.

•Build and maintain strong OEM relationships at senior management level to develop intimacy level that helps achieve quality targets and customer satisfaction. This includes negotiation of responsibility and cost sharing with OEMs, together with commercial team.

•Represent the company in customer management meetings, audits, and quality reviews.

•Lead and develop the Customer Quality team, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and customer focus.

•Ensure compliance with Customer Specific Requirements (CSR) across all quality and production steps.

•Support change management and validation processes to maintain product integrity and reliability.

 

Key Performance Indicators:

•Customer Scorecard ratings: Drive organization to meet customer 0KM, Warranty

•Quality Concern Responsiveness: Drive his team to meet 8D customer time closure expectations

•Financials: Manage financial impact of quality issues with respective internal departments to avoid any last-minute financial surprises.


Key Year One Deliverables:

Customer Engagement Framework:

Implement structured collaboration with OEMs to define expectations, engagement plan and proactively manage containment and permanent / preventive actions, improving CSS by 10%.

Data-Driven Quality Program:

Deploy analytics tools to identify trends and root causes, improving quality initiative effectiveness by 25%.

Issue Resolution Time:

Reduce average resolution time by 20% within the first year.

Reporting Structure:

Direct report to APAC Customer Quality Vice President. India customer quality managers and resident engineers are direct reports.

Requirements

job.title: Process Engineering Injection Engineer
job.description:
◆MISSION
・Manage the engineering of new plastic part, molds and process until to the SOP.
・Define and implement improvements in materials, designs and processes resulting in measurable improvement of quality, costs and delivery.

◆Responsibilities
◎General:
・Maintain quality standards on all products to ensure manufacturing with zero defect methodology including process documentation required.
・Responsible for plastic part engineering according to the specifications in order to meet the requirement of quality, cost and delivery time for local and global platform (worldwide coordination of mold concept).
・Provide support on new product launch tooling and process at each milestone through production, providing the manufacturing and engineering inputs for development of new process, parts and tooling.
・Lead the tooling design and approval process according to the standards & Procedure (RAISE).
・Identify lean & continuous improvement to existing process and tooling related to current product lines with regard to the cost, quality, and/or design.
・Involve in a global coordination to improve and define standards. Identify and investigate potential new tooling concepts and processes.
・Apply in his field safety procedure and have a role model in safety rule appliance.

◎Essential:
・Design for manufacturing a plastic part, mold and process according to Production System & TPM rules.
・Analyze new product in order to integrate new components.
・Support R&D CAD designer about plastic part engineering.
・Involve in Molding FMEA, SPPC definition and tolerances application.
・Investigate design to cost solutions, identify improvement on part to simplify the machining of tool, optimize molding conditions and reduce cost.
・Define mold features, size and injection molding machine.
・Establish request for quotation with preliminary mold design, with tool cost & timing estimation.
・Validate 3D molds design for layout and mold studies acceptance.
・Analyze Moldflow simulation results, implement solution in new mold, and define molding process window.
・Manage the technical part and mold tuning loops from Off Tool to Initial samples, manage the molding tryouts, define & duplicate the process window to ensure reliable and robust part validation & robust production.
・Support tooling transfer and Start of Production or supplier; Establish technical & maintenance book.
・Evaluate toolmaker (current or new) and teach toolmaker about Valeo standards.
・Capitalize feedback from production and supplier to initiate corrective and preventive actions (cost breakdown, problem solving, troubleshooting...).

◆ Team
10 people in production engineering as a whole

Requirements

Engineer degree or advanced technician in plastic engineering or mechanical engineer degree.

5 years in Mold design engineering in technical automotive parts, or 10 years in injection molding in technical automotive parts

Japanese (JLPT N3 or higher) and English: Mandatory

job.title: Requirement Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

This role focuses on Requirement Management and Change Management for automotive electronic systems including in-vehicle audio systems, cockpit domain controllers, and telematics or connectivity ECUs delivered to Japanese OEM customers.

The primary responsibility is to ensure the correct delivery of all requirements to the end product. It includes collect, structure and monitor the stakeholder requirements during the complete lifecycle processes, manage and report risk toward requirement delivery to customer. This position will ensure data maintenance in the Requirements Management tools, and will measure and report the process performance based on defined KPIs. This position will be the bridge between the customer and internal engineering teams for process and structure of requirements.

This position will report to requirement department head as organization perspective.

 

In addition, this role will also manage all Change requests issued from customer and internally. It mainly includes managing the change request process, ensuring all project stakeholders deliver the necessary input to progress on the Change request process.


What You Will Do

  • Customer Interface
    • Ensure availability of customer requirements specifications
    • Agreed on the requirement management process, especially requirement agreement process
    • Ensure availability of referenced documents (GCSR, ISOs, Norms, Standards,...) and handling
    • Clarify any unclear change request assumption, negotiate the reply deadline
       
  • Requirement Management
    • Ensure availability of customer requirement specifications for all project stakeholders in defined requirements tool
    • Manage the requirement process flow, lead the requirement stakeholder team to build the requirement schedule to ensure delivery.
    • Distribute customer requirements to project stakeholders (e.g. Functional Owner, Project Manager) for analysis and derivation of system requirements.
    • Exchange official evaluation result (DOORS / DNG) to the customer
    • Lead the engineering team to ensure agreement of requirement is completed for customer delivery
    • Ensure data maintenance in the Requirements Management tools
    • Create the requirements specification baselines
    • Escalate any risk toward the requirement management to high level project stakeholder based on KPIs data

 

  • Change Management
    • Serve as the Change Request process owner and ensure customer requirements are delivered through a tailored process.
    • Request technical analysis and effort estimation for requirements from the Engineering Team.
    • Review and verify quotations from a requirements/system perspective.
    • Visualize overall CR status and share KPI updates with relevant stakeholders.

 

  • Tracking and Monitoring
    • Measure and report the process performance based on defined KPIs
    • Track and report missing analysis information
    • Track and report completeness of traceability/linking
    • Track and report completeness of requirement agreement with customer

 

Requirements

What You must have

  • Strong leadership skills, proactive attitude, and a customer-focused mindset.
  • Intolerance toward vagueness
  • Ability to surface risks early and escalate them with clear context, impact, and next steps, rather than waiting for issues to materialize.
  • Displays a governance‑oriented mindset, respecting defined processes, decision ownership, escalation paths, and compliance requirements
  • Communicates effectively at customer and senior stakeholder level, not limited to technical or execution discussions
  • Demonstrates decision‑driving behavior, taking accountability to move topics to clear outcomes rather than remaining at analysis level.
  • Ability to read and interpret customer specifications and proactively clarify ambiguities instead of passing them downstream.
  • Fluent communication skills in English and Japanese
  • Basic knowledge of requirements management logic
  • 5 Years of experience working with or for a Japanese automotive supplier / carmaker

 

What You may have

  • Knowledge of Requirements Management Tool “Doors Next Generation”, “DOORS”, and Doors exchange mechanism
  • Knowledge of RFI/RFQ process
  • Knowledge of process models (e.g. Automotive SPICE®)
  • Configuration management rules and tools especially baselining

job.title: [Urgent Hiring / Recent Graduates Welcome] Sales Representative/Account Manager (Industrial Equipment Industry) *Kawasaki Head Office NEW!
job.description:
Job details    [Department Introduction]
Industrial Division (Industrial Equipment Industry)
Industrial IoT (IIoT) continues to develop alongside factory automation. We propose and provide innovative connectivity solutions, such as high-reliability connectivity technology for harsh environments and high-speed signal transmission technology, to support the automation of factories and various manufacturing facilities. In addition to a wide range of high-reliability connector products from high current to signal applications and high-speed Ethernet communication, we also offer various relays and EMC filters, realizing a one-stop service for connectivity solutions for the industrial equipment industry, including new energy, ESS/BESS, etc.

[Message]
This position involves proposing connectivity solutions (connectors, relays, EMC filters, etc.) centered on our products to customers in the industrial equipment field, such as major domestic machine tool manufacturers, factory automation equipment manufacturers, semiconductor manufacturing equipment manufacturers, and data centers. You will build good business relationships with customers, plan future marketing strategies in the industrial equipment field, and drive business growth. We welcome applications from
those who want to utilize their experience and execution skills at TE Connectivity Japan LLC, a world-leading connectivity technology manufacturer that has been established in Japan for a long time and has supported the development of electronic device connectivity.[Job Description] This role
involves working closely with major domestic industrial equipment manufacturers and railway industry clients to understand new and existing client applications, identify demand for our connectors/cable assemblies/relays, EMC filter products, etc., and providing sales proposals and customer support until business closing. This includes:
• In addition to proposing existing products, delving into the unique requirements of each client (including new business development) and planning/driving new product development.
• Providing close QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) support to clients to improve customer satisfaction and expand sales and business share.
• Collaborating with the heads of our domestic and international marketing departments (planning/production of sales promotion materials), agencies (sales expansion), technical departments, and manufacturing departments to provide total management from development to delivery.
• Maintaining close contact with overseas sister companies to share information and strengthen collaboration, thereby providing better service to clients globally.

Requirements

Eligibility    [Application Requirements]
・ Education: Bachelor's degree or higher
・ Language: English - Intermediate level (目安: TOEIC 600 or higher)
*Even if your current English ability does not meet the above, we will accept applications from those who have basic English skills and a willingness to learn. Also, for young people such as recent graduates, English ability is not a requirement.
・ PC skills (Microsoft Office [EXCEL, Word, PowerPoint MS365, etc.] required) *Excel skills must include the ability to use pivot and vlookup
・ Valid driver's license

[Required Conditions]
・ At least 3 years of experience in sales or technical/FAE at an electronic component manufacturer or electrical materials trading company/agency
*For young people such as recent graduates, the number of years of experience is not a requirement if you have B-to-B sales experience at a manufacturing company or trading company.
・ Individuals who are sensitive to customer and related industry market and application trends
. ・ Individuals who can actively promote projects collaboratively, involving relevant internal departments (bright, energetic, persistent, and cooperative)
. ・ Individuals who are always aware of problems and spare no effort in solving them.
・ Individuals who are confident in negotiations, communication, and interactions with customers
. ・ Individuals with a proactive attitude towards work (not waiting for opportunities) and self-management skills, and a strong interest in the latest trends such as AI.

[Preferred qualifications]
・ Individuals with experience in sales, technology, or FAE in the industrial equipment industry (manufacturers, trading companies, etc.).
・ Individuals with sales experience in connectors, regardless of industry.
・ Individuals who can communicate in English.

job.title: Channel Sales Specialist (Valeo Service)
job.description:
[Departments and Products]
◎Valeo Japan is comprised of four divisions:
1) The Power Division designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions related to thermal management, comfort, and electric powertrains to accelerate electrification
2) The Brain Division designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions to accelerate ADAS and reinvent the interior experience.
3) The Light Division designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions for lighting everywhere. 　
4) The Valeo Service Division provides after-sales service for all products from divisions 1 to 3.

*This position is for the Valeo Service Division.
[What kind of work is this position?]
This position is a sales planning and sales promotion position that not only supports sales activities from a numerical and data perspective, but also broadly handles new customer acquisition, account management,  negotiations with customers, and promotion of aftermarket products.

You will support sales strategies through the analysis of sales performance and market data, and in the IAM (Independent Aftermarket) area, you will be responsible for acquiring new customers, planning business plans, and conducting business negotiations with customers.

In addition, in the OES (Original Equipment Service) area, you will promote sales activities for our own products and aftermarket products and accessories such as air conditioner filters. This includes making sales promotion proposals to companies that manage parts sales companies and regional dealers, and conducting product and business training for new employees.
This position supports the growth of the aftermarket business through a wide range of tasks, from data analysis and sales planning to new business development, customer support, and sales promotion activities.

 [Job Description]
■ New Customer Acquisition and Business Development in the IAM Domain: 

Acquire new and potential customers in the IAM domain, conduct business negotiations, understand needs, negotiate terms with customers, prepare quotations, adjust business terms, plan and propose new business plans based on customer needs, build relationships with new customers and expand business, and initiate and promote new projects in collaboration with internal departments
■ Promotion of OES/Aftermarket Products: 

Sales promotion of our own products and aftermarket products (e.g., air conditioner filters). Planning and proposing sales promotion measures to companies that manage parts sales companies and regional dealers Planning and executing sales promotion measures based on analysis of market needs and sales status Providing product information to the sales network and offering sales support Collecting and sharing feedback from the sales field internally. Conducting product and business training for new employees.

[Rewards of this position]
 - You can be involved in the sales strategy of a world-class automotive parts manufacturer
-  You can be responsible for data analysis that directly impacts management decisions
-  You can collaborate with many departments such as Finance, Marketing, and Sales 

-  You can utilize your analytical skills in a global environment
[Recruitment Background]
Increased staffing due to business expansion

[Team Composition]
7 people

[Job Satisfaction]
- You can take ownership and proactively drive business within Valeo You can work in collaboration with the team.
- With the expansion of the IAM business, you can aim for career advancement to manager class in the future.

 

Requirements

Requirements:
- Sales experience in the automotive industry: about 5 years
- Knowledge or experience in after-sales
- Knowledge of IAM
- Not someone whose main role is sales planning or sales management, but someone who can communicate directly with customers
- Experience in parts sales for automotive parts

- Must be able to communicate directly with customers, rather than someone whose main role is solely sales planning or sales management.


[Additional Target Profile]
- As it is a workplace with many women, we would like to actively recruit women
- Someone who is in charge of sales in the parts sales department of a Tier 1 or OEM
- Someone who can think for themselves and proactively drive work
- Someone who can work flexibly while collaborating with the team
- Older people with abundant knowledge and experience are also welcome

Benefits


[Salary/Conditions]
Up to 9 million yen
*Negotiable depending on experience and skills.

[Work Style] Remote work: Possible up to 2 days a week . Monday is an office day, so attendance at the office is required. 

[Working Hours]
8:30-17:30 (8 hours of scheduled work)
Flextime: Available
Break Time: 60 minutes
*As per Valeo Japan's general rules, it is possible to work from home two days a week (no core time), 

[Benefits and Welfare]
- Commuting allowance
- Retirement allowance system
- Employee savings plan
- Health insurance Employees' pension insurance Employment insurance Workers' accident compensation insurance Company -leased housing system (union members only, subject to company regulations)
- Probationary period: Yes (3 months)

[Holidays and Leave] Complete two-day weekend system Paid leave: 17 days in the first year, 18 days in the second year, 19 days in the third year, 20 days from the fourth year onwards
Total number of holidays: 121 days Saturday, Sunday, Refreshment leave, Bereavement leave Year-end and New Year holidays, Golden Week holidays, Summer holidays (company calendar available)

[Salary Increase and Bonus] Salary increase: Once a year (April)
Bonus: Twice a year (July, December)

job.title: Senior Autonomy Systems Engineer
job.description:
【求人票】Senior Autonomy Systems Engineer (656)Japan
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/maymobility/jobs/8125386002

【日本向け補足条件】
雇用契約

※大きな問題がなければ毎年更新されるのが通常運用です。

給与・手当

福利厚生(日本適用)

手当」として別途支給
● 年次有給休暇制度あり(法令に基づき付与)
● 産休・育休制度、介護休業制度あり
● その他、オファーレターに記載の通り

Job Summary (English)
May’s Senior Engineers are front line problem solvers that get things done. They have
the initiative, experience, and technical skill to be able to solve problems delegated to
them without oversight.
Confidence backed by knowledge and experience is a must.
As a Senior Autonomy System engineer you will lead the solution of challenging and
complex problems facing vehicle autonomy. You will lead the design of future May
autonomy systems and track down and solve the system’s most difficult issues.
Autonomy system engineers are responsible for the integrated functioning of the
autonomy system. Systems engineers interact with sensor hardware, middleware,
autonomy software stack, networking, health monitoring, compute platforms and
electronic systems.
You will be a go-to person for understanding how new features will fit in, how the system
might fail, how to best evolve the system to be more effective or efficient, and how to
keep the system working.
This position reports to the Director of Autonomy Systems.
May Mobility Japanのシニアエンジニアは、現場で問題を解決し、成果を出すフロント
ラインの存在です。彼らは主体性、経験、技術力を兼ね備え、上からの細かい監督を受
けなくても、任された課題を解決できる力を持っています。知識と経験に裏打ちされた
自信は必須です。

シニア・オートノミー・システム・エンジニアとして、車両自動運転における困難かつ
複雑な課題の解決をリードします。将来の May の自動運転システム設計を主導し、シ
ステム上の最も難しい問題を突き止め、解決する役割を担います。
オートノミー・システム・エンジニアは、自動運転システム全体が統合的に機能するこ
とに責任を持ちます。センサー・ハードウェア、ミドルウェア、自動運転ソフトウェア
スタック、ネットワーク、ヘルスモニタリング、コンピュート・プラットフォーム、電
子システムなど、多岐にわたる領域と連携します。
新しい機能がどのようにシステムに組み込まれるのか、どのような不具合が起こり得る
のか、より効果的・効率的に進化させるにはどうすべきか、そしてシステムを安定稼働
させるにはどうすべきか ― あなたはそのすべてを理解し、解決に導く「頼れる存在」
となります。
このポジションは、May Mobility 本社(米国)のオートノミー・システム部門ディレ
クター がレポートラインになります。

Essential Responsibilities (English)
● Coordinate with cross functional teams to develop software and locale-specific
system requirements for Autonomous Vehicle behavior, perception and controls
subsystems
● Participate in team code quality activities including design review, code review,
and documentation of Autonomous Vehicle subsystems
● Collaborate with data science team members to design and implement metrics
capturing key performance indicators of Autonomous Vehicle stack
● Develop unit and simulation tests to validate vehicle performance across target
operational domains
● Develop and test state-of-the-art software in C/C++ to enable reliable and safe
operation for Autonomous Vehicles

● Coordinate and execute on-vehicle tests to validate performance of Autonomous
Vehicle software in real-world scenarios
● Diagnose and root-cause issues reported by commercial operations through the
May Field Response process
● Develop tools and visualizations to enable support engineers to analyze
performance of behavior and control subsystems from field data

● 自律走行車の挙動、知覚、制御サブシステムに関するソフトウェアおよび地域固
有のシステム要件を、部門横断チームと連携して策定する
● 自律走行車サブシステムの設計レビュー、コードレビュー、文書化を含むチーム
内のコード品質活動に参加する
● データサイエンスチームメンバーと連携し、自律走行車スタックの主要業績評価
指標を捕捉するメトリクスの設計・実装を行う
● ターゲット運用領域全体における車両性能を検証するためのユニットテストおよ
びシミュレーションテストを開発する
● 自律走行車の信頼性と安全性を確保するため、C/C++による最先端ソフトウェア
を開発・テストする
● 実環境シナリオにおける自動運転車ソフトウェアの性能検証のため、車載テスト
の調整・実行
● May Field Responseプロセスを通じ、商用運用から報告された問題の診断と根
本原因の特定
● サポートエンジニアが実稼働データから挙動・制御サブシステムの性能を分析可
能なツールと可視化手法の開発

Qualifications and Experience (English)
Required
● Must be located or willing to relocate to Japan
● 3+ years demonstrated experience working on real-world robotic systems
● Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or
related field

● Experience in robot perception, localization, behavior, path planning, and/or
vehicle control
● Strong communication skills in both English and Japanese
● Strong programming skills in C/C++
● Expertise with software development in Linux environment
● Familiarity with git, valgrind, gdb
資格と経験(必須)
● 日本在住、または日本への移住が可能な方
● 実装ロボットシステムにおける3年以上の実務経験
● ロボット工学、コンピュータサイエンス、コンピュータ工学、または関連分野の
学士号
● ロボット知覚、位置推定、行動制御、経路計画、および/または車両制御の経験
● 英語と日本語の両方における優れたコミュニケーション能力
● C/C++による高度なプログラミングスキル
● Linux環境におけるソフトウェア開発の専門知識

job.description:
Role Title:

Programme Manager

Role Purpose:

Ensure flawless execution of Programme Management & Launches.

 

Key Responsibilities
 

 

  1. Ensure that programmes are managed to achieve as a minimum target margins and positively enhance ROIC

Manage the execution of one or more programmes for Driveline products or driveline systems to deliver approved targets i.e. time, quality, gross margin, product cost and programme budget.

  1. Initiate Programme Management following authority being received from relevant management committee or from NBA meetings.
  2. Establish the Programme Management (PM) organisation, including the core team.  Using the PM Kick-off meeting, ensure that all relevant information is reviewed by the PM core team, including approved programme targets, specific customer requirements, product & process deviations, previous concern history relating to the customer and products to be launched.
  3. Ensure that a Know-how transfer plan is defined (if necessary) which takes account of all identified requirements.
  4. Set targets for all individuals involved, including Account Team, Quality, Purchasing, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Controlling.
  5. Ensure that a VA/VE plan is defined and executed to achieve improved Programme gross margin.
  6. Define comprehensive PM Project Plan, including a Master Programme Timing Plan, ensuring alignment with customer vehicle development and APQP requirements.
  7. Together with the Account Team, lead the management of the customer interface to ensure GKN Driveline business objectives are met during launch.
  8. Lead the tracking of product costs for the different design changes with the support of the Account Team, Finance and Purchasing to ensure that detailed and accurate cost data is available when required.
  9. Lead progress of all PM activities, including Action Lists, Risk Management, Change Management, VA/VE, Lessons Learned and KHT activities to ensure approved programme targets are achieved.
  10. Ensure all concerns are addressed and resolved in acceptable timescales. Share any lessons learnt through use of relevant databases.
  11. Ensure management are kept aware of progress against approved targets.
  12. Lead all gateway reviews with appropriate levels of management.
  13. Arrange for I-SHARE programme database to be created, accessible by all members of the PM organisation and authorised management.
  14. Ensure that all required information is managed in I-SHARE Programme database.
  15. Ensure programme status is kept up-to-date in on-line reporting system.
  16. Ensure adherence to Customer Application Programme Management Process (Driveline CAPM), including the approval and rejection of deviations.
  17. Ensure that a comprehensive Risk Management plan is compiled & maintained as an active document which takes account of previous concern history and other risks identified from other functions.
