job.title: Program Manager (Automotive)
job.description:
Overview:

Program Manager is responsible for leading the program in all aspects, from program award (or "Request For Quotation Approval" [RFQA] in some cases) until 6 months after Start of Production.

He/she is the guarantor of customer satisfaction in conjunction with the achievement of program Quality, Cost and Delivery objectives, while ensuring profitability throughout the entire program lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop strong relationships and manage the ongoing negotiations with the customer as company representative.
  • Prepare and submit the RFQA to Management if relevant.
  • Liaise with Program Controller, build the initial Business Plan, define the Program investment scheme, and release investments in compliance with controlling procedures; take economical responsibility for all deviations from initial requirements.
  • Launch and monitor the Program : track progress by updating Business Plan, Program Dashboard and Budget Reports and by leading reviews of program steps and results.
  • Conduct Risk/Opportunity analyses and develop and implement appropriate action plans.
  • Arbitrate any conflicts with the customer on financial and/or technical issues.
  • Staff, manage and co-ordinate a cross-functional program team (Sales, Controlling, Purchasing, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Product & Process engineering) and define team members' objectives and assignments.
  • Create a "Program Management culture" by ensuring processes defined in the Company Program Management System (PMS) are applied at all steps and by developing synergies between all actors involved in the program.
  • Organise communications throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Ensure smooth program transfer from Development Centre to Production Plant.
  • Organise key program information to ensure Program continuity and to contribute to knowledge management

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, ideally in engineering
  • Minimum 7 years of job experience (in an automotive environment and/or with electronics product experience a plus)
  • Minimum 5 years of full cycle project / program management experience
  • Background and experience in sales, engineering, manufacturing operation and, production working with plant manager are welcome to challenge.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Conflict management skills : ability to prevent and solve conflicts
  • Ability to work in a matrixed organisation
  • Good knowledge of Program Management System-Process
  • Good knowledge of Program standards, tools and methods
  • Fluent in English and in Japanese
  • Ability to establish, develop, lead and unite a team
  • Strong financial knowledge (incl. building and following a Business Plan)
  • Problem solving techniques
  • Strategic and analytic capabilities
  • Planning and organizing abilities

job.title: Software Engineer - Body Electronics
job.description:
■Company Overview
ForviaHeller is a publicly traded company and a global automotive parts supplier. As part of the Forvia Group, the world's seventh-largest automotive technology supplier, we provide innovative technologies and high-quality products. In Japan, approximately 75 employees work at two locations (Tokyo and Hiroshima; *Currently recruiting for positions at the Tokyo Shinjuku office).

Heller Japan Co., Ltd. is the Japanese subsidiary of HELLA GmbH & Co. KGaA, a world-leading automotive parts supplier and a core member of the Forvia Group. Since its establishment in 2006, we have been dedicated to providing cutting-edge automotive technology to the Japanese market. Specializing in electronics, lighting, and lifecycle solutions, we are supported by a strong foundation in sales, engineering, program management, quality, and corporate services, driving the realization of innovative technologies and customer satisfaction.

■Our Appeal
We provide innovative technology solutions to globally renowned clients. Would you like to hone your career in an environment where you can constantly be exposed to cutting-edge technology and enhance your skills? A career built with us means growing in a diverse and vibrant culture full of trust and unity. Our company's appeal lies in our willingness to take on challenges without fear, and our corporate culture that values ​​mutual respect and consideration. Come and create the future of mobility with us!

■ Recruitment Background
Currently, we are experiencing rapid growth due to the expansion of our business in Japan, and we are actively recruiting new members for sales, engineering, and corporate roles. You will be able to utilize your experience and experience working in a growing company. We look forward to your application.

■ Job Description
We are currently recruiting multiple engineers and project managers to expand our body electronics division!
This division is divided into three areas: "iPDM (Intelligent Power Distribution Module)", "SCA (Smart Car Access)", and "Lighting Electronics".
For this position, we are recruiting one software engineer for each team: "iPDM" and "SCA".
You will be involved in advanced cutting-edge technology and can experience growth in a vibrant environment where you can lead our participation in the Japanese market!
*The assignment to each team will be confirmed by both parties through the selection process.

job.title: Embedded Software & Safety Consulting - Embedded Software Specialist
job.description:
エンベデッドソフトウエア＆セーフティコンサルティング

エンベデッドソフトウエアスペシャリスト 

職務内容

AUTOSAR（AUTomotive Open System ARchitecture）または機能安全規格（ISO 26262など）を適用した車載電子制御ユニット（ECU）のソフトウエア開発を担当していただきます。

イータスはECU開発支援ツールの提供だけではなくコンサルティングなどの顧客サポート、およびECUソフトウエアの受託開発も手掛けており、今回のポジションはコンサルティングや受託開発で求められる、ソフトウエアの実装、テストおよび顧客サポートを主に携わっていただきます。

具体的にはプロジェクトマネージャの管理において分配されたプロジェクトタスクを担当し、ソフトウエアの実装、インテグレーション、テストおよび各開発フェーズにおける作業成果物のレビューを実行していただきます。

また、ソフトウエアの実装、テストだけではなく、顧客要求を分析し把握したうえで、プロジェクト実行フェーズ、および納品物納入後の技術的な顧客サポートも担当していただきます。

ETASの関連会社を含めてETASはグローバルに事業を展開しているため、日本国内の顧客のみでなく、海外の顧客を含み、ETASの世界各地の開発拠点と連携し、開発プロジェクトを推進していただきます。
またプロジェクトの進捗に応じて欧州やアジアの開発拠点に出張していただきます。


主な業務範囲は以下になります。
・ 要求仕様分析、ソフトウエアアーキテクチャ分析、ソフトウエア設計、ソフトウエア実装、ソフトウエア単体テスト、ソフトウエアインテグレーションおよびテスト、作業成果物のレビュー、受け入れ検証、および顧客への納品物の説明、技術的な顧客サポートまた、本人の希望により、将来的にはスペシャリストとしてではなくコンサルタントとして複数のプロジェクトをプロジェクトマネージャとして担当いただくことも可能です。本人のやる気次第で教育、訓練等の支援を提供いたします。

応募資格求められる能力
・ 組み込みソフトウエア開発の設計、プログラミングおよび検証などの3年以上の経験（C言語およびマイコンの知識および経験は必須）
・ 日本国内の顧客と技術的な聞き取りおよび説明が可能なネイティブレベルの日本語能力（話すだけでなく読み書きも必須）
・ 国内外の標準規格や仕様、および最新技術の知識を自ら研鑽して習得する向上心のある方
・ 顧客および開発拠点を含むプロジェクトの関係者と調整し、開発プロジェクトを円滑に推進できるコミュニケーション能力
・ 海外の開発拠点とコミュニケーション可能なビジネスレベルの英語能力（読み書きは必須）
・ 一般的な電気・電子系、および機械系の専門知識
あると望ましい知識・経験
・ 車載電子機器メーカーおよび関連業界の業務経験
・ AUTOSARを適用したECUソフトウエア開発の経験（コンフィグレーションやインテグレーションなど）
・ AUTOSAR仕様の知識（オペレーティングシステム、通信、診断など）
・ 車載通信ネットワーク（CAN、LIN、FlexRay、Ethernetなど）
・ 車載診断プロトコルの知識（UDS、OBDなど）
・ 機能安全規格を適用したECUソフトウエア開発またはプロジェクトマネジメントの経験
・ 機能安全規格の知識（ISO 26262、IEC 61508など）
・ ソフトウエア開発プロセスの知識（Automotive SPICE、CMMI、PMBOKなど）
・ ECUソフトウエア開発ツールの使用経験（モデリングツール、コードチェッカー、検証ツール、計測適合ツールなど）
・ ソフトウエア開発サポートツールの使用経験（要求管理ツール、トレーサビリティツール、構成管理ツールなど）
・ ソフトウエア開発プロセス改善（UML、オブジェクト指向開発など）


＊現時点において保持されていない上記の知識や経験はプロジェクトの必要に応じて習得していただくことが可能です。

勤務地 みなとみらい

job.title: Project Manager (REQ2025063118)
job.description:
【Job Overview】
Our group is celebrating its 100th anniversary and continues to lead the industry, including being the first in the world to develop Level 3 autonomous driving.

As we enter a new stage of growth and innovation, we are looking for a Project Manager to lead OEM/OES projects , including components and systems with existing technologies.

【Division and Products】
Valeo Japan is composed of four divisions:

　１）Power Division ： Designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions related to thermal management, comfort, and electric powertrains to accelerate electrification.

　２）Brain Division ： Designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions to accelerate ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) and reimagine interior experiences.

　３）Light Division ： Designs, develops, and manufactures products and solutions for lighting everywhere.

　４）Valeo Service Division ： Provides after-sales services for all products from Divisions 1-3.

This position is within the Brain Division.

【Products】
Front cameras, sensors, vision systems, LiDAR, etc.

While being in charge of existing projects, we will also work to acquire new projects.
・Existing projects: Software updates, system/configuration changes, etc. for products already installed in automobiles in mass production
・New projects: If awarded, the candidate will work on the project for 2-3 years

Projects in charge scale and products will be matched to the candidate's skills (in some cases, multiple projects will be carried out at the same time)

【Job Description】
As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for the full scope of project management, from operational and functional execution to team management, budget, and scope control.

- Plan, execute, and monitor assigned projects
- Achieve project KPIs (Quality, Cost, and Time)
- Manage resources and lead, evaluate, and develop team members
- Communicate with clients, including progress reporting, technical discussions, and issue resolution
- Manage project budgets, scope, and changes
- Prepare and coordinate with relevant committees and investment plans

【Business trip】
- Domestic
　OEM: 3 times a month at most, mostly day trips
- Overseas
　Germany (development center): once a year
　Other in-house development and manufacturing teams are in Valeo group companies, so I sometimes go there once a year.
　→China, India, Egypt, etc.

【Additional Information】
- Team size：5～6 members

Requirements

[Required]
・Software knowledge
・PM experience (Sales background who understands technology is OK) or SW engineer who wants to challenge PM
・Automotive industry background
・English: Business level
・Japanese: Business level (N2 *N3 is OK if you can communicate)

[The person we are looking for]
・Has good communication skills (can organize a conversation well, catch up what is not understood and deploy it to the team members)
・Able to handle MTG that may occur at night since the production is done overseas
・Able to work in an international environment People (there are few Japanese in the team)
・People who are strong under pressure and can clearly assert their opinions

職務の目的と価値
Role Purpose & Value

 担当するプログラムについて、実務レベルのエンジニアリング・インターフェースを顧客に提供し、リード・エンジニアまたはチーフ・エンジニアの支援と指導の下、製品ライフサイクルを通じて顧客の期待に沿ったプロジェクト遂行を保証する。
 
Providing the working-level engineering interface to the customer for assigned program(s), and ensuring project execution in alignment with customer expectations throughout the product life cycle, in support and under the guidance of the Lead or Chief engineer.
 

業務詳細
Key responsibilities

 1. 顧客に対する技術面での対応についての統括業務
1) 顧客に対して、技術面でのあらゆる活動を統括する。
2) アカウントチーム、及び、全社的な製品戦略をチーム内に展開する。
3) アカウントチーム内のマーケティング活動を技術面からサポートする。
4) 各プロジェクトに必要な開発や技術検討の工数見積もりを行い、サイト毎の予算の立案、執行に協力する。
5) 先行開発（Stage A・B）、量産プロジェクトの立ち上げや問題解決（Stage C・D）など、さまざまな開発ステージで、
社内スペシャリストからの応援を得られるよう調整する。
6) 顧客の先行開発部隊と良好で有意義な関係を構築する。
2. 顧客とのアプリケーション・エンジニアリング業務
1) 担当車両については、見積もり検討（pre-C0）から量産（Stege D)まで、ブランド名やモデル名に関わらず、
一貫した製品のアプリケーション・エンジニアリング業務を遂行する。
2) 要求仕様の明確化を執り行う。
3. 顧客への提出に必要な技術資料作成業務
1) 機密情報に留意しながら技術情報の蓄積・管理を行う。
2) 製品仕様を検討し提案する。また、海外を含む全てのプロジェクトで、顧客からの要求、及び、社内基準に対して、
開発の各ステージで実機評価を実施し、結果を承認する。
3) 製品の開発計画を立案し、また、開発終了、量産移行を承認する。
4. 海外プロジェクトに関する対顧客の技術面での窓口業務
1) 対顧客への技術面でのフロントエンドとして、あらゆる技術的内容について、国内外の開発チームとの仲介を行う。
2) 顧客文化を社内で展開し、浸透を図る。
3) 顧客の不満をいち早く察知し、社内展開する。
4) 顧客と国内外の開発チームとの間の文書、交信の支援(通訳)を行う。
5) 特に重要な問題に関して、開発チームと協力して、アクション、回答の調整を行う。
6) 顧客との技術面での議論や対応について、担当者間のレベル合わせを行う。
 
 
1. Technical Coordination with Customers
1. Oversee all technical activities related to customer interactions.
2. Communicate account team strategies and company-wide product strategies within the team.
3. Provide technical support for marketing activities within the account team.
4. Estimate the workload for development and technical evaluations required for each project, and assist in planning and executing budgets for each site.
5. Coordinate internal specialists' support across various development stages, such as early development (Stage A & B), mass production launch, and issue resolution (Stage C & D).
6. Build and maintain constructive and meaningful relationships with the customer’s advanced development teams.
 
2. Application Engineering with Customers
1. For assigned vehicles, carry out consistent application engineering tasks from estimation (pre-C0) to mass production (Stage D), regardless of brand or model.
2. Clarify and define customer requirements and specifications.
 
3. Preparation of Technical Documents for Customer Submission
1. Accumulate and manage technical information with attention to confidentiality.
2. Propose product specifications. Conduct real-vehicle evaluations at each development stage in response to customer requirements and internal standards, including overseas projects, and approve the results.
3. Plan product development schedules and approve the completion of development and transition to mass production.
 
4. Technical Liaison for Overseas Projects
1. Act as the technical front-end for customers, mediating all technical matters between domestic and international development teams.
2. Promote and embed customer culture within the company.
3. Detect customer dissatisfaction early and communicate it internally.
4. Support documentation and communication (including interpretation) between customers and domestic/international development teams.
5. Collaborate with development teams to coordinate actions and responses for critical issues.
6. Align technical discussions and responses with customers across all responsible personnel.

job.description:

  • Identify hazard, evaluate, and mitigate the risks in the field of HSE, and implement required action plans to prevent occupational diseases, reduce the number of working accidents, avoid damage to property, limit environmental impacts, and improve site security, by respecting the local regulations, and Group directives

Responsibilities：
Organize and manage all internal and external, financial, material and human resources, in order to:

Technical aspects:

  • Ensure continuously that all buildings, processes, equipment, machines, installations, all devices, materials and products of the site present the minimum hazard, through his involvement upstream of the projects, the issuance of HSE specifications, reception and the audit of these means on a continuous basis.
  • Planning, assigning, budgeting and monitoring the implementation of all corrective or preventive improvement actions in the technical field following to internal/ external audits, inspections and exchange of best practices.

Organizational aspects:

  • Analyze the regulatory compliance of its site and maintain it continuously.
  • Perform risk assessments for all HSE fields on the site, including emergency mode, non prescribed / unplanned work such as contractor works, unplanned maintenance, deviation to validated process, and each deviations is captured in database with an updated mitigation plan to cover deviation lead time.
  • In each area, set up manuals, procedures, instructions, visual standards, and signs
  • Ensure and audit by OJT that safety tools, safety standards are adapted, known, understood, applied, and enforced by management
  • Communicate internally (operators, managers, employee representatives) and externally (authorities, inspectors, neighbors, other companies, etc.) on HSE issues
  • Assess and monitor safety risks from deviations to standard.(Deviation Database)
  • Monitor incidents and accidents on the site using QRQC & PDCA/FTA tools

Requirements

  • Education: Degree / Engineer
  • Min 5 years Experience in EH&S scope and Industrial section
  • MUST: Fluent Japanese and English
  • Team Player / Result Oriented / Communication Skills / Ability to elaborate clear standard (Visual / Well described)
  • Proactive and good accountability

job.title: Key Account Manager
job.description:
Our client in Japan represents sales and the full technical scope of making the best bridge between our Japanese customers and head office project teams, providing tailor-made tech solutions to our customers.

We are looking to hire an experienced key account manager to maintain solid relationships with the Japanese company's key customers. The key account manager's responsibilities include growing the company's revenue by ensuring that key customers are satisfied with the services provided, identifying new business opportunities for key customers and new customers by making the best bridge between our Japanese customers and head office.


To be successful as a key account manager, you should be able to analyze data and sales statistics and improve business and marketing strategies. Ultimately, an exceptional key account manager should be able to manage multiple key accounts without compromising on the quality of services provided

Tasks

  • Comprehensive management of customer relations (organizational, personal, strategic)
  • Long-term business development in line with the company's strategies
  • Developing & synchronizing customer strategy
  • Driving force in enhancing company's appeal to customers
  • Procuring and providing all sales-relevant data,e.g. budget identification and price indication
  • Communicating and collaborating with the advertising, technical divisions, marketing and sales departments to ensure that key customers’ needs are met.
  • Leading the bidding team and holding negotiations for cross-functional and strategic quotations.
  • Negotiating contracts with key customers and meeting established deadlines for the fulfillment of each client's long-term goals.
  • Expanding existing business and positioning new fields of business
  • Elaborating the development & sales strategy in close coordination with the technical division
  • Identifying and communicating the customer's principal sales chances
  • Safeguarding customer satisfaction
  • Compiling reports on account progress, goals, and forecasts for account teams and stakeholders

Requirements

  • Excellent presentation skills; able to communicate technical solutions clearly, in a way suited to Japanese customers
  • Problem-solving focus
  • Strong negotiation and leadership skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering related subject
  • > 3 years experience as KAM in an automotive industry
  • Experience with Western and Japanese working culture
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications as well as CRM software.
  • Proven experience in key account management (Powertrain, ADAS/AD, Infotainment).
  • Knowledge of technical requirements specifications
  • Valid driving license

job.title: Technical Program Lead (TPL)
job.description:
Job Responsibilities

Role Summary
 

  • Lead projects for a customer and execute the task from the start to development completion, then end of product’s life.
  • Job Description
  • Responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, controlling, and completing development.
  • The project assumes a camera or similar system including sensor and ECU.
  • Manage the scope, goals, timeline, resources and so on about the development.
  • Management of a project team which includes HW, SW, system engineer, test and so on.
  • Communicate and coordinate with stakeholders.
  • Report project progress to the superior and the global team and control as necessary.
  • Access and manage risks and resolve issues.
  • Comply with internal process and automotive industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262, ASPICE)

  • Experience in project management or as a development team leader (preferably more than 2 years).
  • Knowledge about problem solving method such as FMEA, FTA and DRBFM.
  • Understanding of development life cycles and agile development methodologies.
  • Understanding of development processes based on IATF16949.
     

Preferred Experience

  • Experience of managing large-scale technical projects.
  • Experience of working in multicultural and multinational teams.
  • Basic knowledge about camera sensing- perception/ECU structure/processing of image signal
  • Knowledge about vehicle communication protocol (e.g. CAN. LIN, Ethernet)
     

Soft Skill
 

  • Strong communication and leadership skills.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Communication in English with members in other regions such as US and India. Skill and experience of communication in Japanese with Japanese customers.
     

Education

Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering such as electrical, computer or related field.

job.title: Function Owner, Interior Sensing
job.description:
Position Summary

The Interior Sensing Function Owner is responsible for the requirements
elicitation, and for the proposal of functions at the vehicle system level,
aiming at acquiring new customers.

The Function Owner contributes to the definition of a Core Function for Driver&In-Cabin Monitoring Systems and has the responsibility to develop a concept for Application projects. This position requires interfacing with cross functional, global and regional Core development teams located in North America and Europe, as well as customers and
technology partners.

Working in the Core team, the Function Owner will be given the opportunity to make significant contributions to the creation and implementation of new active safety products.

Specific Duties

  • Define and design Function concepts and applications in accordance  and external standards
  • Support in process definition and rollouts for ADAS systems and associated tools
  • Gather and analyze in the RFI/RFQ process the requirements and define the corresponding systems architecture
  • Lead an adaptation of a DMS/ICMS-based function algorithm in customer application projects
  • Perform a gap analysis between platform development and customer project, manage and elicitate requirements in requirement management tools (e.g., DOORS) for the owned function
  • Generate effort estimation for the pre-development or application activities and create function and feature development plan in
    the application project
  • Coordinate customer feature adaptation(e.g., interdisciplinary meetings, task tracking, work breakdown and planning, issues management, reporting)
  • Coordinate stakeholders like suppliers, customers, engineering and sensor development for the owned feature
  • Control and perform reviews with cross functional teams for owned feature 
  • Identify possible feature improvements in the scope of customer applications and report into platform development
  • Provide support of process definition and rollouts for feature adaption on system level
  • Contribute to the product roadmap definition in coordination with its owner
  • Establish contacts with carmakers Advanced Engineering and Development divisions
  • Support and review of feature validation and verification with V&V teams
  • Support customer/investor demonstrations or Technology, regional and international
  • Solicit customer input on existing architecture & future needs, feedback to Core
    development and Product Planning
  • Keep close contact to the platform development and coordinate adaptations for customer events: technical demonstrations, documentation reviews, alignments, etc.
  • Join benchmark activities, maintain technical knowledge by staying up-to-date with Veoneer/suppliers technologies
  • Other duties related to product development or support as assigned by the Regional Engineering Manager
  • Travel, including international, to meet with global counterparts and customer
     

Requirements

Required

Experience 

Desired Background

Automotive design or Model based software development for Advanced
Driver Assistance Systems. Experience with ADAS, camera, radar, brake control,
engine/powertrain control, and steering controls.

Previous involvement as Systems Engineer or feature/function
owner, with Customer interaction.

Advanced experience with requirement analysis and reviews.

Past experience with driver status, bio-identification, medical vital parameters are beneficial.

Good understanding of systems architecture workflow and its relation to requirements management.

Profound knowledge in automotive and safety critical software development.

Good knowledge on the NCAP standards.

Solid knowledge with automotive standards like A-SPICE and ISO 26262.

General knowledge of Doors, PTC, JIRA, Human-Machine Interface.

Educational Requirements

Bachelor or Master Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical field of study

Communication And Interpersonal Skills

Excellent oral and written communication skills towards internal and external audiences including customer and leadership.

Analytical ability, experience in writing clear requirements and presenting technical information to non-/specialists.

Problem solving skills independent judgment, hands-on attitude, attention to
detail, adaptability.

Self-motivated, proactive, able to work well within an interdisciplinary
multiple-site team, with minimal remote supervision.

English: Above Business

Japanese: Above Business

job.title: Japan PMO Head (Senior Manager - Program Management Japan)
job.description:
Job Responsibilities:

About the Role

This position is a key leadership role within the Program Management team. The Director has strong expertise in building and leading teams and in many facets of product development. The Director of Program Management is responsible for delivery of all programs and projects in his/her customer group on time in alignment with process requirements, at quality targets, and at budgeted profitability to meet customer and Magna expectations.  Director also ensures identification and resolution of engineering product quality issues related to programs. Playing key roles such as Mentor, Coach, Manager and Team Leader are important in addition to the formal management functions of objective setting, employee appraisals and disciplinary actions.

 

Position Responsibilities

•Accountable for the execution of all global Japanese programs and meeting defined cost, timing, and quality and performance milestones in accordance with customer and leadership defined requirements.  Additionally, responsible for Engineering quality management and escalation resolution.

•Provides team leadership, management support, including coaching and active engagement with direct and extended team, including Program Management and Engineering Quality.

•Establish and maintain robust customer relationships with Japanese customers at all required levels of organization.

•Develops, coaches and implements engineering quality processes and policies.

•Develops, coaches and implements program management processes and policies based on program needs for all stakeholders

•Directs the efforts of product steering committees, ensuring adherence to the product development process for all program managers.

•Manages escalation path to the executive leadership on critical programs, and provides support (Technical and Leadership) to the project team(s).

•Be aware of the big picture (Technical, Product Space, Financial, Organizational, etc.) and proactively support it.

•Communicates as necessary with other senior executives in Magna on program status, new initiatives, etc.

•Facilities executive-level interaction with Customer and serves as an escalation-tiered company representative of internal and customer issues.

•Works with internal and external resources to maintain strong customer relationships with dedication to customer program schedules.

•Reports on group KPI to senior management and the broader organization.

•Prepares departmental/project budgets, and put effective controls in place to manage spending within the budget.

•Develops long-term organizational strategies/plans to meet future business needs and growth opportunities.

•Constantly seeks methods to improve program management efficiency and effectiveness and engineering product quality.

•Ensures that programs are properly resourced (both quality and quantity) for success, whether through assignment of direct resources, or leverage of external resources as required.

•Supports reviews as required.

•Ensures that teams are aware of and using the appropriate tools and processes.

•Provides supervision and oversight to Managers, Senior Program Managers, Program Managers and Project Managers.

•Interviews, hires, trains, rewards and disciplines, and performance appraisals of direct reports.

•Participates in continuous improvement efforts for products, tools, processes and programs.

•Responsible for the adherence of all processes, tools and methods of the program management team to all applicable standards, laws, rules and regulations.

•Performs other duties as necessary in support of business objectives.  Ensures that facilities are in full compliance with all safety regulations.

•Acts as Change Leader for cross-functional organization to ensure continuous improvement, customer satisfaction and quality program performance.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

Education

•Bachelor’s degree in engineering – Required

•Master’s degree in business or engineering - Desired

•Management/Leadership training – Required

•Business Finance training – Desired

Experience

•Minimum of 15 years deep and relevant product development experience and manufacturing operations is required.

•Minimum of 10 years of demonstrated experience in a managerial role of a technical team is required.

•Minimum of 10 years related experience in program management with prior project team management responsibility.

•Deep and comprehensive knowledge of key North American automotive OEM product development practices

•Knowledge of the application and delivery of advanced electronic systems into the automotive industry.

•Expert level problem solving skills, risk management, and analytical abilities.

•Knowledge of Software, product and/or engineering quality.

job.description:
About the Company:

The company is an automotive supplier and partner to automakers around the world. They design innovative solutions for smart mobility while aiming to lower CO2 emissions.

  • Prepares the system test report.
  • Communicates the system test report to all stakeholders, including function safety members.
  • Closes the system test activities.
  • Defines, tracks, and reports KPIs (system test status) in his/her area of responsibility.
  • Continuously identifies areas for improvement, defines measures, and ensures implementation in his/her area of responsibility.
  • In case of deviations, escalates to the test management lead and provides adequate information and proposals for decision making.
  • Takes part in the function of the core team.

Requirements

  • Japanese (business level)

job.title: Customer Manager
job.description:
Our client is a leading, global Tier 1 automotive supplier which focuses on electronics and software for software-defined vehicles—covering ADAS sensors/cameras, vehicle compute, connectivity, and mobility software—with a self-described mission to make mobility safe, connected, and autonomous.

This position is a key account management role focusing on one JOEM customer, managing internal and external stakeholders.

This position is a great career move for salespeople who prefer to work deeply into one customer rather than chase business across many customers. In this role, you will gain a lot of business insight, interacting with executives internally and with customer top management.

Role and Responsibilities:

1) Contracts & Standards

  • Lead and coordinate internal reviews of customer contracts.

  • Negotiate global terms & conditions and ensure alignment with internal policies.

2) Claims & Disputes

  • Define, prepare, and execute customer-specific claim strategies.

  • Act as key negotiator and internal coordinator for cross-BA claims; support BA-specific claims on demand.

3) Commercial Management

  • Drive commercial improvements (e.g., A/R, premium freight).

  • Manage crisis topics as needed.

  • Improve efficiency and digitalization across B2B portals and CRM.

4) Sustainability

  • Capture, align, and negotiate customer sustainability requirements in line with the Automotive sustainability strategy.

5) Customer & Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable insights.

  • Serve as the interface to BA product teams and Japan Marketing; bridge innovation roadmaps between the customer and BAs.

JOEM Product/Platform Intelligence (critical task)

  • Proactively gather, synthesize, and distribute JOEM’s product plans—by vehicle architecture and platform, including alliances (e.g., with TOYOTA).

  • Use these insights with BA/CST to identify early entry points and position our technical solutions at the start of JOEM’s development process.

6) Volume Planning

  • Provide a single source of truth for OEM production volumes (car/platform and finished goods) as the basis for sales planning.

  • Build and maintain a global volume-intelligence network and framework.

7) Customer Communication & Events

  • Define the marketing/communications/events plan per customer strategy.

  • Execute in collaboration with Japan Marketing.

8) Customer Experience

  • Deliver an outside-in view of customer satisfaction and feedback.

  • Track actions to closure and provide proactive feedback to the customer.

Collaboration

  • Serve as the subject-matter expert for the JOEM account and work closely, in harmony, with Customer Sales Management (CSM) across BAs.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in JOEM customer-facing roles (sales, project/program management, business controlling, etc.) in the automotive industry.

  • Communication & teamwork: Proactive, open communicator with a strong team mindset (must-have).

  • Process knowledge: Familiarity with Tier 1 side supplier business processes into JOEMs is a plus.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred; Business or Engineering background ideal.

  • IT skills: Intermediate–advanced proficiency with office productivity software.

  • Languages: Native level Japanese and business-level English.

一人のために、そして世界中のすべての人たちのために、進化を続ける自動車の安全、快適、エコロジーをサポートしています。

job.title: Customer Project Leader/Manager (Cloud)
job.description:
業務内容：
このポジションは状況によって多様性と単独・少数（１～３）現地チームでの効率のよい行動・リーダシップが求められる。
強い量産設計・開発管理の経験は求められるが設計・開発の実業務は少ない。
ビジネス獲得時にはヨーロッパにあるメインオフィス（R&D,　Sales）と密な連携を取りながら顧客に製品説明をして、量産開発・試作・AdvanceEngineeringなどのビジネス取得に貢献する。　地図などのサプライヤとの連携をとる等。
開発が始まると、カスタマーインターフェースとして弊社プロジェクトマネージャや開発チーム（海外、主にヨーロッパ）と顧客開発チームのサポートを行う。　業務内容として頻繁に発生する会議（出張・テレコン）に参加し詳細仕様やスケージュール調整の議論や交渉を英語・日本語の両方を駆使して正しく理解・合意できるように整合・貢献する。
日本側で試作テストやデモンストレーションの必要があれば自ら、又はローカルエンジニアと共にセットアップ・インストールなどの作業や、簡易ベンチテスト・車両走行テストなども行うこともある。
新型コロナ感染状況が改善すれば国内OEM先への出張や（週数回）、メインオフィス・車両仕向け先などへの海外出張（年２～４回）も発生すると思われる。
この業務のカギとなるのは海外にいる弊社開発・営業部隊と日本の顧客とのコミュニケーションをスムーズに行うところにある。
カルチャーや常識の違いを理解し且つ技術的内容を十分把握する必要がある。
業務上、ある程度の通訳翻訳・翻訳分確認が必要となるため、会話だけでなく筆記での日本語と英語レベルが要求される。

ITSの製品：
ITSでは車両向けクラウドサービス、主にドライバ・自動運転車両に向けた地図や地図関係の情報提供をビジネスとしております。　簡単な例として、車両に搭載されたロケータデバイスにより位置を把握し、その周りの地図を弊社クラウドサーバからダウンロードし、車両がどの道路を走行しているかを特定して、前方数キロメートルの道路形状・地物等を車両コンピュータに提供するサービスがあります。　車両に搭載されたカメラ、レーダー、スピード、ジャイロなどのセンサー情報をクラウドにアップロードし、それらの情報から有効な情報を生成して別車両群に配信するサービスや、外部から入手した渋滞情報などを提携車両に提供するサービスも行っております。　また、別製品としてユーザがスマートフォンを使いセキュアに車両のドアを開閉したり、エンジンをスタートさせるKey as a Serviceも行っております。　
本部署ではクラウドサービスをメインに行っておりますが、車両に搭載されているハードウェア（ECU）を開発する部署（例えばADAS、テレコミュニケーションモジュール等）との連携も重要となります。

Requirements

学歴:

  • 4年制大学　理工系
    修士・博士は追加プラス要素

経験:

  • 3年以上のオートモーティブ（優先）、IT、
    機械工業等　量産開発プロジェクト環境の経験。
  • リーダレベルでの量産開発経験（オートモーティブ優先）、2回以上
  • OEM顧客との技術的インターフェース・議論（設計仕様、開発管理などの詳細）
  • Linux,　Android,　Windows、RealTimeOS等でのソフト開発（組み込み又はクラウド）
  • 組み込みハード（ECU）又はソフトウェア量産開発時の試作評価・結果分析、ベンチテスト/車両実走
  • 設計・評価（電気・メカ）量産開発経験は追加プラス要素

技能・特技：
必須：

  • 英語（会話・筆記）：Advanced/Fluent、TOEIC　７００点以上、技術的な詳細議論ができること
  • 日本語（会話・筆記）：Native/Fluent, 技術的詳細議論ができること
  • オフィスコンピュータ・ソフトウェア　スキル
  • 普通自動車免許

優先：

  • カーナビ関係開発：地図、ルーティング、ロケータ
    その他車両組み込みデバイス（ECU）のソフト開発
  • クラウドソフト開発
  • 英語・日本語でのスムーズなテクニカルコミュニケーション（開発管理・詳細仕様・評価項目・製品説明など）
  • 外部開発チームとのコラボレーション

job.title: Business Development Manager (Automotive)
job.description:
Mission:

As a sales leader, the Business Development (BD) Manager will build and lead a capable and dynamic team, provide strong business results, and drive incremental sales in the rapidly growing automotive market. The BD Manager will define and execute account strategies to deliver the best possible customer experience for some of the most strategic automakers in Japan.

Role and Responsibilities:

Key Objectives of this Role:

  • Develop and executes business strategy and achieve sales goals.

  • Analyzes market dynamics to maximize successes and to create new sales growth opportunities through managing the customer design business cycle, market research, intelligence, and competitive market.

  • Build relationships across the customer’s technical and commercial groups, from working level to executive leadership.

  • Build a high level of customer intimacy by being present regularly with the customer and work to drive continued relevance and leadership for the company.

  • Utilize the company’s key leadership with customer to expand the selling process and develop critical relationships.

  • Maintain a deep and dynamic understanding of the customer’s business and technical objectives, strategies, capabilities, and ensure ongoing alignment with the company’s business objectives.

  • Communicates and document evolving business "pipeline" being able to always articulate status of opportunities to executive management as stages progress, on a regular basis.

  • Identify and grow opportunities with customer to ensure continuous growth in all product categories.

  • Use knowledge of competitors’ position as well as the customer’s requirements to play an active role in shaping the company’s Product Development for new applications, products and product developments and innovation.

  • Understand the key customers’ requirements such as cost, functionality, features and other performance metrics and promote the corresponding the company products.

  • Drive design wins for Cockpit Electronics (such as Displays, Clusters, and IVI), Electrification, and other the company product lines, and offerings to customer, including negotiation of pricing and commercial terms.

  • Plan and develop sales presentations and additional support collateral in collaboration with other functional teams and utilizes information when developing new opportunities for sales growth and new business/design wins.

 

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Product Management or related experience.

  • Minimum 5 years working experience at Tier1 automotive supplier

  • Experience with electronic products

  • Self-motivated, analytical, persuasive and strong business acumen with an outstanding track record in sales.

  • Adept at growing sales, negotiating pricing, identifying profitable business opportunities, developing sound business deals as well as demonstrate excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

  • Passionate about technology innovation and business with interests and experience creating and positioning new products and services.

  • Strategic leader with excellent communication skills able to navigate high level complex business opportunities and the ability to engage with customer’s technical, commercial and executives teams to establish strong and collaborative relationship, and strategic partnerships in the end.

  • Inspiring, creative, engaging, and able to build an innovative culture to anticipate change, proactively consider the customer’s perspective, and seek out new ideas, application, products, and solutions.

  • Analytical thinker able to focus on the key drivers of a decision and think through the down-stream consequences of various options. Considers implications, financial impact, strategic alignment and influence to customer’s strategy when making decisions.

  • Results orientated, builds commitments and enthusiasm to meet deadlines and achieve goals. Drives a culture of exceptional performance, accountability and ethical behavior to ensure that strategic focus areas are executed and deliver significant results for the company.

job.title: System Engineer (Project Functional Safety)
job.description:
About the Company:

This company is an automotive supplier that operates in nearly 30 countries. They offer cutting-edge products and systems that contribute to lowering CO2 emissions as well as developing intuitive driving.

Role:

The Project Functional Safety (PFS) as a member of the system department, is responsible for assisting and ensuring that design and development are carried out in accordance with the company's Functional Safety (FuSa) methodology, based on the ISO26262 Functional Safety Standard.

Responsibilities:

  • Identifies, plans, organizes, tracks and documents all necessary FuSa activities within a project.
  • Ensures close cooperation with the R&D TPM (Technical Project Manager) and other FuSa resources in other sites or external contractors.
  • Acts as a mentor/guide for product development FuSa activities.
  • Ensures consistent tracking of all FuSa related activities.
  • Organizes/prepares/supports/moderates FuSa activities and FuSa analysis.
  • Ensures documentation of FuSa activities, establishes evidence of FuSa.
  • Negotiates and agrees with the customer about the scope and common understanding of the FuSa requirements.
  • Agrees on a Project Development Interface Agreement (DIA) for FuSa with the customer.
  • Communicates and reviews with customers to ensure common understanding and agreement on FuSa implementation.
  • Identifies FuSa requirements within the project based on Customer Requirements.
  • Leads design analysis to support the development of safety case arguments for related developed products.
  • Ensures the integration of the FuSa activities in the developed project based on the defined FuSa development plan.
  • Leads hazard and risk analyses where necessary.
  • Leads FuSa requirements and FuSa concepts for system/component.
  • Supports the definition/specification of FuSa requirements for HW and SW architectures.
  • Demonstrates how the chosen technical concept will comply with FuSa requirements.
  • Collaborates with the design team for an effective technical solution to achieve adequate robustness at System, HW, and SW architectural level in compliance with ISO26262.
  • Prepares and assists the Safety Assessment Reviews held by the safety assessor.
  • Leads or participates in safety analysis processes (e.g. FMEAs, FTAs, FMEDAs, etc.).
  • Defines the safety verification and validation activities.
  • Creates the Safety Case for the product.
  • Defines, tracks, and reports KPIs in his/her area of responsibility.
  • Continuously identifies areas for improvement, defines measures, and ensures implementation in his/her area of responsibility.
  • Functional reporting to System TPM (Technical Project Manager) and PL (Product Line) FuSa Discipline Manager.

Requirements

  • Engineering Degree
  • System and/or Software experience in Japan’s automotive industry (more than 3 years)
  • Preferably FuSa management experience in the automotive industry
  • Strong knowledge of ISO26262 Functional Safety Standard
  • Strong knowledge of ASPICE
  • Strong communication and interpersonal and reporting skills
  • Strong technical presentation skills
  • English: Business level fluent (Reading, writing and speaking)
  • Japanese: Business level fluent (Reading, writing and speaking)

job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
A global Tier 1 system supplier in Automotive is expanding and hiring for a Program Manager.

Overview:

  • The Program Manager is responsible for leading the program in all aspects, from program award (or "Request For Quotation Approval" [RFQA] in some cases) until 6 months after Start of Production.
  • He/she is the guarantor of customer satisfaction in conjunction with the achievement of program Quality, Cost and Delivery objectives, while ensuring profitability throughout the entire program lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • From program award until handover to production site, the program manager has the overall responsibility of the program in all aspects:
  • Lead program team as functional manager, with an entrepreneurial mindset,
  • Achieve program targets through development & deployment of program  roadmaps and cascade program objectives and assignments to team members
  • Ensure customer satisfaction (timing, quality, costs, product performance…)
  • Plan and execute all activities which contribute to program success
  • Ensure compliance code of ethics and code of management and escalate non-compliance items according to guidelines
  • Build and monitor Master Schedule
  • Meet financial targets (Operating Income, cash, Internal Rate of Return, Upfronts…)
  • Liaise with Program Controller, build the initial Business Plan, define the Program investment scheme, and release investments in compliance with controlling procedures; take economical responsibility for all deviations from initial requirements.
  • Use Business Plan to monitor permanently convergence to financial expectations
  • Manage the core team (project basis) and ensure cooperation with the functions and the plant(s),
  • Identify risks and opportunities. Ensure risk management and alert process.
  • Arbitrate top issues internally or externally within the program,
  • Act as primary PoC towards the customer to support its expectations while preserving company from risk exposure (like Engineering Change, planning…)
  • Support or take the lead of commercial negotiations for contract evolutions
  • Communicate and report relevant program status to secure proper management support on program issues

Requirements

  • Minimum Education Level: Bachelor's degree, ideally in engineering
  • Minimum 7 years of job experience (in an automotive environment and/or with electronics product experience a plus)
  • Experience of full cycle project / program management experience
  • Background and experience in sales, engineering, manufacturing operation and, production working with plant manager are welcome to challenge. 
  • Conflict management skills : ability to prevent and solve conflicts
  • Ability to work in a matrixed organisation
  • Good knowledge of Program Management System-Process
  • Good knowledge of Program standards, tools and methods
  • Fluent in Japanese and English 
  • Ability to establish, develop, lead and unite a team on a project basis
  • Strong financial knowledge (incl. building and following a Business Plan)
  • Problem solving techniques
  • Planning and organizing abilities
  • Familiar with APQP process and ability for risk management, cost control and quality control.
  • Familiar with development and manufacturing process in Electronics

job.title: Customer Engineering Manager
job.description:
Overview:

The Customer Engineering Manager (CEM) will own global product engineering for a customer base. In this role, the senior CEM will orchestrate successful engineering customer interfaces and will be the escalation path for the customer.

With their global cross-functional team, he / she will be responsible for planning, managing, and completing the engineering development. The team consists of core engineering groups in NA and China and customer interface teams in Japan.

This position will drive world-class engineering development to meet customer deliverables and prototype deliveries while managing the team to adhere to high quality processes / standards that ensure zero customer defects.

Responsibilities:

Manage customer interface and direct customer communication strategy with Japan OEMs in Japan, US, and EU. Ensure assignments from Japan OEMs are well understood, distributed to core teams.

  • Build and manage customer relationships in Japan, US, EU, and China.
  • Work with customer interface teams to manage issues
  • Represent product engineering team in new business opportunities by interfacing with core team /customer / sales. Drive business case inputs and product engineering engagement on new technologies.
  • Serve as internal expert on Japan OEM development processes
  • Analyze and negotiate program schedules with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure product costing targets are achieved for each product. Maintain records of BOM costs compared to targets; escalate within organization when targets are not achieved. Ensure design actions are implemented to recover any cost variance in BOM cost target.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering best practices / processes and facilitate creation of new best practices as appropriate
  • Own and maintain the resource budget and cost of external resources. Ensure engineering resources are hired and qualified to meet the customer requirements. This includes resources in NA, EU, China, and Japan.
  • Ensure engineering teams have equipment and facilities needed to meet customer requirements. This includes budget as well as acquisition.
  • Back up engineering colleagues in Japan Office and program management team as appropriate.
  • Oversee decisions regarding product content, budget and timing to ensure the product is on-time, on-schedule, on-quality, and meets all customer acceptance criteria (Performance and Features).
  • Manage product risk proactively, identify engineering risks and coordinate meetings with the PM and multi-discipline functions to address risks before they become issues.
  • Evaluate engineering processes and metrics to track and measure engineering success. Update processes where needed to address customer-specific requirements.
  • Be the initial engineering escalation point for both internal and external stakeholders to ensure flawless development execution
  • Ensure customer requirements are met with the product designed. Manage customer interface teams to clarify requirements when needed

Requirements

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Masters preferred
  • 7+ years related technical experience
  • 2+ years in engineering leadership or technical program management
  • Proficient in Japanese language
  • Able to communicate in English (spoken and written)
  • Experience as a supplier to Japanese carmakers
  • Experience managing global teams
  • Experience in consulting and/or client-facing role is preferred
  • Must have general knowledge of automotive engineering.
  • Must be able to articulate vision and influence decision making outcomes with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and the customer.
  • Proven and effective communication, analytical, judgment, initiative and execution skills

説明

新しいトレンドと期待に応え、自動車業界は変革しています。この革命に関連したエキサイティングな新しい課題に触発されて、未来を先読みした快適な車室内生活空間と持続可能なモビリティのための最先端技術を開発しています。貴方が明日のよりクリーンでスマートなモビリティに貢献し、価値を創造したいと考えているなら最適な居場所です。

責任と業務ルール

設備の修理、セットアップまたは改修など作業において、適切な治具を使って実行する。日常作業において、作業前に安全ルールを確実に実行または業務関係者をリードする。

  • 生産記録等のペーパーワークの支援をお願いする場合がある（エクセル等が使える

 

Requirements

本職務において、理想的な候補者は下記を有する:

job.title: Senior Program Manager
job.description:
In the role of Senior Program Manager you will act as the Lead of your programs, guiding global cross-functional teams from business award to end of production:
•The role is highly visible; you will support programs that are an important part of our growth strategy
•Programs involve cutting-edge technology in automotive cockpit electronics and products that make the first and biggest impact on consumers

•You'll share ideas and insights with experts in our organisation, at major automotive OEMs and major-name display technology providers
•We offer a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment in which strong performers can make their mark and progress their career.

Lead a team of Program Managers in Japan, UK, Mexico and other global locations. While each team member focuses on individual responsibilities, there is also a good deal of interaction and knowledge sharing.

As you might expect, programs can evolve and change over time. Whatever the program, you and your team will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of electronics projects to agreed targets in cost, quality and timing.

You will be responsible for leading strategy and escalation reviews with senior leaders relating to your projects, typically including Purchasing, Product Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Product Management as well as others. You'll be responsible for overall profit and loss for the program(s), and for ensuring team adherence to internal business operation and project system disciplines.

Requirements

• Minimum of 5+ years of program management experience, preferably in the automotive industry

• Team management experience, preferably having managed Project Managers

• A good understanding of automotive electronics business (or relevant businesses); 

• Negotiation skills

The ability to:
◦Build and lead appropriately skilled teams
◦Prioritise your own and others' work under time and cost pressure (organisation and planning) •Experience with project management concepts and principles
•Experience leading global teams to deliver programs

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
job.description:
【メッセージ】
“接続（Connectivity）”ということがあらゆる分野で重要性を増しています。 自動車の分野においても、多様な機器の間を電気的に接続し、様々な情報や信号、エネルギーをやりとりすることにより、自動運転や電動化等の飛躍的な進歩が進もうとしています。 このような接続技術の中心的役割を担う電子部品として、我々の主力製品である“コネクタ”があります。 高速伝送、大電力伝送、小型高密度化など、その進化は止まりません。

【仕事内容】
自動車業界向けを中心とした電子部品製造において、製品技術、製造技術、品質、生産計画、社内工場等他部門と連携し、品質、技術、コスト、納期のバランスのとれた戦略的な調達/購買を実現する業務です。コネクタ製造における金属材料、樹脂材料、部品調達について以下を行います。
・ 最適なサプライベースの確立と維持、サプライヤーの育成と管理
・ 中長期のサプライヤー戦略、コモディティ戦略の立案と実行
・ サプライヤーの選定、サプライヤーとの価格および購買条件の交渉、契約書の締結
・ 原価改善活動の立案と推進、進捗管理
・ 調達/購買プロセスの改善、最適化

Requirements

【応募資格】
・ 学歴：大卒以上
・ 語学：日本語 - 上級（ビジネス対話および資料作成が可能なこと）
　　　　　 英語 - 上級（TOEIC800点以上またはそれに相応する英語力。資料作成、議論が可能なこと）
　　　　　※取引先を含む海外拠点と、日常的にメールや電話による情報交換と会議の機会があります。

【業務経験】
<必須条件>
・ グローバルに展開する製造業（自動車部品/電機/電子/機械などの工場製品）にて5年以上の調達/購買の実務経験
・ サプライヤー、製造委託協力会社の管理、関係構築・維持の経験
・ 新製品開発プロジェクトに係る調達/購買業務、既存製品の原価改善活動を横断的にリードした経験
・ 問題発生時に、社内外のステークホルダー（関連部門、サプライヤー）と折衝、調整し粘り強く問題解決する能力
・ 社内関係部門を巻き込み、積極的にプロジェクト推進する能力
・ チームの統率、チームメンバーの育成など組織マネージメント能力

<歓迎条件>
・ 自動車業界または車載電子部品メーカー（Tier1,2）にて調達/購買業務の経験
・ 業界を問わずコネクタメーカーでの経験
・ 購買を含むサプライチェーンプロセスを改善した経験
・ 調達/購買プロセスのデジタル化の経験

• シニアプログラム品質リーダーは、プログラムコアチームのメンバーです。彼女/彼は、生産開始までPMS(Program Management System)で高品質の製品品質保証を実現する全体の責任を負います。彼女/彼は プログラム内で顧客との品質計画・品質マネジメント・品質問題のインターフェースとして、チーム内部の機能を確保します。また、シニアPQL(Program Quality Leader)の立場から、PQLを必要に応じ コーチします。
  • Manage the PQLs (budget, allocation of resources, personnel development) ・安全と規制、PPMなどの環境、知覚された品質を含むスクラップなどの品質目標を達成し、それらを内部および外部のサプライヤーにカスケードします。 FMEA、特殊特性、機能、許容範囲スタック、PPMなどに基づくリスク評価のフォローアップを通じて、目標の達成を監視します。 重大な不適合(顧客の期待または安全性と規制の問題など)が発生した場合に、プロセスまたは製品の配送を停止する権限があります。 エンジニアリングによって確立された設計検証計画と生産検証テストを承認し、プログラムのマイルストーンに従って完了していることを確認します。 形状とゲージの測定、チェック、テストの開発および製造プロセスを主導します。
  • コントロールプランの定義します。 ゲート4までの開発フェーズ全体を通じて、顧客に提供される部品の適合性、知覚品質、およびトレーサビリティに責任を負います。 PPAP-生産部品承認-ファイルを準備およびコンパイルし、プロセス検証監査を含む初期サンプルの提出のためにプラント品質エンジニアをサポートします。 彼の活動の進捗状況を月次ベースで報告します(3PRレベル2)。 プログラムリスク評価を開始および更新します。主要なリスクに緊急時対応計画がない場合は警告します。
  • 顧客プログラムの品質との関係を主導します。 プログラム管理システムとエンジニアリング変更管理およびCompanyの原則、ツール、および標準を適用します。 適切な方法と品質基準(PMS、特定の顧客プログラム開発システム、国際規制など)の使用を確認します。

Requirements

  • University degree: engineering
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in the Automotive industry. (Minimum 2 different positions, such as Plant Quality Engineer, Process Engineer)
  • 2 years of facilitating JOEM customer Quality
  • Team leading skill/experience and Teamwork and ability to work in a matrix environment
  • Mechanical analysis skill for 8D problem solving
  • Results oriented
  • Good written and oral communications skills (Japanese and Business English)
  • Understanding of geometrical tolerance and mechanical design
  • Experience of using dimension measuring machine

job.title: System Engineer (Driveline)(Tokyo)
job.description:
The system engineer will populate “System Design Responsible” & “System Designer” role according to Kongsberg Automotives development process. To be able to perform this task, the system engineer needs to have knowledge within following engineering disciplines, software, hardware and mechanics.

 

System Designer (according KBD-SDP)

Responsible for definition, analysis and management of system requirements and traceability (including Safety Goals and Safety Requirements). System includes all sub systems, i.e. Mechanics, Electronic Hardware and Software. Develop the System Design and the Technical Concept (including Technical Safety Concept) that comply with the Functional Requirements and the Technical Requirements Specification of the item. Verify that the System Design and the Technical Concept comply with the Technical Requirements Specification.

 

System Design Responsible (according KBD-SDP)

Main technical interface/contact towards customer. To understand the Customer Interests. To understand/clarify the design Requirements. System Responsible for all designs included in the Project. System includes all sub systems, i.e. Mechanics, Electronic Hardware and Software. To lead / perform the design work on System level including coordination of all Sub-systems and all concerned interfaces. To find and close knowledge gaps and using Set-based engineering as well as simulation, calculations or tests to ensure that the design meets requirements and objectives agreed upon before S-release. Challenge the Knowledge Owners to improve KA standards

Requirements

Qualifications systems engineer (wishlist)

  • Bachelor or master degree in electronics, mechatronics, computer science, mechanical engineering or similar. Work experience in above mentioned disciplines is also qualifying.

  • Requirement management, analysis and break down. Doors, Doors NG, Polarion.

  • Functional safety, ISO26262.

  • Automotive SPICE.

  • ISO TS16949.

  • FMEA experience

  • Project management.

  • English spoken and written.

  • Good communication skills.

  • Automotive experience.

  • Social competence.

  • Electronics HW understanding. MCU, Sensors, Schematic.

  • Embedded SW, Diagnostics, Autosar, Real time systems.

  • System testing.

  • Production of PCBA:s.

  • Mechatronics.

job.title: Senior Algorithm Engineer (ADAS)
job.description:
About our client:

私たちは、モビリティを進化させるテクノロジー企業、。、 我々の知識、システム・インテグレーション技術、ソフトウェア技術、能力を駆使して次世代のモビリティー開発をリードし、 未来を描き、それを実現化する想いがこめられています。弊社は、横浜と豊田に拠点を持ち、日本国内では車両メーカ ー向けに歴史あるエレクトロニクスビジネスと新しいテクノロジービジネスを展開しています。

当ポジションについて:
自動運転、ADAS分野で用いる車載センサーのエンジニア募集。 世界でもトップクラスの売り上げをもつADAS部品のメガサプライヤーです。業績向上に伴い日本の組織を 拡大中。 横浜テクニカルセンターにおいても、自動運転関連製品のエンジニアチームの拡大を進めています。この機会に新 しい製品の立ち上げや、組織を成長させる経験を一緒につんでみませんか。
車載レーダーやカメラは製品のECUとしての側面、および物体の検知を行う計測器としての機能面があります。 その中でアルゴリズムエンジニアは機能面を担当し、検出した物体の追跡機能、ACCなどの顧客機能などのアル ゴリズムの検証および設計を行います。 私たちのチームでは、お客様および社内研究開発部門と対等に会話のできるチームを目指し、成果物の納期、品 質に力をいれる文化を育てようとしています。

主な業務内容:

 車載センサーのアルゴリズム設計チームのリード
 開発プロジェクトの中でアルゴリズムパートの開発進捗の管理および客先報告  アルゴリズムの内容および検証結果に対する資料作成、客先説明
 海外の開発チームの進捗管理
 アルゴリズムの妥当性検討、検証の先導
 実車での計測およびデータ分析を用いた検証の支援
 システム設計チームおよび検証チームの支援

Requirements

必要スキル

 ダイバーシティ豊かなチームメンバーをリードできる能力
 顧客対応経験
 Matlab、Python、C言語いずれかを自在に操れるスキル、経験  三角関数、対数関数などの数学の基礎
 車載エレクトロニクス部品関連の開発経験
 英語および日本語の語学力 (いずれもビジネスレベル以上)

推奨スキル、経験

  •   車載ネットワークに関する知識

  •   顧客対応経験

job.title: Automotive Security Business Development Manager
job.description:
The Automotive Security Business Development Manager will work within the global automotive business development team to lead and foster relationships in the automotive security ecosystem within Japan and the Asia Pacific region. This is inclusive of the automotive OEM’s and Tier 1’s and the major ecosystem influencers for automotive cybersecurity and mobility services

The individual will be measured on the ability to grow BlackBerry’s revenue in automotive cybersecurity products and services, driving and influencing major automotive security design wins. This will be accomplished by identifying key influencers, whether individuals, organizations or ecosystem companies, and by evangelizing the BlackBerry value propositions. This individual will work closely with the global sales team to enable OEM and Tier 1 design wins.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong balance of solution level technical acumen and customer influencing skills. The candidate should possess a broad knowledge base of security technologies and solutions. The individual should be comfortable engaging with engineers or with purchasing teams.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Identify and prioritize the major OEM, Tier 1 and ecosystem influencers in their region and to develop account plans with measurable goals tied to design wins and revenue achieved directly or through influence
  • Establish customer and partner relationships and develop the accounts. Identify creative business models to expand BlackBerry’s footprint in the automotive security market
  • Expand the BlackBerry product footprint and mindshare at the accounts by leading customer and partner meetings including presenting and demonstrating the BTS value proposition for the entire security portfolio. This is inclusive of current and future embedded security technologies and services. The candidate will be able to lead initial architectural discussions with the customer or partner
  • Translate and influence customer requirements and represent to product management and engineering, and to ensure that the customer needs are ultimately met
  • Drive thought leadership within the industry and within BlackBerry, including the development of content to support these initiatives. Represent BlackBerry at relevant cybersecurity industry events and consortiums

Essential Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 7+ years of experience in security business development or solutions architecture
  • 5+ years’ experience in automotive technology solutions
  • Strong technical background and solutions architecture mindset with the ability to drive system architecture discussions
  • Strong record of Tier One and/or OEM business development or sales, new market penetration, and C level engagements with industry relationships which can be leveraged to drive business growth
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient worker who knows how to utilize internal and external networks to achieve results
  • Analytical approach to quickly solve problems with creative solutions
  • Technical literacy with excellent communication skills
  • Experience with legal and commercial negotiations

The Japan office includes various nationalities and offers an international working environment. In addition, the office system is more flexible than other Tier 1 suppliers; work from home is possible.

They are seeking to hire a Sales Manager:

Overview
Our client is seeking a dynamic Sales Manager to strengthen its presence with Japan OEM customers. The role will focus primarily on business development (70%) with new and targeted accounts, while also managing relationships and sales activities with existing customers (30%).

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively build and develop strong relationships with Japan OEM customers 

  • Drive business development activities: identify opportunities, secure RFIs/RFQs, and promote the full sales process to win new business.

  • Manage and maintain relationships with existing customers, ensuring high service levels and ongoing revenue stability.

  • Partner closely with internal departments (engineering, program management, quality, etc.) to align on customer requirements and deliver winning solutions.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to open new doors and gradually expand market share over time.

  • Problem-solving skills, with ability to coordinate across departments to resolve technical, quality, or delivery issues.

  • Native level Japanese skills / Business-level English (intermediate or above).

  • Japanese driver’s license.

Ideal Candidate

  • A proactive, self-driven sales professional who thrives on building long-term OEM relationships and winning new business under competitive circumstances.
  • Someone who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, able to balance immediate sales results with long-term growth.

job.title: Sales and Engineering Manager
job.description:
This person would be our Sales/Technical resource with the OEM customers in Japan – not selling in Japan, but working with Japanese  OEM’s and liaising with our Commercial teams in North America and Europe.   The individual would report to Dan Rudolfi, our Senior Director responsible for the Japanese OEM’s from the Commercial side.  We would be payrolling the person through a Japanese company – JP Tech – and locate the person in JP Tech’s  office in Shin Yokohama.  But, let’s talk about other questions you’d have.

  • The position you want to hire - is he the first employee for Auria in Japan?Yes, but we may not hire him/her as an Auria employee – we are working on hiring them through Nezar Akeel’s company (JP Tech) so we do not have to set up an entity.
  • Does Auria have an office in Shin-Yokohama?No, but Nezar does.
  • What is your budget for salary for this position?We were looking to bring on an IAC resource at one point; his annual salary was approximately 800,000 JPY.

We have talked in the past when I was at IAC – having gotten your contact information from Rick Van Heukelom.  I have since taken over global HR responsibilities at the JV formed between IAC and a Chinese company, Shenda.  We have the need for an Engineering Sales resource in Japan – in the Shin Yokohoma area, who would be our main interface in Japan for Engineering Sales with Honda and Nissan.  I’d like to speak with you at your earliest convenience about such a search – possibly a contracted resource at first if that is something you can help us with.  Let me know your availability to talk if you think you can help us out.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities
 

  • Cross Domain (SWE, HWE, MEE) technical leadership of the development of a mechatronic product, consistent with stakeholder requirements, quality and safety throughout the product lifecycle (EOL, Service, Manufacturing..) Ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Lead development of system requirements, architecture, simulation, integration, verification, validation, calibration and releases for related workproducts.
  • Lead continuous improvement of processes, methods, and tools related to systems management and their interfaces.
  • Approve and manage product development timelines incl. resource planning in systems engineering for projects and represent the progress of product development according to the defined timing to project management and GKN Leaderschip.
  • Define and apply reuse strategy and reuse configuration space in a application project
  • Create, maintain and align system implementation plan throughout the lifecycle of the product and communicate the customer expectation and goals to project members.
  • Lead development of alternative solutions to meet product costs (e.g. design to cost) considering customer requirements and satisfaction.
  • Approval of requirements elicitation procedure, integration and qualification strategy, final calibrated parameter from stability and safety perspective for controls features.

  • Manages resources and deliver according to project budget within systems engineering. Ensure that assigned workpackages are planned, agreed and delivered according to plan.
  • Collect effort estimation for System Engineering according to defined processes and methods. Lead consolidation and optimization of efforts for Systems Engineering activities.
  • Lead resolution of technical issues arising during mechatronic integration & testing according to Change, Problem, Configuration and Risk Management. Escalate accordingly.
  • Represent System Engineering within the whole organization, at external conferences and at customer / suppliers as an expert and strengthen the network with external experts.

job.title: Demand Manager
job.description:
“Connectivity(接続)”ということがあらゆる分野で重要性を増しています。 自動車の分野においても、多様な機器の間を電気的に接続し、様々な情報や信号、エネルギーをやりとりすることにより、自動運転や電動化等の飛躍的な進歩が進もうとしています。 このような接続技術の中心的役割を担う電子部品として、我々の主力製品である“コネクタ”があります。 高速伝送、大電力伝送、小型高密度化など、その進化は止まりません。

【仕事内容】 Responsibility
1. 営業部門と連携しての全販売製品に対する月次Demand Forecastの算定とIBP（Integrated Business Planning）への登録
2. 月次でのDemand Review Meetingの開催及び主導
3. Demand Forecastの分析及び中長期Viewerの可視化
4. 基軸製品に対する長期Demand Trendの調査とSIOP（Sales Inventory Operations Planning）との連携に依るCapacity分析の実施
5. Sustaining Project（増設など）への参画とProject Teamとの協業に依る日程管理
6. Capacity Constraintなど懸案アイテムに対するDeep Dive及び問題解決
7. 年次OA（Operating Advantage）活動への参画とAction Plansの実行
8. STR（Stock Transfer Request）/PDR（Process Design Repository）促進に向けたPlanning TeamへのSupportの実施

Requirements

【応募資格】
・ 学歴：大学(高専)卒以上
・ 語学：日本語 - 母国語レベル（ビジネス対話および資料作成が可能なこと）
英語 - ビジネスレベル以上（目安TOEIC700点以上、または、相応の実力）
※取引先を含む海外拠点と日常的にメールや電話による情報交換と会議の機会があります。
・ PCスキル（Microsoft Office〔EXCEL、Word、Power Point〕必須）
・ 普通自動車運転免許

【業務経験】
<必須条件>
・ Demand Management業務経験（それに通ずるSupply Chainや営業企画系も可）3年以上
・ SAPシステム（特にPP/MMモジュール系）使用経験
・ Team Management経験
・ 関係部門を突き動かす強い推進力
・ コミュニケーションスキル
・ 英語を使用しての業務経験
・ データマネジメントスキル（データ分析力）
・ エクセル及びパワーポイントを駆使しての業務経験

job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.

Visteon is a global leader in digital cockpit and electrification solutions, driving the future of software-defined vehicles with world-class innovation and deep automotive expertise.

The Product Delivery Team

Our Product Delivery team leads the V-development cycle from award to launch and service, ensuring QCDDM principles and A-SPICE compliance while driving innovation and decisions locally. We stand apart by having significant authority and responsibility for design and drive innovation and decision-making directly from Japan.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for a dynamic Program Manager with Tier 1 automotive electronics experience, strong leadership in program launches, and excellent communication skills to manage cross-functional global teams.

Key Objectives of this Role:

  • Oversee program financial targets with the product financial team to ensure objectives are achieved.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing plants, including our Hiroshima facility and global sites, to manage cost and timing for the program.
  • Lead supplier sourcing with the Purchasing Department, ensuring alignment with program goals.
  • Mitigate project risks by managing RIOs in enterProj (Program Management tool) and ensuring timely closure.
  • Support the project team in their monitoring and reports of timing, income, expense, and resource management.
  • Prepare and lead Project Board reviews, ensure quality assurance, and chair the Change Control Board (CCB) to manage key project changes and issues.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Achieve program financial targets
  • Ensure Plant process readiness
  • Effective risk and issue management

Key Year One Deliverables:

Deliver comprehensive milestone and launch readiness reports, ensuring alignment with customer expectations.

Requirements

What you need

  • Project Management or product development experience in the automotive industry with exposure to Electronics products (more than 3 years)
  • A proven track record of managing programs from business awards to launch
  • Experience working with cross-functional departments (Purchasing, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, Accounts, etc.)
  • Business-level Japanese and English

What we’d love

  • Experience working in either JOEMs or tier 1s to JOEMs
  • Experience with Cockpit Electronics, similar to Visteon product portfolio
  • Experience with hardware and software-based products both in development and production environments.

Languages - fluent Japanese

job.title: Sales Account Manager

Our client is a long-established global Tier-1 automotive supplier.  It serves major automakers across programs in vehicle automotive electronics. Requirements

  • 5+ years in automotive sales experience, preferably Tier 1 or Tier 2.

  • Project & change management: coordinates development projects, processes ECOs/changes, and drives value-engineering/rationalization with program management.

  • Contract/quality compliance: reviews customer contracts against internal policies; works with legal, quality, and PM to align terms and deliverables.

  • Cross-functional execution: partners with global project teams and plants; supports production/operations to meet customer expectations; escalates risks early.

  • Tools & reporting: proficient with CRM (e.g., Salesforce), price files, and forecasting; delivers accurate volume/price reports to global stakeholders.

job.title: Manager, Operations
job.description:
The Operations Manager oversees the operation of autonomous vehicle technology across Japan. The position is responsible for ensuring timely preparation and operation of sites, being a liaison for company, and providing operations training to our partners. This position is also responsible for the integration work of ADK to the platform vehicle in Japan. The Operations Manager shall maintain strong relationships with our partners and balance customer satisfaction with  needs and resources.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Manage autonomous vehicle operations in Japan, including the vehicle integration work as well as operation work at site.

  • Serve as a partner contact for vehicle operation, maintenance, and integration.

  • Manage site field engineers (SAEs) in Japan

  • Ensure consistency between Japanese and US operations, and be the bridge between

    US operations team and JP operations team for the best practices to be share

  • Develop and maintain a regular cadence of communication with company and non-company operations teams and AVOs to keep them informed about software and process updates and to assess the need for training.

  • Work with Program Management to coordinate with our partner’s operation and maintenance entity.

  • Work with Vehicle Integration to ensure the proper integration and maintenance of

    ADK hardware.

  • Coordinate infrastructure preparation and maintenance with partners.

  • Manage and maintain repair parts inventory in Japan.

  • Train and certify personnel on vehicle operation and safety

  • Train personnel on deployment tools such as fleet management, issue tracking, and

    learning platforms.

  • Train the trainer of 3rd party operators.

  • Train site operator

  • Track operational KPIs and ensure global standardization.

  • Provide operational support, escalation management, and customer relationship

    management.

  • Develop and deliver training, and assess training needs.

  • Drive customer retention and identify expansion opportunities.

Requirements

Skills and Abilities

Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:

  • Leadership to guide and mentor the direct reports

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in Japanese and English

  • Ability to build and maintain relationships across both technical and nontechnical stakeholders

  • Proven ability to create and maintain clear and thorough documentation of processes and procedures

  • Leadership in training others

  • Ability to keep calm under pressure

  • Ability to keep learning and updating the knowledge about May’s technology and operation to communicate them correctly with our partners

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent

  • At least 3 years of experience of managing a team

  • Experience in engineering

  • Experience with problem solving in a customer facing environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple platforms, with the ability to explain complex and technical concepts in an easily understandable manner

  • Ability to work effectively with team members at all levels of the organization

  • Excellent Japanese and English language skills for both verbal and written communication

  • Japan’s Drivers license

job.description:

Ensure flawless execution of Programme Management & Launches.

Manage the execution of one or more programmes for Driveline products or driveline systems to deliver approved targets i.e. time, quality, gross margin, product cost and programme budget.

  1. Initiate Programme Management following authority being received from relevant management committee or from NBA meetings.
  2. Establish the Programme Management (PM) organisation, including the core team.  Using the PM Kick-off meeting, ensure that all relevant information is reviewed by the PM core team, including approved programme targets, specific customer requirements, product & process deviations, previous concern history relating to the customer and products to be launched.
