job.title: Quality Manager (Yokohama or Osaka)
job.description:
Position Summary:

Responsible for operation and development of quality programs/systems to ensure quality control and assurance on the production of the products consisted with established quality standard and/or internal and external customers’ requirements by performing following duties.

The responsibility also includes handling customer problem solving activities as a corporate quality manager of TJ.

 

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Act as a representative for all quality problems.

  • Lead customer problem solving activities for customer to identify root cause and generate corrective action plan

  • Drive on plant customer issue handling and related process set up/implementation problem solving activity.

  • Lead manufacturing process efficiently from product quality point of view to build high quality manufactured products to meet with customer specification.

  • Formulate and maintain quality objectives in compliance with corporate policies and goals.

  • Develop and initiate standards and methods for inspection, testing and evaluation. Develop Inspection Check sheets for manufactured parts and purchased parts.

  • Analyze statistical data and product specification to determine standards and establish quality and reliability objectives of finished products.

  • Perform quality engineering review of design documentation to participate in design reviews of product, process and tolling.

  • Develop, coordinate and maintain PFMEA and control plans with being part of core team to develop Process flow, PFMEA, Control plan, Check Sheets and so on.

  • Initiate and lead APQP process, review and approve PPAP from suppliers. Coordinate with suppliers on Quality issues and resolutions.

  • Conduct internal audits on Process, Product and System. Maintain data/documents and submit quality reports such nonconformance, PPM, etc as required by management and/or customer.

  • Design and implement quality training for engineers and production workers.

  • Investigate and take necessary actions to customer’s feedback and claims. Lead 8D activities to close Quality issues.

  • Support company initiative and programs such as Lean, Six Sigma and TVM.

  • Use BOS to track quality record and improve production process.

  • Review gauge designs. Plan, purchase and maintain gauges and instruments. Ensure Gauge calibration per schedules. Coordinate calibration and maintain Gauge calibration records. Perform MSA.

  • Perform other duties as required.

 

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in plant QC or QA.

  • ISO 9001/TS16949 application to a facility and/or process.

  • Skills/experience in quality audit and statistical methodology .

  • Global Experience / exposure.

  • Leadership skill.

  • Excellent communication skill in English and Japanese.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a College Degree in Engineering.

  • Self Starter.

  • Knowledge of Gauge designs / Gauge functions.

  • Ability to read and understand drawings / GD&T.

  • CMM programming and inspection using CMM.

  • Weld cut check qualifications.

  • Excellent computer skills (Excel / Word / Power Point) .

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including travel and attending conference calls at night.

job.title: SW Product Owner
job.description:
General Description (Purpose of the placement, Scope of program):

Software Product Owner for JOEM programs at Visteon will play a key role in planning, tracking, and oversight of high-quality embedded software of our Products to the Customers.

Specific Responsibilities (Detailed information of the position's R&R):

• Establish and maintain coherent plan across system, software and functional validation in a product backlog utilizing RTC work packages/vFIP for original scope and change requests (including supplier deliverables).
• Drive work item status update in the central planning database (RTC work packages) as work is completed but at least prior to the progress tracking meeting.
• Monitor progress of deliverables through periodic meetings using dashboards of live data with the focus of status, scope, priority and re-planning.
• Ensure lower level work items (epics/stories/tasks) are created by involving the relevant system, software and functional validation stakeholders.
• Participate in SW scrum ceremonies sprint planning, daily scrum (optional), sprint reviews and retrospection.
• Provide progress updates to project stakeholders (including OEM) regarding the status of systems, software and functional validation teams through vFIP.
• Facilitate dependencies management between systems, software, functional validation and other disciplines (through PDTL).
• Escalate RIOs concerning system, software development and functional validation that may require next level of attention to Chief Engineer / CRE Leader.
• Ensure discipline specific strategies are created and maintained mainly for system, software, functional validation and hardware (though PDTL).
• Drive process compliance and deliverables quality of system, software and functional validation teams.
• Ensure the requirements impediments/issues are resolved by involving the appropriate teams (including OEM) on time.
• Coordinate with the systems, software and functional validation team for technical impact, estimates and schedule for PICs (customer change requests) supporting PDTL.
• Ensure the defined level of traceability and consistency between system, SW development and functional validation work products is maintained.
• Review the test coverage and test status report to ensure all applicable systems and software requirements have been tested prior to release (Test coverage includes all levels test of from system “V” cycle).
• Lead SW release readiness and approval process.
• Triage, prioritize and forecast defects from customer or functional validation teams (In large projects, this may be done by a dedicated defect manager role supporting the SW PO).
• Lead the resolution of time sensitive showstopper issues resulting from system, software and functional validation by raising alerts to the concerned teams.
• Manage non-functional requirements with work packages (e.g. software related certification requirements android auto / car play, SW re-flash strategy definition).


 

Requirements





 

Required skills and experiences:

• Solid experience in embedded software development for 8-10 years preferably with Automotive background - Cluster/Infotainment/Platform software.
• Quick decision-making and negotiation skills.
• Excel in Teamwork and relationship management with Customer.

• Communication skills - Verbal and Written.
• Experience in problem solving (8D, 5-Why, Fish Bone...) and process improvement. • Strong analytical & debugging skills.
• Japanese language skill.

job.title: Itako. - Senior Electronics Engineer
job.description:
[Position Overview]
・An electronics engineer responsible for domain controller products and other products currently in mass production.
Based at the Ibaraki office, you will primarily be responsible for the hardware design and development of “domain controllers” (for ADAS, body systems, or integrated cockpits). Your mission will be to leverage Valeo's global standards and cutting-edge technologies to develop complex products equipped with high-performance SoCs (Systems-on-Chip )
and high-speed communication interfaces, ensuring they meet both functional safety (ISO 26262) and cybersecurity requirements.

Background】
Due to a new ADx project being assigned for mass production at our Ibaraki plant, we are opening this position to strengthen our organizational structure. This is an expansion-driven recruitment to support the new project, not a backfill for a departure.

[Key Responsibilities]
◎Hardware Design & Development
・Design and develop electronic circuits for domain controller products.
・Design analog/digital circuits.
・Design peripheral circuits for SoCs, MCUs, and DDR4/DDR5 memory.
・Design power supply circuits (DC-DC converters, PMICs, etc.).
・Design automotive communication circuits (CAN, LIN, etc.).

◎Development Documentation
・Create ITS (In-circuit Test Specifications).
・Create SPPC (Special Product and Process Characteristics).
・Prepare technical documents and design reference materials.

◎Cross-Functional Collaboration
・Collaborate with the Software, System, Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to achieve product optimization.
・Optimize BOM (Bill of Materials).
・Evaluate productivity improvements.
・Resolve technical issues.

◎Design Review & Verification
・Participate in Design Reviews (DR).
・Define test requirements for EOLT (End of Line Tester).
・Conduct product verification and mass-production viability checks.

◎Production Transfer & Technical Transfer
・Transfer product definition information, including drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
・Execute technical transfer to the production department.
・Support the launch of manufacturing processes.

◎Mass Production Support & Quality Improvement
・Participate in plant QRQC (Quick Response Quality Control).
・Analyze causes of defects during mass production.
・Drive problem-solving activities on the manufacturing shop floor.
・Provide technical support for EOLT.【Why This Role is Rewarding】
・Opportunity to work on cutting-edge ADAS products for ADx.
・Gain experience in developing automotive electronic products that meet global standards.
・Involvement in the complete lifecycle?from initial design to final mass production.
・An environment where you can take initiative while leveraging your technical expertise.
・Future career paths available toward Technical Leader or Project Engineer roles.
 

Requirements


Eligibility Requirements    [Required (MUST)]
　・Practical experience in the development of vehicles, in-vehicle ECUs, or automotive components (3+ years)
　・Experience in hardware development and design for embedded products (3+ years) *Most important
　・Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, etc.)
　・Ability to read mechanical 2D drawings/machine drawings
　・Conversational Japanese or higher
　・Business English or higher

[Preferred (WANT)]
・Knowledge of standards such as functional safety (ISO 26262) and cybersecurity
・Knowledge of system design related to hardware design
・Knowledge of electronic components and printed circuit boards

[Recommended for those who:]
・Can learn and grow on their own
・Can act proactively in response to challenges
・Value communication with related departments
・Can think and act independently rather than waiting for instructions
・Can immerse themselves in the field while utilizing their technical skills

job.title: Sales Account Manager
job.description:
Sales Account Manager

 

No, this isn’t one of those ordinary jobs.

 

Cummins is a team of dependable, innovative thinkers, who are empowered to generate and deliver solutions for customers, community and environment. Our employees develop their careers through the challenges only a diverse, global innovator can promise. This is a collaborative culture where thinking beyond your desk is more than part of the job. It is the job.

 

This is what we call Working Right.

 

Cummins, a global power leader, is a corporation of complementary businesses that design, manufacture, distribute & service engines, fuel systems, controls, air handling, filtration, emission solutions, power generation systems and all related technologies.

 

We are committed to building partnerships with our people, our customers, our environment and our communities. We are working right.

 

Our Vision is "making people's lives better by unleashing the power of Cummins" and it is carried out by our employees around the world who give of their time, talents and resources to improve the communities in which we live and work. More than 150 Community Involvement Teams worldwide work with the Company's Corporate Responsibility Corporate Responsibility organization and senior management to strengthen our communities with a focus on education, the environment and social justice.

 

Cummins, a Fortune 150 company, has been recognized by national and international organizations for our employees and Cummins’ unique working culture such as World’s Most Ethical Companies by the Ethisphere and awarded a perfect scored in the 2013 Corporate Equality Index by the Human Rights Campaign as part of its Best Places to Work initiative.

 

This is an exciting opportunity in Tokyo for an Account Manager. Cummins Emission Solutions (CES) in Japan is where Account Manager can lead for all sales activities and results for a specific line of business in a given territory or region. Develops sales plans and budgets for achieving sales goals. Assigned business customers to achieve sales goals, expanding existing customer relationships and executing account sales plans in support of business strategy.

 

Thinking Beyond Your Desk Includes

•    Lead the Cummins Emission Solutions Business in Japan, delivering financial performance and business growth through being the first choice of our customers and meeting the needs of the market.

•    Directs and manages the products, programs, and processes within the region to achieve strategic growth plans. Collaborates with Global Teams and other Business Units to understand customer needs and provide the required products and services.

•    Work across BU’s to ensure appropriate support to customer needs

•    Grow and improve relationship and service to the regional OEM’s by effectively managing the customer, resolving issues, serve as the bridge between the customer and the work/team going overseas, conducting commercial negotiations, resolving issues, and various aspects of account management.

•    Understand the country opportunities, markets and customers and develop and implement a growth strategy that will ensure market share growth in the region

•    Work cross regions with programs and accounts to ensure alignment of the voice and support to the customer

•    Drive growth in the country by actively building customer relationship, identifying and pursuing growth initiatives, and effectively working across regions on required support and commercial offering to customers

•    Responsible for opportunity management which includes identifying new growth opportunities and managing new business growth for a key market segment or in a specified region or channel.

•    Helps coordinate the work of multiple functions across the region and oversees the implementation of operating policies and procedures across the business including customer service, finance, quality control, and purchasing and materials management. Anticipates, recognizes, facilitates and coordinates the resolution of cross-functional challenges that may impact organizational success.

•    Responsible for managing the relationships and business strategies for key accounts, which includes selling the organization's products to assigned business customers to achieve business goals, expanding existing customer relationships and executing account sales plans in support of business strategy.

•    Investigate markets needs/trend and find out potential opportunities and introduce our technology/capability/experience/ into OEMs and conduct the quote based on RFQ, made a JDA or Supply Agreement with OEMs and communicate our plant/engineering internally to carry out new business developments.

•    Leads, manages and coordinates communication and interfaces with CES customers at all levels.

•    Develops account strategy and works with key stakeholders in the business to achieve optimum results.

•    Negotiates and implements contracts with accounts as authorized.

•     

Skills And Experience Required

•    Product Knowledge - Knowledge of products and product lines. Able to represent the features and benefits to sell the products.

•    Able to recognize customer needs and suggest product applications to solve problems and create benefits for the customer.

•    Able to teach others to formulate effective messages and represent the features and benefits of the product.

Focus On Customer Needs - Leading authority with respect to customer needs and interactions. Able to train specialists.

•    Knowledge of competitive alternatives. Able to directly influence the customers response to those alternatives.

Account Planning

•    Can evaluate account plans to determine their effectiveness. Able to develop and implement strategies to increase sales and strengthen customer relationship.

•    Able to demonstrate proper use of and teach others on Customer Market Profitability tools pertaining to account planning as well as customer loyalty NPS tools and process.

Sales Calls

•    Able to formulate sales strategies, plan and conduct calls, gather information, persuade others and negotiate terms of sale. Able to teach others to apply sales skills.

Manage Customer Relationships

•    Able to identify contact management requirements, set performance standards and develop strategies for optimizing sales force productivity.

•    Can coach others on the ability to establish rapport, meet commitments and develop strong working relationships with customers.

Sales Negotiations

•    Can coach others on the utilization of negotiating skills. Uses the Customer Market Profitability tools that support customer negotiations. Lead negotiator on major accounts.

job.title: Electrical / Electronic Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Electrical Engineers - UX
UX 製品 エレクトリカルエンジニア

Summary

SVA (Smart Vehicle Architecture)構想に基づき、最新世代の統合コックピット コントローラ ー (ICC)の設計開発を行います。 本ポジションでは、メーター、ナビ、テレビ、オーディオ、ETC等のシステムを含むJOEM 向けUX製品の電気・電子設計の担当をしていただきます。

Based on the SVA (Smart Vehicle Architecture) concept, this position will design and develop the latest generation of Integrated Cockpit Controllers (ICC).
You will be responsible for the electrical and electronic design of UX products for JOEM, including systems for meters, navigation, TV, audio, ETC, etc.

Your Role

  •   電気ハードウェア設計をリードするデザインに取り組む Work on design tasks to lead the electrical hardware design

  •   顧客仕様のレビュー
    Review customer specifications

  •   ワーストケース解析とシミュレーションを実施し、顧客要件への準拠を確認する Perform worst case analysis and simulations to ensure compliance to customer requirements

  •   製品設計レビューのサポート Support product design reviews

  •   電気DFMEAの開発と維持
    Develop and maintain electrical DFMEA

  •   EMCおよび検証テストのサポート Support EMC and validation testing

  •   テストの失敗を解決するための構造化された問題解決手法の活用 Utilize structured problem solving techniques for test failure resolution

    Your Background

  •   自動車産業または家電分野での 5 年以上の実務経験
    5 years of work experience in Automotive Industry or Consumer Electronics

  •   問題解決手法に精通している、または使用経験がある
    Familiar with or experience using basic structured problem solving techniques

  •   日英両言語による優れたコミュニケーション能力
    Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Japanese and English

  •   工学分野の学士号 (電気工学または電気工学技術)
    Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline (Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology)

Your Character

  •   革新的で既成概念に捉われない考え方を出来る方
    You are Innovative: Challenge us to think outside the box, creating solutions which will enhance our technology landscape

  •   自発的に行動し、結果を出すことに強い熱意を持っている方 Self-motivated and have a strong passion for achieving results

  •   自身の行動に対して高い責任感を持ち、オーナーとして行動できる方 High responsibility for own actions and able to act like an owner

job.title: Software Project Lead - Automotive Telematic Projects

job.description:
Our client is a global motion control technology company across all mega-trends – including ADAS/automated driving, electrification, shared mobility.

The role of a Production Supervisor is to manage the production performance, personnel issues and the Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) standards of several Autonomous Production Groups (GAP). 

Ensuring permanent presence in the area, the supervisor has a close relationship with all operators under his/her responsibility.

He/she is involved in daily management and in development of the team.

The main missions of the role are to:

  • Lead the Quality Cost & Delivery (QCD) performance for designated groups

  • Direct QCD initiatives: set targets, implement plans, track daily results, make appropriate adjustments in resource planning in order to attain desired results

  • Drive actions for improvement: communicate with the Plant Manager, Production Supervisors of other shifts, and support functions to ensure a transparent information flow, collaborate to define improvement areas and precise action plans.

  • Manage team performance: know team problems, define areas for performance improvements with team members, drive teamwork, lead problem solving groups, lead workshops on quality improvement methods (5S, TPM, 6M…).

  • Manage the personnel issues of the assigned team

  • Ensure daily team management: assure appropriate headcount, ensure the respect of standardised work methods, assure presence on the floor to answer questions or address problems

  • Develop the team: ensure proper staffing, integrate new team members, foster individual development plans, advise and arrange for appropriate training, assure punctual job evaluations, etc.

  • Ensure that working conditions are fully compliant with Group HSE standards: interfere in production line in case of safety risks and drive improvement of working conditions and ergonomics

Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in engineering or Diploma with a specialization in Production

  • 1-3 years of production experience

  • Team Player

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

  • Japanese fluent level to interact within plant & ability to communicate in English with Management team

job.title: Health Safety Environment Manager (ADAS)
job.description:
Identify hazard, evaluate, and mitigate the risks in the field of HSE, and implement required action plans to prevent
occupational diseases, reduce the number of working accidents, avoid damage to property, limit environmental impacts,
and improve site security, by respecting the local regulations, and Group directives.

In accordance with the country's regulations and Group requirements, and certified Management System, his role of the
HSE Manager is to organize and manage all internal and external, financial, material and human resources, in order to:

Technical aspects:

  • Ensure continuously that all buildings, processes, equipment, machines, installations, all devices, materials and products of the site present the minimum hazard, through his involvement upstream of the projects, the issuance of HSE specifications, reception and the audit of these means on a continuous basis.
  • Planning, assigning, budgeting and monitoring the implementation of all corrective or preventive improvement actions in the technical field following to internal/ external audits, inspections and exchange of best practices.

Organizational aspects:

  • Analyze the regulatory compliance of its site and maintain it continuously.
  • Perform risk assessments for all HSE fields on the site, including emergency mode, non prescribed / unplanned work such as contractor works, unplanned maintenance, deviation to validated process, and each deviations is captured in database with an updated mitigation plan to cover deviation lead time.
  • In each area, set up manuals, procedures, instructions, visual standards, and signs
  • Ensure and audit by OJT that safety tools, safety standards are adapted, known, understood, applied, and enforced by management
  • Communicate internally (operators, managers, employee representatives) and externally (authorities, inspectors, neighbors, other companies, etc.) on HSE issues
  • Assess and monitor safety risks from deviations to standard.(Deviation Database)
  • Monitor incidents and accidents on the site using QRQC & PDCA/FTA tools

Behavioral aspects:

  • Develop manager Safety Skills using Safety first, Risk Hunting, PFMEA, Safety Talks and Safety Briefing tools to certified and autonomous in safety.
  • Train people to react in emergency and unexpected situation
  • Train people with Ergonomics to avoid risk and injury
  • Train people and certify for work coordinator

Requirements

Master Degree / Engineer

Must
・5 years Experience in HSE scope and Industrial section
・Japanese + English (Mandatory)

Team Player / Result Oriented / Communication Skills / Ability to elaborate clear standard (Visual / Well described)
Proactive and good accountability

job.title: Software Test Engineer
job.description:
Summary
Bose Corporation is looking for a highly motivated, detail oriented engineer to join the automotive
software testing team. This person will perform embedded software testing and automation
development on state of the art automotive audio amplifiers. This person will also interact with the
Global Software development and validation teams. The position will also work closely with
Engineering Project Managers to ensure proper test coverage and project deadlines are met.

Responsibilities
• Design and develop test plans, procedures and generate test reports.
• Develop and execute automation scripts.
• Assist developers in debugging customer issues.
• Maintain/update defects database with a defect tracking system.
• Support determining root cause of defects through structured analysis
• Manage validation schedules based on project demands.
• Participates in requirements reviews, design reviews, and related activities in development
process.
• Design and maintain test infrastructure for automation test suites.
• Manage validation activities assigned to offshore team.

Requirements

SKILLS REQUIRED
• Strong communication and problem solving skills.
• Self-motivated, work well in a team as well as independently.
• Experience in Software development.
• Knowledge in developing automation test scripts with Python.
• Knowledge of C/C++, MatLab, and Microsoft Office.
• Working knowledge of Digital Signal Processing.
• Familiar with analyzing signals on an Oscilloscope and configuring Function Generators.
• Experience with automotive networks, such as CAN, MOST, RS-485 and Ethernet AVB.
• Familiar with Lean process.
• Project Management skills
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (preferred)
• 3 - 5 years of relevant experience
• Must be fluent in both local and English language. Strong capability with English language
(verbal and written) to allow effective communication directly with staff at R&D, suppliers
and customers (highly technical discussions)

job.title: Engineering Lead - OTA
job.description:
Description & Requirements

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

  • Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
  • Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
  • Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

 

About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Team Manager to join our Software Product Delivery group, where the focus will be on designing, developing, and leading activities related to new requirements and maintenance for our products and customers.

 

Our OTA product is recognized as one of the most advanced and proven offerings for Automotive and Mobile OEMs and suppliers. The role also involves shaping the future Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) offering and defining the migration path from legacy products to a new, advanced architecture.

 

Responsibilities include system component design, implementation, code review as well as mentoring team members and enhancing the development environment. The position requires integration of end-to-end solutions across automotive systems and operator networks, ensuring high technical quality and supporting the development of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and robust development infrastructure. The Technical Team Manager will work closely with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and Development and QA teams within the Solution Engineering organization. Your Team Report to department managers located outside of Japan.

 

What You Will Do

  • Lead Development/QA team located in Japan
  • Design/development of automotive OTA/software product/ E2E solution (Cloud/On-premises)
  • Contribute to clarify customer requirement
  • Have deep understanding in the products progression and Harman SDV offering
  • Review new architecture plans and create a migration path
  • Guide the team in adopting modern AI-driven methodologies, such as data-driven development, model-based design, and automated decision-making.
  • Embracing new technologies, running POCs and adaptation of our processes
  • Hands on coding developing customer features, to improve our product, to deeply understand technical feasibility etc.
  • Investigate and analyze technical problems and making recommendations to improve software quality
  • Team member development growth

Requirements

What You Need

  • Education: BSc. in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 3+ years of team management experience
  • 7+ years of work experience in Java programming
  • Hands-on experience with development tools like: Maven, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket or GitHub
  • Linux hands-on, networking
  • Independent, experienced in learning new environments and assembling POC quickly, experienced in working under pressure and deadlines
  • Native level Japanese
  • Business Level English skills (meeting, reporting and collaboration)

 

What is Nice to Have

  • Experience with development on Embedded OS software programming (Linux / Android / QNX)
  • Knowledge and experience in using: Spring Boot, JUnit, Cucumber
  • Experience with CI/CD related tools: Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Experience with modern web development: Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, REST API
  • Experience with scripting languages (Python, Shell, Groovy, Gradle)
  • Experience & knowledge of DB – Oracle/PostgreSQL, SQL, Elasticsearch
  • Experience with Cloud Services like AWS/Azure/GCP
  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, and applications including hands on experience (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, automation tools)

job.title: Platform Engineering Manager for Toyota
job.description:
ROLE PROFILE

 

Role Title:           Platform Engineering Manager for Toyota

 

Role Purpose:     Lead the platform engineering interface with the customer.
                                              Lead the platform engineering team.

.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead the platform engineering interface with the customer.
  2. Lead the platform engineering team or product application(s) team.
  3. Lead product application engineering across a vehicle platform, irrespective of model type or brand name, from product launch stage pre ‘Design validation’, through production and inclusive of stage ‘Mass production’.
  4. Provide full engineering support to: Product launch teams in all GKN operations involved in the launch of products for a vehicle platform (i.e. Stage ‘Design validation’); Manufacturing development teams during subsequent manufacturing change programmes (i.e. stage ‘Mass production’), including the authorisation of engineering changes.
  5. Identify the platform engineering team or product application team resource requirements and structure.
  6. Define and obtain agreement for the programme plan (targets, timing, resources, spend etc.) to implement ‘Design validation’ & ‘Muss production’ phase engineering activities and changes.
  7. Manage and deliver vehicle platform programmes in accordance with both the customer APQP and GKN’s process deliverables, activities, procedures and programme management sign off system. Includes responsibility for:-product validation/homologation approval; change request/control; prototypes & production sample builds; design FMEA (support process FMEA);deviations; standardisation; testing & report authorisation; supplier parts.
  8. Manage product selection recommendations, for approval by the account team, in accordance with GKN’s process.
  9. Ensure the delivery of data & designs to support all relevant commercial activities within the account team (e.g. new enquiry, VA/VE, process change, face-lift, product design changes).
  10. Liaise with the GKN ‘Customer Liaison’ and / or ‘Resident Engineer’.
  11. Work as and when required with GKN product and process specialists for advanced engineering discussions/proposals (phase Development), product application, product launch & problem solving (phase Design validation / Mass production).
  12. Support the performance development of Application/Design Engineers.
  13. Support other GKN activities as required.

 

Competences & experiences

  2. Vocational experience in the field of engineering within products development, products design
  3. Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
  4. Japanese language ability (essential)

  16. Capability of leading/guiding and motivating staff.
  17. Available for frequent overseas business travel.

job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
Operations:

The following duties are required at the Hiroshima Plant, which manufactures electronic components for automobiles (centre displays, speedometers, etc.).
The process (board mounting/LCD attachment/assembly/inspection) you will be responsible for will depend on your latitude and skills.

1) Design of processes/development of production methods/introduction of production equipment
2) Start-up of mass production process
3) Productivity improvement after start-up
 

Job description:

1) Process design / method development / introduction of production equipment
　1) Process design/process method development/implementation of production equipment 2) Examine processes/process methods based on design input
　P-FMEA, Control Plan preparation
　2) Planning of production equipment concepts and preparation of specifications.
　Negotiate with equipment manufacturers, place orders, manage delivery dates.
2) Start-up of mass production processes
　Production trials using new equipment.
　Preparation of work instructions and implementation of training for the production department.
3) Improve productivity after start-up
　Analysis of mass production quality issues
　Monitor and analyse production efficiency.
　Develop investment plans for improvement.
　Implement improvements involving equipment manufacturers, etc.
 

Requirements

Skills/experience required:

  • Experience of preparing for mass production in the manufacturing industry (common to all processes)
  • Experience of managing and improving board mounting lines (board mounting process)

Other experience, etc. that you would like to have if possible:

  • Experience in setting up new equipment in an automobile-related company
  • Experience in process development/design/implementation of automated lines.
  • Experience in starting up and improving processes using product inspection equipment and measuring instruments (inspection process)
  • Experience in inspection processes in an electronic components factory (inspection process)
  • Knowledge of PLC control equipment/robot operation (liquid volume attachment/assembly process)

job.title: Requirement Manager (ID) (YOK)
job.description:
Main Tasks 
• Obtain, Clarify and negotiate Automotive Requirements with Japanese Customers such as Mazda, Toyota, Suzuki, Subaru as well as 
Conti internal stakeholders (Production, Technology competence centres, logistics, etc.) 
• Consolidate Requirements for one Customer or Customer Group across ID products 
• Manage Requirements within one Project and lead a team of Analysts (Obtain, Structure, Baseline, Distribute, Clarify, Trace) 
• Discuss and understand future Requirements for Technologies and Products with Customer 

 

Detailed Tasks 
• Definition of the structure of the Requirements Documents 
• Definition, installation and operation of a Requirement Management Tool 
• Definition of the Requirements Tracing Concept. 
• Definition of the Requirements Metrics. 
• Definition of the Requirements Change Process 
• Checking and reporting the level of completeness towards the project management. 
• Monitoring of the Requirements Traceability. 
• Managing and participation in reviews to identify Requirements inconsistencies. 
• Managing the changes of Requirements. 
• Ensure that the communication with the customer follows the agreed processes 
• Identification of Requirement Stakeholders 
• Identification and Distribution of all Stakeholder Requirements, e.g. Customer Requirement Specifications, Legal Standards, 
internal Standards 
• Managing the team for Requirements Analysis. 
• Organization and participation in the Elicitation of the relevant Requirements 
• Organization and participation in the Analysis of the Requirements (analyzing, categorizing, prioritizing). 
• Ensure that the Performance Specification is in line with the customer contract. 
• Organization and participation in the documentation of the requirements in the Performance Specification

 

Requirements

 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities 
 Bachelor or Master's degree in Engineering, required 
 5+ years of progressive automotive industry experience; design & technical requirements 
 Deep knowledge of automotive technology, trends, and needs 
 Good understanding of systems engineering and subsystems for autonomous vehicles 
 Capability to analyze technical problems including Problem Solving methods (5Why,FTA) 
 Process & Tool experience on Change­, Version­ and Req. Management (CMMi, Spice) 
 Requirement Engineering with DOORS in automotive environment 
 Embedded development experience 
 Pro­activeness & respond in a timely manner to critical items 
 Understanding of the customers and user needs and problems in automotive environment 
 Planning and Organization skills 
 Excellent communication & presentation skills (English required, Japanese required)

job.title: Key Account Manager
job.description:
Our client, head quartered in Europe, is an Industrial manufacturing company which was established to handle the sales and marketing of products in the Japanese market. They make mechatronics products for various industrial segments: automotive and off-highway. Their products are well-known for their innovative suspension technology, making them a market leader with a 20% market share in Japan.

This Key Account Manager position is unique because the position has a clearly defined career path to Sales Manager and then the potential for General Manager in future.

The Key Account Manager is responsible for:

  • Acquiring new business of mechatronics products for the off-road vehicle market (construction, agriculture, material handling)
  • Ensuring that profitable sales volume and strategic objective targets are met for the assigned key accounts.

Key activities include:

  • Develop trusted long-term customer relationship with Key Accounts
  • Establish business plan and strategy to realize business growth for Key Accounts and improve profitability
  • Work with related internal teams in global basis to implement the business plan and deliver solutions to customer
  • Implement continuous product promotion, propose solutions that meet customer needs and objectives
  • Propose new product development to satisfy customer requirements, create new project
  • Lead customer events (techday, presentation, live events), Participate to trade show, exhibition, internal events
  • Deal with contact, negotiation and complaint in global basis, supervise regional sales in other countries and make decisions as Key Account Manager (after the certain period of training as regional sales)
  • Negotiate with customer head quarter for global RFQ and contracts (after the certain period of training as regional sales)

Requirements

Requirements:

  • University degree: Engineering or Business
  • At least 5 years of professional sales experience of Mechanical components or Electrical components sales for Construction, Agriculture or Automotive market
  • Strong numerical (number of sales and demand) understanding, set up target and explanation of changes for monthly update are must. It is necessary to explain in detail about update / changes in sales forecast by customers and by products in monthly basis according to the customer forecast and best estimation based on knowledge and experiences. (Necessary for budget process, monthly forecast change, 5years plan update, target objective for incentive)
  • Native level Japanese / fluent English

job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
関東地区の自動車メーカー(OEM)への当社製品 及び 開発提案によるセールス活動。

  • 顧客の全てのニーズを調査し、社内開発部門と連携した顧客への新規開発提案を行う。
  • 顧客への売込み活動を通じて、新規ビジネスを獲得し、継続した売上/利益の拡大を目指す。

  • 製品開発においては、社内コアチームへ情報提供を行い、開発から量産納入までのトータルマネジメントをリードする。

  • 海外拠点と連絡を密に行い、情報の共有化と連携の強化により、グローバルでより良いサービスを顧客に提供する。

Requirements

・ 社内関係部門と連携し積極的に業務遂行ができる方 （明るさ、活発さ、粘り強さ、協調性）

< 歓迎条件>

・ チームワークで業務を遂行されてきた方

job.title: System Engineer (HMI)
job.description:
Our engineers develop pioneering control and display systems for vehicle interiors. These are central operating elements, climate and audio panels as well as fully integrated center stacks.

Alongside precise classical mechanical solutions with keys, buttons and rotating actuators, we focus on the area of multi-touch displays.

Displays are the central interface to the user. Our technology experts are constantly on the look-out for new ideas and solutions to improve user experience even further. The focus is on comfort and safety as well as on revolutionary technologies.

New display technologies, the integration of tactile effects, acoustic feedback, innovative materials. and other exciting topics are setting the trends for the interiors of the future.

job.title: Product Technical Leader Electronic
job.description:
PRIMINARY MISSION ( RFI / RFQ/P1/P0):
Product Technical Leader Electronic is accountable for the deliverables of his network due to ensure the success of customer projects.
He is the Electronic Product INTERFACE between Customer and the Electronics Network at Project Level: Electronic Design Leader (EDL) / System Engineer (SE) located in the Development Center (DC).

Scope includes:

  • HW architecture & SW & EMC & Function Safety
  • Compliance to A-SPICE System Eng. Process
  • Specification: Responsible for Collecting/ Dispatching /Clarifying & Explaining / Negotiating Specifications
  • Change Management: Responsible for Managing Customer change request between OEM and SE & EDL
  • Customer Milestones: Responsible of Customer Milestones & Delivery linked to SW & HW

 

SECONDARY MISSION ( C.O Business & Development):
He is the Promoter of Wiper Electronic motor at Japanese OEMs ( Business and Development point of view):

  • Create and re Inforce the Customer Intimacy
  • Customer Voice into the Organization
  • Lobbying at Customer // Benchmark to share within the organization

Main responsibilities

Perimeter of mission is to address the Japanese OEMs in Japan by Promoting and explaining new technologies linked to electronic wiper motor to JPN OEM ( PRE RFQ / RFQ Phase).

During project development, responsible of the Customer Communication and Strategy along the Electronic development teams direction located in the development sites: EDL & SE.

His RESPONSIBILITY consists of the following

  • Customer Requirements & Specifications gathering and analysis– if not existing build the Customer Requirements & Specifications.=> KEY ACTIVITY
  • Clarify / Share / Explain Customer Requirements & Specifications to development team
  • Negotiate (if needed) Specification with Customer for the best interest.
  • Manage Customer Requirements & Specifications changes and traceability along A-SPICE SYST. ENG. Process
  • Insure Timing consistency between Customer Milestone & V cycle (along EDL and SE directions) to meet the Customer deadlines.
  • Translate documents necessary for development in English while only available in Japanese to share with development team.
  • Communicate to Customer about HW, SW and EMC & Function Safety matters along EDL & SE directions.
  • Insure Communication consistency with PTL Resident at Customer and PTL at DC. ( at Project Level)
  • Participating in tests with customer during development/predevelopment along Test Plan with Support of DC & Metier: participation of the Calibration of wiper system as like to Specifications (expected)


His support consist of the following:

  • Participating in Quality & Warranty pre-analysis when necessary. ( Gamba / Problem Solving / 5Whys)
  • Benchmark and competitive watch on Japanese market on Wiper System electronics. ( Product / Road Map / Market trend / at Competitors level & JOEM)
     

Requirements

Master's Degree in Electronics - System with general knowledge of HW and SW and basic knowledge of mechanics.

The Electronic System Engineer must be familiar with the following:

  • LIN network and associated Vector tools (CANoe/CANister/CANcase)
  • A-SPICE PROCESS
  • Doors -- Matlab/Simulink—( dSPACE is a plus)
  • Functional Analysis, System FMEA – FTA & Problem Solving
  • ISO 26262


Professional Experience:

  • More than 5 years of experience in design Automotive Electronic, embedded systems, transportation industry
  • More than 5 years of experience in electronic development SW & or HW.
  • Experience in a complete electronic project in automotive industry from RFQ to SOP appreciated.
  • Familiar with Worldwide organizations.


Language:

  • Japanese Fluent (Written and spoken)
  • English very good level (Written and spoken) as Clear and Synthetic Communication needed worldwide sites.
  • Chinese or French or German knowledge appreciated

job.title: System Validation Engineer
job.description:
Mission of the Role:

System Validation Engineer of Cluster (&Display) product. Support projects together with VJL and global Visteon teams (India).

Key accountabilities / How You Will Spend Your Days:

Validation Design

  • Involve in Test Script Update and work towards Automation.
  • Involve in Test procedure development for new and existing feature requirements.
  • Need to identify typical Use Case Scenarios happening in vehicle and implement those use cases in internal test procedure

Validation Execution

  • Perform Functional Black Box Testing of Cluster Features.
  • Use of tools for Testing, Defects Management, Configuration Management.
  • Work and collaborate internally within the team to deliver the Test scripts,procedures / Test Execution reports as planned.
  • Perform testing of products in an iterative, agile software lifecycle
  • Onsite Customer testing in vehicle or bench.
  • Defect Triaging and Analysis
  • Perform the reproduction testing for the issues reported by customer, triage, analyze (product behavior and debugging CAN/Ethernet log), and break down the possible root cause from requirement point of view.
  • Participate in Defect Triage meeting and demonstrate the issues identified to        Requirements & Development Teams.
  • Explanation about Visteon's Internal test procedure/result to customer together with offshore team.

Requirements

Technical Knowledge and Skills (Required):

  • Have a knowledge of Software validation or development of embedded systems, automated testing for the Automotive products and experience for more than 5 years.
  • Product level Knowledge and Requirement understanding of Cluster and Display projects or Product level Knowledge on
  • Automotive Domain products - Driver Information and\or Infotainment.
  • Understanding Customer Requirements (SPSS) / SRD documents.
  • Excellent Functional Black Box Testing Knowledge
  • Knowledge on Scripting (Python or VB \ Winwrap or CAPL or PERL)
  • Good knowledge on Network Tools – Vector CANoE / CANalyzer, Test Simulation, Measurement and Trace Debugging.
  • Knowledge on protocols – Communication (CAN, LIN) and Diagnostics Protocol (GGDS, UDS, KWP2000)
  • Knowledge on process and able to demonstrate how it has been deployed in projects worked.
  • Knowledge on Requirement Management Tools (Team Centre, Doors)
  • Knowledge on Tools for Configuration Management, Defects Management, Peer Reviews of Requirements and Test procedures.

job.title: Talent Adviser
job.description:
Serve as the strategic and operational HR leader for the site/region, owning the delivery of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, fostering a high-performance culture, ensuring compliance with legal and policy frameworks, and driving employee engagement and experience. Ensure consistent and compliant execution of HR processes in the region.

Key Objectives of this Role:

Employee Engagement, Inquiry Management & Self-Service Support

  • Respond to HR-related queries (policies, benefits, payroll, general lifecycle topics) via ticketing and case management systems.

  • Consult / Transfer unresolved or complex issues to Sr. Talent Advisors with complete documentation

  • Track and close service tickets using HR tools, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.

  • Maintain and continuously improve the HR knowledge base (FAQs, SOPs, policy docs, how-to guides).

  • Promote and educate employees on the use of self-service tools (e.g., Panorama)

HR Transactions & Administration

  • Process onboarding, offboarding, and employee lifecycle documentation; update all employee records and HRIS (e.g., changes in personal info).

  • Manage exit tasks: offboarding documentation, checklists, system deactivation, and final settlements.

  • Generate and validate employment-related documents (e.g., verification letters for visa, loan, employment proof).

  • Maintain and organize employee files (physical and digital) for easy retrieval, confidentiality, and compliance.

  • Digitize and archive physical documents as required.

Payroll, Time & Attendance, Benefits and Claims Support

  • Own T&E process alongside end-end payroll process right from input preparation, verification of data, working with payroll vendor on processing to actual disbursement

  • Should have good understanding of local laws (both employment and statutory)

  • Manage year end payroll closure, regular statutory submissions & year end tax statements

  • Guide employees through benefits enrolment and address queries about benefits, health, and retirement options.

  • Support insurance claim processing, expense reimbursements, and coordinate with external benefits providers.

  • Administer employee benefit programs end-to-end.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Manage relationships and ensure compliance with local Worker Councils (where applicable, e.g., in EU regions).

  • Facilitate and support external audits (e.g., Compliance Officer visits, IATF audits).

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date local HR documentation and regulatory permits.

  • Local Documentation & Compliance: Ensure all local HR documentation, permits, and regulatory requirements are meticulously managed and up-to-date.

Process Optimization & Service Improvement

  • Identify, recommend, and implement opportunities for process automation and standardization.

  • Suggest, test, and document new approaches to enhance service delivery and employee experience.

  • Adopt and promote HR best practices for continuous improvement.

Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with HR service vendors including contract negotiation and service agreements and performance monitoring.

  • Create and issue RFQs, track service delivery, monitor invoices, and manage follow-ups.

Operational Oversight & Advisory (Country/Site Focus):

  • Cross-functional Liaison

  • Act as the HR point of contact for regional business leaders, for site-specific people matters in collaboration with Facilities, Operations, and other teams.

  • Support people-related aspects of site emergencies, disaster response, and M&A integration.

Key Year One Deliverables:

  • Streamline inquiry handling to achieve >90% first-contact resolution rate.

  • Standardize onboarding and offboarding processes across regions/sites.

  • Develop and launch an updated knowledge base with top FAQs and guides.

  • Achieve 95%+ data accuracy rate in HRIS through audit and cleanup initiatives.

  • 100% adoption of self-service HR tools

  • Complete digitalization of 100% of legacy physical employee files.

Requirements

Qualification, Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field

  • 8 years of relevant experience preferably in regional or global environment.

  • High levels of business acumen and insight (including knowledge of various strategic, financial, and operational business models).

  • Demonstrated experience in employee engagement, ER case management, and performance management

  • Strong Communication skills (English & Japanese), conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills

  • Proficiency in HRIS tools and HR dashboards

  • Working experience HR Analytics and high proficiency on MS Excel / MS PPT / MS Word is a must.

  • Deep understanding of managing Japan payroll independently is critical alongside local employment laws and statutory and regulatory requirements.

job.title: IE Engineer
job.description:
Operations:

The following duties are required at the Hiroshima Plant, which manufactures electronic components for automobiles (centre displays, speedometers, etc.).

1) Lead and implement improvement work using IE methods.
2) Share information with the Global team
3) Manage and follow up the progress of cost improvement

 

Job description:

1) Lead and implement improvement work using IE methods.
Identification and analysis of items with large costs and improvement of efficiency using IE methods to reduce costs.
2) Information sharing to Global team
Develop and share the content of each indicator and improvement activity at the Hiroshima Plant with the Global Team.
Scrutinise the content that can be incorporated into the Hiroshima plant from the content of the Global team's activities, and plan and introduce content that is suited to the Hiroshima plant.
(3) Progress management and follow-up of cost improvements
The Hiroshima Plant will examine the content of improvements planned by each department, optimise the content, manage progress, and follow up as necessary.
 

Requirements

Skills/experience required: 

  • Knowledge of IE and experience in its use.
  • Leadership skills
  • Data analysis skills
  • Experience of improvement activities using the 5s

job.title: Appliction Engineering Manager
job.description:
Application Engineering Manager

 

Description

 

No, this isn’t one of those ordinary jobs.

 

Cummins is a team of dependable, innovative thinkers, who are empowered to generate and deliver solutions for customers, community and environment. Our employees develop their careers through the challenges only a diverse, global innovator can promise.

 

This is a collaborative culture where thinking beyond your desk is more than part of the job. It is the job.

 

This is what we call Working Right.

 

Cummins, a global power leader, is a corporation of complementary businesses that design, manufacture, distribute & service engines, fuel systems, controls, air handling, filtration, emission solutions, power generation systems and all related technologies.

 

We are committed to building partnerships with our people, our customers, our environment and our communities. We are working right.

 

Our Vision is "making people's lives better by unleashing the power of Cummins" and it is carried out by our employees around the world who give of their time, talents and resources to improve the communities in which we live and work. More than 150 Community Involvement Teams worldwide work with the Company's Corporate Responsibility Corporate Responsibility organization and senior management to strengthen our communities with a focus on education, the environment and social justice.

 

Cummins, a Fortune 150 company, has been recognized by national and international organizations for our employees and Cummins’ unique working culture such as World’s Most Ethical Companies by the Ethisphere and awarded a perfect scored in the 2013 Corporate Equality Index by the Human Rights Campaign as part of its Best Places to Work initiative.

 

This is an exciting opportunity in Tokyo for an Application Engineering Manager. Cummins Filtration in Japan is where Application Engineering Manager can Interfaces between client and internal engineering, quality and sales teams to design and deliver client solutions. Manage the development and project while demonstrating leadership within the team.

 

Applies advanced knowledge of technical engineering principles and practices in the identification and understanding of client requirements to manage the development of technical specifications, implementing designs, and delivering high performance, low-cost equipment and system solutions integrated with customers’ solutions.

 

Thinking Beyond Your Desk Includes

•    Lead communication between client and internal engineering team.

•    Identifies issues, problems, and opportunities to support continuous improvement

  initiatives.

•    Applies technical expertise on complex components or projects with minimal

  supervision.

•    Leads small projects or portions of large projects.

•    Provides technical direction for a project or a project team.

•    Participates as a key contributor and is accountable for project success.

•    Influences at department or program management level.

•    Provides input on program-related decisions.

  applications expertise on other projects.

job.title: Technical Sales Engineer - Japan, Korea (info/tele)(Nag or Yok)
job.description:
Requisition Id : Technical Sales Engineer Japan/South Korea

Multi Location Job: None 

A Career at HARMAN

We are ONE HARMAN. We are greater than the sum of our divisions or brands. We proudly talk about our many iconic brands and describe how our technologies are transforming the car, the workplace and everywhere in between.  We work hard. We create useful, playful, beautiful things. We strive for excellence and we aim to win as a team. No matter the position, every employee at HARMAN is expected to demonstrate our core competencies:  leadership, change-orientation, collaboration, judgment and a results-driven mindset.  At HARMAN, we expect brilliance.  You can expect a career full of brilliant possibilities. 

 Position Summary:

The Technical Sales Engineer (TSE) is the subject matter expert in the assigned region for the Harman Telematics Product Portfolio and related technologies. The PM will work closely with the Customer Business Units (sales) and facilitate a two-way conduit for the flow of information to ensure that customers understand Harman’s Telematics portfolio and the company’s strengths in the domain. The TSE will collect and assimilate customer and market intelligence to support the product generation process working closely with Product Management to ensure that the company’s products reflect innovative approaches to meet customer needs. The TSE will also work closely with the various CBUs to help identify, qualify and engage with new customer opportunities in both existing and new accounts. In the course of program pursuits, the TSE will act as the subject matter expert in the RFQ response process.

Job Responsibilities:

HARMAN is at the forefront of developing new in-vehicle infotainment and connectivity systems that let drivers and passengers are entertained, connected, efficient, safe and productive while in the car.  As such, our systems are leading the industry with exciting innovations in multimedia, connectivity, car-centric applications, navigation, advanced safety, and multi-modal interfaces.  This position will be an evangelist for Harman’s connected car technologies, working closely with our OEM partners, internal and customer engineering teams, and select 3rd parties to define next generation features and services.

The Technical Sales Engineer (TSE) will

  • Work closely with the Japanese and Korean Customer Business Units (Sales) as the Subject Matter Expert in Telematics technologies.

  • Establish a position of expertise that is recognized in the organization and across the industry. Utilize this strength to engage and present at industry forums.

  • Work with the assigned CBU counterparts, open new customer opportunities including RFQ pursuits in legacy and new customer accounts.

  • Identify and qualify opportunities to assemble joint Proofs of Concept (PoC) projects with customers that result in future opportunities. Work with the CBU, Product Management, Engineering and Customer Program Management to win and execute new PoC’s.

  • Engage directly with customer constituents (research, engineering, purchasing, senior decision makers) to articulate Harman’s expertise in the telematics sector. In so doing, information will be collected that supplement the knowledge base that will be used in planning the Telematics product and services portfolio.

  • As the subject matter expert, work closely with the CBU and RFQ teams to support the creation of proposals in response to RFIs, RFQ’s and RFPs for telematics solutions.

  • Work closely with customer engineering teams to understand requirements, influence the customers’ technical direction and to build confidence in Harman’s products and product delivery capabilities.

  • Communicate customer technical requirements within the Harman Product Management and Engineering organizations and interface with multiple groups within to ensure customers’ product expectations are being met.

  • Work with the Marketing and Product Management teams to create collateral that can be utilized in a f lead generation programs (trade shows, workshops, videos, white papers, etc). Assemble such programs to facilitate account penetration and an active network.

  • Create and maintain a dashboard of OEM programs in the assigned region that tracks current and upcoming telematics programs, SWOTS, decision criteria, competitive environment and other critical account information which can help guide product planning and can facilitate sales success.

  • Provide monthly program status updates via the standard template.  Represent account progress internally to senior management during program, quality and operations reviews. 

Requirements

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor degree in Electrical or Computer or Communications Systems Engineering or related field and 10 years of experience in a product management role with responsibility for advanced technology products. A Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering would be preferred.

  • A self-starter and strong team player who can successfully navigate the organization to reach the agree-upon business goal.

Must be able to distill ideas from discussions with customers, suppliers and industry participants that help the Product Management teams in their roadmap synthesis.

job.title: Principal Supplier Development Engineer Semiconductors
job.description:
Company Information:

 

ZF is a global leader in driveline and chassis technology as well as active and passive safety technology. ZF has a global workforce of approximately 138,300 at 230 locations in 40 countries. Working at ZF is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to imagine and create global mobility for tomorrow – and beyond.  Are you up for the challenge?
 

Position Description:

 

Principal Supplier Development Professional responsible for "cradle to grave" quality management of Semiconductor devices and suppliers.

 

Position Requirements:

  • Perform structured risk assessments to support Sourcing of Best in class semiconductor components for new product developments.
  • Conduct regular APQPs to minimize quality and reliability risks with new component introductions.  Utilize ZF qualification standards to qualify new components and devise safe launch plans to ensure quality in production ramp-up.
     
  • Drive structured problem solving to identify root cause of quality concerns and ensure effective corrective/preventive actions are utilized at supplier manufacturing/testing processes to avoid reoccurrence of quality incidents. 
  • Conduct audits, technical assessments, and process reviews on-site at Semiconductor and subcon locations.
     
  • Develop and maintain ZF standards for supplier manufacturing/testing/design processes based on lessons learned and best practices.  Deploy read-across of established standards throughout the supply chain and with internal procedures.
     
  • Drive and monitor continuous improvement projects with key semiconductor suppliers to improve quality performance key performance indicators.
     
  • Support internal Knowledge Management program by developing and teaching courses in your area of process/technology expertise.  
  • Work with Core Development, Purchasing, and Advanced Technology teams to ensure challenges for future component technologies and roadmaps are met in our Supplier Development programs. 
  • Support our change management process to properly risk-assess and qualify any changes proposed by our semiconductor suppliers.

Requirements

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Sciences or Engineering.  Advanced degrees preferred.
  • Minimum 8-15 years of Direct work Experience in semiconductor manufacturing/testing/Quality.
  • High proficiency in use of Quality tools/methods (Six Sigma DMAIC/DFSS).
  • Excellent communication skills both in verbal/written with high proficiency in English.
  • Excellent Analytical skills required.  Excellent leadership skills in leading Globally distributed team of internal and external partners.
  • Position requires approximately 50% Regional/international travel to ZF and Supplier locations.

job.title: Application Engineer (Nagoya, Aichi)

ROLE PROFILE

 

Role Title:           Application Engineer for TOYATA

 

Role Purpose:         Deliver application engineering requirements for customer release.

 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead the application engineering tasks for the customer platform.
  2. Review customer requirements/specifications and initiate /conduct feasibility studies.
  3. Create customer programme requirements and the product listing proposal for all global locations.
  4. Prepare the assembly design package for initial review for all global locations.
  5. Manage all relevant application engineering tasks/activities in accordance with the customer APQP and GKN’s programme management system deliverables (including pre ‘Design validation’ through stage ‘Design validation’ and inclusive of stage ‘Mass product’) within the framework of GKN’s programme management sign-off system for global applications.
  6. Lead the technical response (approval) for the stage ‘Mass product’ change management process.
  7. Perform the engineering calculations for joint sizing and make proposals on the joint type. Validate and approve the product performance at each stage of development in accordance with the customer and GKN specifications for all global applications.
  8. Obtain boot development source approval and approve the developed product for local customer release launch. Communicate and coordinate this with other transplant applications.
  9. Manage and support the creation and update of the assembly DFMEA. Communicate and coordinate this with other transplant applications.
  10. Lead internal design reviews and the assembly drawing approval for the local customer release launch. Communicate and coordinate this with other transplant applications.
  11. Lead supplier design reviews (DFM and DFA) for local customer release launch. Communicate and coordinate this with other transplant locations.
  12. Lead prototype and pre-production sample build reviews for local customer release launch.
  13. Authorise the release of the pre-production parts list and structures on the business system for local customer release launch. 
  14. Initiate prototype requests and initial tooling authorisation and release to local product launch centres.
  15. Prepare test specifications and the test development plan (DVP&R) for customer release.  Approve the Liaison Application Engineer test reports prior to issuing to the Customer for all global applications.
  16. Support financial assessments and cost analysis.
  17. Co-ordinate the PPAP package preparation with product launch operations through the appropriate Application Liaison Engineers and Product Launch Managers.
  18. Support the performance development of the Liaison Application Engineers in the team.
  19. Support other DL activities as required.
  20. Adopt a total quality philosophy by: seeking opportunities for continuous improvement; eliminating waste; communicating effectively; striving to exceed the internal and external customers’ expectations.

 

Competences & experiences

  1. University Degree / Technical College with main focus on Mechanical Engineering
  2. Vocational experience in the field of engineering within products development, products design
  3. Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
  4. Japanese language ability (essential)
  5. Extensive experience in the field of automotive engineering, possibly powertrain
  6. Knowledge of plant related manufacturing processes and technologies
  7. Command of TQC and TPM philosophy
  8. Sound knowledge for technology and innovation development
  9. Standard level of IT/computer literacy is required
  10. Knowledge / experience of Japanese work environment (essential)
  11. Ability to successfully implement change in a multi-cultural environment.
  12. Capability to conduct/take part in discussions and negotiations on standard level
  13. Ability to report clearly on staff level
  14. Dynamic personality/ capability of taking initiative/ innovative thinking and motivation as well as enthusiasm for problem and conflict (potential and actual) solving tasks
  15. Decision taking and ability to cope with stress.

job.title: IND-Injection Process Engineer (THS)(SAR210002LP)

SOPまで、新しいプラスチック部品、金型、およびプロセスのエンジニアリングを管理します。
Define and implement improvements in materials, designs and processes resulting in measurable improvement of quality, costs and delivery.
材料、設計、およびプロセスの改善を定義および実装して、品質、コスト、および納期の測定可能な改善をもたらします。

Responsibilities
責任 General: 一般：
1. Maintain quality standards on all products to ensure manufacturing with zero defect methodology
including process documentation required.
1.すべての製品の品質基準を維持して、必要なプロセス文書を含む欠陥ゼロの方法論で製造を保証します。

2. Responsible for plastic part engineering according to the specifications in order to meet
the requirement of quality, cost and delivery time for local and global platform (worldwide coordination of mold concept).
2.ローカルおよびグローバルプラットフォームの品質、コスト、納期の要件を満たすために、仕様に従ってプラスチック部
品エンジニアリングを担当します（金型コンセプトの世界的な調整）。

3. Provide support on new product launch tooling
and process at each milestone through production, providing the manufacturing and engineering inputs for development
of new process, parts and tooling.
3.生産を通じて各マイルストーンで新製品の発売ツールとプロセスのサポートを提供し、新しいプロセス、部品、およびツールの開発のための製造とエンジニアリングの入力を提供します。
4. Lead the　tooling design and approval process according to the Valeo standards & Procedure (RAISE).
4.ヴァレオの基準と手順（RAISE）に従って、工具の設計と承認のプロセスを主導します。

5. Identify lean & continuous improvement to existing
process and tooling related to current product lines with regard to the cost, quality, and/or design.
5.コスト、品質、および/または設計に関して、現在の製品ラインに関連する既存のプロセスおよびツールに対する無駄のない継続的な改
善を特定します。

6. Involve in a global coordination to improve and define standards. Identify and investigate potential
new tooling concepts and processes.
6.標準を改善および定義するために、グローバルな調整に関与します。潜在的な新しいツールの概念とプロセスを特定して調査します。
7. Apply in his field safety procedure and have a role model
in safety rule appliance.
7.彼の現場の安全手順に適用し、安全規則アプライアンスのロールモデルを持っています。

Essential: 必須：
1. Design for manufacturing a plastic part, mold and process according to Valeo Production System &
TPM rules.
1. Valeo Production SystemおよびTPMの規則に従って、プラスチック部品、金型、およびプロセスを製造するための設計。

2. Analyze new product in order to integrate new components and P2.
2.新しいコンポーネントとP2を統合するために、新製品を分析します。

3. Support R&D CAD designer about plastic part engineering.
3.プラスチック部品エンジニアリングに関するR＆DCAD設計者をサポートします。

4. Involve in Molding FMEA, SPPC definition and tolerances application.
4.成形FMEA、SPPC定義、および公差アプリケーションに関与します。

5. Investigate design to cost solutions, identify improvement on part to simplify the machining of tool, optimize molding conditions and reduce cost.
5.設計を調査してコストソリューションを作成し、部品の改善点を特定して工具の機械加工を簡素化し、成形条件を最
適化し、コストを削減します。

6. Define mold features, size and injection molding machine.
6.金型の特徴、サイズ、射出成形機を定義します。

7. Establish request for quotation with preliminary mold design, with tool cost & timing estimation.
7.予備の金型設計、工具費とタイミングの見積もりを使用して、見積依頼を確立します。

8. Validate 3D molds design for layout and mold studies acceptance.
8.レイアウトおよび金型研究の受け入れのために3D金型設計を検証します。

9.Analyze Moldflow simulation results, implement solution in new mold, and define molding process window.
9.モールドフローシミュレーション結果を分析し、新しい金型にソリューションを実装し、成形プロセスウィンドウを定義します。

10. Manage the technical part and mold tuning loops from Off Tool to Initial samples, manage the molding tryouts, define
& duplicate the process window to ensure reliable and robust part validation & robust production.
10.オフツールから初期サンプルまでの技術部品と金型調整ループを管理し、成形トライアウトを管理し、プロセスウィンドウを定義および複
製して、信頼性が高く堅牢な部品検証と堅牢な生産を確保します。

11. Support tooling transfer and Start of Production at
Valeo or supplier; Establish technical & maintenance book.
11.ヴァレオまたはサプライヤーでの工具の移動と生産開始を
サポートします。技術とメンテナンスの本を作成します。

12. Evaluate toolmaker (current or new) and teach toolmaker
about Valeo standards.
12.ツールメーカー（現在または新規）を評価し、ツールメーカーにヴァレオの基準について教えます。

13. Capitalize feedback from production and supplier to initiate corrective and preventive actions (cost breakdown,
problem solving, troubleshooting...).
13.生産およびサプライヤーからのフィードバックを活用して、是正措置および予防措置（コストの内訳、問題解決、トラブルシューティングなど）を開始します。

Requirements

Engineer degree or advanced technician in plastic engineering

job.title: Senior Project Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a global Tier 1 specializing in technology enabling ADAS/AD system applications. Their core technologies are converging to become integral components in connected cars and future mobility systems.

Overview:

  • This is a mechanical engineering related position, handling plastic injection molded components as part of the ADAS systems.
  • This position is responsible for meeting the technical requirements of the customers and facilitating smooth technical communication between the customers and  development team to promote mass production development.

Role:

  • Bilingual - native Japanese/English required. (TOEIC 750 or higher.)

  • Global travel as required to support Sales and Engineering activities and customer communication.

job.title: Project Manager (Telematics)
job.description:
Our client is an automotive supplier and partner to automakers worldwide. They design innovative solutions for smart mobility, with a particular focus on intuitive driving and reducing emissions. 

In Japan, our client has one of the strongest footprints comprising R&D centers and plants. Connected Car is a fast growing area.

They are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager for the Telematics team who will have project accountability local and global colleagues on a large scale.

Overview:
In the Telematics Project Management team, the Project Manager has overall responsibility of the project accomplishment (QCT of the deliverables).

This is to ensure Project performance objectives are achieved (Customer satisfaction, Product, Quality, Cost, Profitability, Delivery and Schedule)

Responsibilities:

  • Manage OEM Projects (Component, System with known technology components, …)
  • Is responsible for the achievement of the Project KPI in terms of profitability (both product/development vs Development Activity Payback and Extended Margin), Quality and Production Preparation
  • Secure Project resources and control them
  • Solve all project issues requiring any type of support of all suitable functions via the Project Escalation
  • Check and validate Project Team Members’ activities and proposes timing scenario to achieve milestones
  • Define and manage the budget
  • Define scope of projects
  • Prepare decision making process for relevant committee and challenge the project team readiness
  • Prepare and submit business cases and investment plans (Project/System level) and challenge the Technical Project Managers or Launch Managers of the Projects
  • Manage all project changes (internal and customer) and coordinates through his team
  • Lead appraisals and development of team members
  • Is functionally responsible of all project team members, set project objectives, ensure appraisal
  • Manage communication with Customers on Project development progress, taking ownership on all matters.

Requirements

  • Education: Degree Engineering Software, computer science
  • Over 5 years experience with the Product Development process / V cycle knowledge and practice
  • Over 3 years project management experience, including from development to SOP.
  • Knowledge in embedded system and software development 
  • Embedded system product project management including validation
  • Telematics field experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of vehicle standard protocols (CAN, LIN, UART, SPI)
  • Experience with a system engineering view (requirement analysis, validation process, DOORS, Functional safety)

job.title: Facility Manager
job.description:
職務内容:

  • 生産ラインとプラントに必要なエネルギー利用を確保します。

  • 建物と付帯設備のメンテナンスと更新を確保にします。

  • 新しい工場（含む、施設関連）の見積、仕様、工事をサポートします。

 

施設のメンテナンスのすべての側面で安全規則が完全に適用されていることを確保します。

生産ラインとプラントに必要なエネルギー利用を確保します。

  • すべてのエネルギーネットワークの支障がないよう監視します。 （電気、工場エア、水、排気など）

  • エネルギーネットワークの場合、サプライヤーと必要なすべての保守契約を確立します。

  • エネルギー消費を削減するための新しい方法/設備を見つけ出します。

  • エネルギー消費と予算を管理します。

  • 生産エリアにエネルギーを割り当てます。

  • 来年/年のエネルギー予算を準備します。

 

建物と付帯設備のメンテナンスと更新を確保にします。

  • 建物の内外で会社のビジュアル的な基準の均一性を維持します。

  • 建築基準法、及び消防法に則った建物、付帯設備（含一部の消防設備）の維持管理、更新を実行します。

  • 冷却/加熱/フレッシュエアシステムの完全な作動に監視します。

  • あらゆる面（飲用、排水、雨水）での水の取り扱いを管理します。

  • O空調、フレッシュエア、およびすべての水などのシステムを維持し、サプライヤーと必要な保守契約を確立します。

  • 来年/年の予算を準備し、実行に移します。 （水、設備などのメンテナンス、更新）

  • すべてのメンテナンスサプライヤーとの年次契約交渉に参画します。

 

新しい工場（含、施設関連）の見積、仕様、工事をサポートします。

  • 購買部門とのユーティリティおよび大型機器の保守契約の再交渉に参加します。

  • 新しい見積の仕様書を作成します。

  • サプライヤーのオファーとデータに基づくサプライヤーの選定サポートします。

  • 施設関連プロジェクトに参画します。

 

施設に関わるマネジメントシステムに沿った活動推進と管理を行います。

  • IATF16949におけるインフラ整備を軸とした管理を行います。

  • ISO140001、ISO50001における省エネを軸とした管理を行います。

  • ISO450001における施設の係る安全作業を軸とした管理を行います。

  •  HSSEのリクアイアメントに沿った環境、安全の管理を行います。

（例、THS Cap50 活動、カーボンニュートラル）

Requirements

応募資格:

施設スタッフの労務管理を行います。

募集条件（Updated）

１）工場での施設管理の経験者

２）施設管理のマネージャー経験者

３）英語は仕事で必要になる事を前提条件として受け入れらる方
