job.title: Material Control Leader
job.description:
【メッセージ】
“Connectivity(接続)”ということがあらゆる分野で重要性を増しています。 自動車の分野においても、多様な機器の間を電気的に接続し、様々な情報や信号、エネルギーをやりとりすることにより、自動運転や電動化等の飛躍的な進歩が進もうとしています。 このような接続技術の中心的役割を担う電子部品として、我々の主力製品である“コネクタ”があります。 高速伝送、大電力伝送、小型高密度化など、その進化は止まりません。

SCM組織の強化に伴い、チームを再編し、当ポジションは、Material Control Leaderとして、主に生産管理、在庫管理、SCM業務にフォーカスする部門をリードして頂きます。

【仕事内容】
原材料/部品/製品に関するSCM業務（生産計画/調達業務/在庫管理）全般をManage頂きます。
1. 顧客Demand及びForecastの分析と適正なる生産計画/調達計画の戦略立案と実行
2. 生産計画/調達計画に即した的確な発注業務の実施と納入管理の実践
3. 適正在庫（Inventory Healthの向上）確立に向けた在庫管理業務
4. 各国内のSuppliers及び材料Makersとの折衝/Timelyなる調達の実践/Supply Chain強化
5. 納期遵守率の改善と未納Orderの撲滅/Sales部門との協業に依る顧客納期管理
6. ManagementsへのKPI報告及び協議 / SCM Strategy策定への参画 7.Supplier Consolidationの企画/立案/遂行（Japan-ASEAN Operation戦略の遂行）
※主に弊社協力工場及び弊社海外工場におけるSCM業務のManagementをご担当頂きます。

Requirements

【応募資格】
・ 学歴：大卒以上（類似の実務経験があれば高卒でも可）
・ 語学：日本語 - 母国語レベル（ビジネス対話および資料作成が可能なこと）
　　　　　英語 - 中高級程度（目安TOEIC700点程度、または、相応の実力）
　　　　　※英語での読み書き及びPresentationが行える方
・ PCスキル：Microsoft Office〔EXCEL、Word、Power Point〕必須）

【業務経験】
<必須条件>
・製造業でTeam LeaderとしてPeople Managementをご経験の方
・生産計画/生産管理業務経験（Supply Chain Management）
・ERP SCMモジュール経験（SAP MM/PP等歓迎）
・市場の変化や問題に対しても積極果敢且つFlexibleに業務に取り組み、また強くLeadershipを発揮頂ける方を希望しております。

<歓迎条件>
・製造業関連工場での経験
・電子部品業界での経験
・中国、東南アジアの海外工場担当者との調整、折衝経験
・英語でのコミュニケーションに抵抗のない方。(for Global meeting)
・Excel/PowerPointなどのオフィスツールを問題無く使用出来る方

job.title: Product Group Customer Manager (ADAS)
job.description:
Mission:

  • Define on a worldwide basis the Sales Product Group strategy for the customer in charge and ensure deployment in Regions/Product Lines.
  • Ensure achievement of Product Group sales performance for the customer in charge in line with agreed targets
  • Promote appropriate innovative products, modules and systems

Responsibilities:

Define on a worldwide basis the Sales Product Group strategy for the customer in charge and ensure deployment in Regions/Product Lines

  • Drive specific product interests from the customer, follow-up and translate into business.
  • Maintain and develop deep understanding of the company’s competitive advantages to select strategic projects, appropriate innovative products, modules and systems
  • Organize roadmaps exchange in order to define the Product Group vision for the customer.
  • Define the strategic projects to be acquired in close collaboration with the Regions/Product lines.
  • Coordinate all the Regions/product lines strategies and activities related to the customer in charge.

Business intelligence and information sharing

  • Identify decision making actors and rules on customer side, gather and share all useful information with concerned
  • Regions/Product Lines and functional networks (ex. R&D, Industrial, Quality, Project Management).
  • Develop an intimate relationship with key decision makers in customers’ purchasing, engineering and marketing organizations at senior level.
  • Be the customer’s central contact for information concerning the organization, key persons, new vehicle launches, production plans, etc, of the customers and communicates this information to Regions/ Product lines
  • Competition intelligence in full compliance including market share monitoring.

Ensure achievement of Product Group sales performance for the customer in charge in line with agreed targets

  • Be the preferred interface between the customer and the Product Group.
  • Be responsible for consistency of selling prices worldwide.
  • Drive globally the NPA, propose the sales strategy and participate in the CAA process.
  • Drive global negotiations with the Customer: business acquisition; annual productivity, market effects (currency, raw material,...), claims, overdues, warranty...
  • Tailor the sales messages based on a customer’s business and individual attributes
  • Take control in guiding the customer to a recommended action by discussion alternatives and reinforcing the value of making a change
  • Manage communication in crisis, protecting customer’s relationship
  • Coordinate important customer visits.

Promote appropriate innovative products, modules and systems

  • Coordinate and organize lobbying activity and manage global RFI/RFQ’s
  • Contribute to/Initiate Innovation Tech Days in co-operation with Product Marketing and R&D.

Lead the Product Group interfacing with the customer

  • Drive the Customer Development Plan (CDP) process, the Mid Term Plan (MTP) and propose the sales budget for customers in the Product Group.

job.title: Autonomy Release Engineer II
job.description:
Job Title: Autonomy Release Engineer II
Work Style: Hybrid
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create
a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May
develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative
Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the
way AVs think.
Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to
communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to
go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best
autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding
access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant
and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 300,000
autonomy-enabled rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just
getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the
future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their
work. Join us.

Job Summary
May’s Lead Engineers are front line problem solvers that get things done.
May’s engineers have the initiative, experience, and technical skill to be able
to solve problems delegated to them with little oversight. Confidence backed
by firm engineering talent and knowledge of complex systems is a must.
As a Release Autonomy Engineer located at one of our Japan sites, you will
enable the successful deployment of solutions to challenging and complex
problems facing vehicle autonomy. You will support the deployment of May

autonomy systems and track down and solve the release’s most difficult
issues.
Release Autonomy Engineers are extremely cross-functional and must be
able to frequently adapt their roles between various areas of autonomy AND
various areas outside of autonomy. They straddle the line between the
Autonomy software developers and the broader issues of Deployment,
Product, company milestones and schedules. They MUST be ready to operate
within environments that often lack formal processes and they must be ready
to connect the dots between technical- and non-technical organizations.
Release Autonomy Engineers absolutely must identify key issues and drive
problems to solution. This often includes critically thinking through chaotic
situations spanning multiple organizations, schedules, and stakeholders.
From a technical standpoint, Release Autonomy engineers are responsible for
the integrated functioning of the autonomy software release. Engineers
interact with sensor hardware, middleware, autonomy software stack,
networking, health monitoring, compute platforms and electronic systems.
They drive forward architectural design and hardware/software design
through collaboration across other engineering groups. Additionally, release
engineers take feedback from sites, customers, riders, and turn that into
metrics/instrumentation/tools to evaluate that the autonomy system is
functioning and improving in a way that matters to the user. You will be a
go-to person for understanding how releases come together, be an active
participant in troubleshooting merge/CI issues as well as a generalized
understanding to dive into system integration issues found during release
testing.

Essential Responsibilities
● Take initiative to understand every aspect of the May vehicle
architecture - hardware, software, networking, configurations - all of it.
● Take initiative to find and permanently solve challenging system level
issues caused by the interplay between different software and
hardware components.
● Troubleshoot and support solutions to challenging field issues.
● Collaborate and lead system-wide improvements when working with
other teams without having direct ownership or management
responsibility.
● Design, build, and maintain the May autonomy system architecture and
cross functional autonomy components.
● Assess and develop approaches that improve performance in a variety
of ways (e.g. CPU performance, memory usage, disk usage, network
usage).
● Assess and improve system robustness to systematic stochastic and
transient issues that impact autonomous vehicle performance.
● Support other autonomy engineers in designing and integrating their
components with the full May system.
● Management of software branch updates to existing software releases
● Curation of hotfixes and patches to ensure proper maintenance of
deployed software at our sites
● Curation and execution of simulation suites and results to track
performance across software releases to understand current
performance capabilities and limitations between deployed releases as
well as proposed updates
● Appreciation for production quality software - We are a product
company - not a research lab!

Qualifications and Experience
Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following
qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:
Required
● Minimum of 1 year of experience in autonomous robotics system
engineering with a broad focus across multiple aspects of autonomous
robot components
● Experience successfully navigating uncertainty and bringing
stakeholders from different organizations together to form alignments
when stakeholders objectives are at odds with each other
● Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer
Engineering, Electrical Engineering or an applied engineering field.
● Experience ‘managing up’
● Strong communication skills in both English and Japanese
● Experience using analysis to form a conclusion with argumentation on
critical technical issues AS WELL AS communicating this to stakeholders
at different technical and management levels
● Strong programming skills in C/C++
● Experience taking components and systems through the full product
lifecycle.
● Demonstrated strong troubleshooting and analytic skills at the system
and subsystem level.
● Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and clearly about
complex system behaviors, structures, and issues.
● Drive to “see for yourself”
Desirable
● 5+ years of experience in autonomous robotic systems
● Experience managing software (branches / versions / deployments)

● Experience with autonomous cars, trucks, or similar vehicles.
● A masters or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer
Engineering, Electrical Engineering or an applied engineering field.
● Previous experience in a startup or high performance research and
development group delivering a product
● Project management experience
● License to drive on public roads in Japan

Physical Requirements
● Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to:
○ Prolonged sitting
○ Prolonged standing
○ Prolonged computer use
Travel required? - Moderate: 11%-25%

job.title: Purchasing Director
job.description:
Purchasing Director covering: Japan, Thailand, Indonesia for a top global Tier Automotive supplier

  • Essential responsibilities and duties
    • The Purchasing Director is responsible for the purchase functions development within a Country / Region.
    • Overall responsibility and accountability for the Purchasing Function which will include people and budgetary management. Integral part of the senior management team or board which determines overall strategy and business decisions.
  • The main missions of the role are:
  • Strategy and Development
    • Create and implement best practice purchasing vision, strategy, policies, processes and procedures to aid and improve business performance
    • Ensure that purchasing strategies and processes are in place to meet business objectives and operational needs in terms of price, quality and delivery targets
    • Evaluate the challenges faced by the business and take actions to mitigate risks and develop opportunities
    • Contribute to overall business strategy and annual budget process
    • Take ownership of the purchasing policy, guidelines and any associated documents
    • Support commodity to negotiate with key suppliers at a senior and strategic level
    • Support commodity to negotiations with key suppliers to ensure value for money, quality standards and delivery terms with technical and operational input from stakeholders if appropriate
    • Forecast price and market trends
  • People Management
    • Provide leadership to departments under control. Coach, mentor and develop direct reports and manage a high performing team that delivers continuous improvement, added value and cost reductions
    • Set department objectives and monitor ongoing progress and performance
    • Ensure strong communication between teams under leadership to facilitate exchange of information and in order to implement change and improvements
    • Responsible for developing the appropriate organisational structure, resource plans and culture to support the business objectives and customer deliverables
  • Financial Budget and Control
    • Prepare the annual Purchasing budget and forecasts and all Capital Expenditure proposals as well as ensuring compliance with customer and legal requirements. Manage the budget from identification to completion of projects
    • Relationship Management
    • Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance
    • Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on supply. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimising cost
    • Contribute to new business initiatives and projects and review and communicate the impact on Purchasing activities
  • Environmental
    • Review environmental strategies that impact on future ways of operating and ensure implementation where possible • Review the use of technological systems that support a more environmentally friendly approach
    • Review opportunities to be as environmentally friendly as possible

Requirements

  • Qualifications
    • Engineering Degree (Mechanical / Electronics, Production) / Master degree and advantage
  • Experience:
    • 10-15 years of experience in purchasing with big organization set up with matrix reporting relationship
  • Skills and Attributes
    • Strategic mindset
    • Managing complexity
    • Managing ambiguity
    • Building effective teams

job.title: Customer Program Management
job.description:
Overview:

The Customer Program Manager leads the cross-functional team to develop and launch product and services

Activities:

Responsible for development and launch of a compelling product that meets internal/external customer requirements and promotes customer satisfaction.

To deliver the product in accordance with development milestones into stable production and to meet operating profit over program life. 

Specifics:

  • Manage customer interface and direct customer communication strategy with Japan OEMs. Ensure assignments from Japan OEMs are well understood, distributed to core teams, and reasonable for Harman success.
  • Build and manage customer relationships.
  • Work with customer interface teams to manage issues.
  • Represent product engineering team in new business opportunities by interfacing with core team /customer / sales. Drive business case inputs and product engineering engagement on new technologies.
  • Build and maintain a customer interface team – responsible to manage the customer from the entry-level to the senior-level. Evaluate and develop team members.
  • Serve as internal expert on Japan OEM development processes.
  • Analyze and negotiate program schedules with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure product costing targets are achieved for each product. Maintain records of BOM costs compared to targets; escalate within Harman when targets are not achieved. Ensure design actions are implemented to recover any cost variance in BOM cost target.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering best practices / processes and facilitate creation of new best practices as appropriate.
  • Own and maintain the resource budget and cost of external resources.
  • Ensure engineering teams have equipment and facilities needed to meet customer requirements. This includes budget as well as acquisition.
  • Back up engineering colleagues in Japan Office and program management team as appropriate.
  • Oversee decisions regarding product content, budget and timing to ensure the product is on-time, on-schedule, on-quality, and meets all customer acceptance criteria (Performance and Features).
  • Manage product risk proactively, identify engineering risks and coordinate meetings with the PM and multi-discipline functions to address risks before they become issues.
  • Evaluate engineering processes and metrics to track and measure engineering success. Update processes where needed to address customer-specific requirements. Ensure all engineering disciplines are designing per Harman processes and customer processes.
  • Ensure customer requirements are communicated throughout Harman engineering teams. Ensure customer requirements are met with the product designed. Manage customer interface teams to clarify requirements when needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science in a technical field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5 years product development and/or program management experience with specific experience in at least one area of technical specialization, such as: software, hardware, telematics or electronic manufacturing, preferably in an automotive application.
  • Developed and launched at least 1 product through the lifecycle from business commitment through stable production.
  • Expected general skills includes, but not limited to, cross functional team leadership, arbitrate technical tradeoffs, problem solving, negotiation, P&L understanding and communication skills
  • Fluent in English and Japanese (written and verbal)
     
  • What Is Nice To Have
     
    • Masters of Science, Technical or MBA
    • PMP Certification
    • Automotive supplier, Tier1 Electronics background
    • Direct experience with applicable customer

Perform the Quality Assurance relative to System and Software Engineering activities in the project
-Identify and track corresponding risks in the project
-Enable the R&D to develop a quality product

Control and monitor the conformity to the GSMART process

Support the Customer interface for System & Software Quality matters in development for the assigned projects in the Product Group / Site


Responsibilities:
-Create the project quality assurance plan for system and software in collaboration with the SYS & SW Product Quality Engineer and the Q-PTM.
-Has the authority to approve process tailoring vs. GSMART Part 1 and Part 2 within the scope of System and Software activities.
-Check that project is compliant with the Group Golden Rules and assess the status of the corresponding action plan.
-Is part of inspectors for “Quality” checks in the Technical reviews. Attend the Technical Reviews as a moderator.
-Conduct Work product quality checks according to the GSMART Process.
-Check the Software releases and approve the de-standardization as needed.
-Conduct Process compliance audits vs. GSMART part 1 and part 2.
-Prepare and align internal organization assessments (GAMA) with the Quality Assessor (C).
-Prepare the OEM project assessments (ASPICE) and facilitate self-assessments with the project teams .
-Reports an accurate status of projects to the Product Line Management, to Quality (incl. Q-PTM) and to GEEDS based on standardized reports. Owns the Quality section of the Project dashboard.
-Has the authority to escalate issues through the project Red Box, PMC and the Group Red Alert procedure.
-Prepare and support customer communication about System and Software Process compliance.
-Identify Lessons Learned and Best Practices and feed the Process Improvement organization with them.
-Ensure the Change Control Boards are performed according to the defined process.
-Manage Assessments and Audits of external SW suppliers.
-Prepare the Software Milestone Reviews.

Requirements

MUST
-Engineering degree
-2- 3 years in Engineering Quality Assurance activities
-Experience in the Software Quality Assurance / Software Development

　
Good to have;
-Master degree in Electronics / Software
-Experience in embedded SW/SYS development in automotive experience
-Experience with the software development process, systems engineering methodologies, and test techniques

job.title: Product Technical Manager (ADAS)
job.description:
Mission：

  • Product Technical Manager is accountable for the deliverables of R&D due to ensure the success of the project
  • He/She is responsible for the detailed scheduling and budgeting of R&D activities, with support of department managers.
  • Product Technical leader is empowered by R&D Manager to manage his/her Contributors.

Responsibilities：
Accountable for the deliverables:

  • Apply the specific PDP of his/her PG/PL following CPM (CLEAN Project Management)
  • In charge of the robust design in line with the economical targets
  • Applies Standardization rules, exceptionally will request de-standardizations based on sound justifications
  • Call for all necessary design reviews
  • Make sure that Design Reviews of other networks are happening in a timely manner (Purchase, Industrial)
  • Represent the R&D function at the customer
  • Interface with the customer for the R&D subjects of the project, break down and cascade internally customer requests and needs
  • Report and escalate to his project manager or R&D manager as needed

Responsible for the detailed scheduling and budgeting

  • Contribute to the identification of the needs in terms of resources, equipments, investments
  • Establish detail break down of the activities to meet the milestones
  • Follow activities and spending of his scope to meet his allowed budget

Management of the contributors

  • Daily management of all R&D contributors, dedicated or not
  • Assign to them the work packages needed
  • Regular review with his/her R&D manager or Product Manager and the Department Managers to check alignment between needs and availabilities

Requirements

Education/Training:

  • A relevant Technical Engineering Degree e.g. Electronic Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, etc
  • Japanese: native
  • English: intermediate

Professional Experience:

  • Experience in R&D development activities
  • 3 to 20 years according to Manager and/or Leader

Key Competences:

  • Product knowledge ：Skilled
  • Oral and written Communication ：Skilled
  • Leadership ：Skilled
  • Budget and Value Management ：Autonomous
  • People management ：Skilled
  • Customer focus ：Skilled

job.title: Customer Software Technical Project Manager (Sensors)
job.description:
Mission：
The Customer Software Technical Project Manager is responsible for managing the planning and technical activities of the software development from the design phase till the complete integration, validation & start of production of the projects, and is the main window person with the customer for all related SW topics.

Responsibilities：


Methodology：

  • Contributes to the definition of the software methodology in accordance with R&D Operations Manager.
  • Ensures the correctness and the execution of the technical design reviews on his projects.

Management：

  • Manage the resources of his projects (status progress, tasks, …)
  • Validates and optimizes the workload plan for his projects.
  • Drives the weekly meeting of his team.
  • Ensure the communication with the customer on all SW related topics, from requirements until final SW delivery.

Technical Management：

  • Contributes to identification of the required standard bricks in accordance with SW Manager.
  • Contributes to identification of the required standard tools in accordance with SW Manager.
  • Contributes to the capitalizations and the required evolutions to improve the development processes.
  • Contributes to identification of the required make or buy strategy in accordance with SW Manager.
  • Manage the SW Planning and action plan.
  • Manage the change management of his project and prepare the SwCCB
  • Manage the Requirement Management
  • Ensures the correctness of application of the standards.


Budget Management：

  • Defines the budget for his projects.
  • Follows up and tracks the budget and updates the 3 months forecast view of his projects.
  • Contributes to the R&D efficiency plan of his project in accordance with SW Team Leader.

Reporting and Meeting participation：

  • Reports progresses, technical reviews and issues of his project to Operations Manager and System PM.
  • Attends the daily meeting with Operations Manager and System PM.
  • Support the System PM in project reviews when needed.
  • Participates in review meetings when needed.

Requirements

  • Engineering degree in “Embedded Real time” SW developments
  • Langage C
  • MBD
  • Architecture Temps reel OSEK , AutoSAR
  • 5 to 10 years in Embedded SW developments and associated testing.
  • English and Japanese: more than business level

job.title: ADAS Software Project Manager
job.description:
Scope:
The Software Project Manager (SW PM) is end to end responsible for all software deliverables of the project. He/she leads the software core team and represents the SW project towards the IPT team and the customer. The SW PM leads the SW project (incl. Sensorics software) from planning to integration until final validation. He/she assures that the SW project is run according to the valid development processes.

Main Activities
Plans and tracks all software deliveries and related activities together with the SW core team members according to customer/internal milestones, required scope and quality (incl. 3rd party software components).
Manages and drives the software team to achieve the project goals in terms of scope, timing and quality.
Assures that the SW project is run according to the valid development processes (Stages, SPICE, ISO26262)
Leads software relevant requirements engineering from initial analysis through test execution.
Leads overall software relevant IMS issue resolution (incl. Sensorics software topics) covering planning, monitoring, driving closure and ensuring successful on time execution.
Monitors and reports status within the project team and towards SW Line Management. Drives on time execution of the SW project.
Plans and performs SW releases and SW milestones including all necessary activities, release documentation and reviews required for final release approval by the SW Release Director.

Requirements

Necessary Items
1. Study Engineering at college/university or have an equivalent knowledge.
2. 3 years or more experience in defining requirements and specification Experience in automotive industry is preferable.
3. Conversation in Japanese language, Reading and writing in English. Basic conversation in English
Preferable items
1. Experience of simulation tool (Matlab)
2. Experience of Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer)
3. Experience in development of software (C, C++)

The Autonomous Mobility and Safety Business Area integrates safety technologies and controls vehicle dynamics to ensure safe and comfortable driving. The objective is to implement "Vision Zero", the vision of accident-free driving. Autonomous Mobility and Safety's components and system capabilities are prerequisites for autonomous mobility.

job.title: NLP R&D Manager

The candidate will manage a team of NLU developers. The team’s purpose will be to develop NLU tools and models for for the leading JOEMs.  They will work closely with project teams to analyze customer requirements and localize NLU models.

Role and responsibilities:

  • Mange team of NLU Specialists.
  • Analysis of customer requirements for realizing NLU on embedded platforms.
  • Work with R&D teams on improving techniques and processes
  • Work project teams to estimate and schedule required work

Requirements

  • Experience with C# or Java, SQL database programming
  • Experiences in programming (particularly Python and regular expressions).
  • NLP experience is a must.
  • Effective people manager, experience with team management
  • Experience with machine learning techniques
  • Ability to work independently, including at customer premises, but always as part of the NLU team.
  • Self-learner, with sense of initiative, and perseverance to deliver high quality work

job.title: Project Manager (ADAS)
job.description:
Mission：
Ensure Project performance objectives (Quality, Cost, Profitability, Delivery and Timing) in the management of Projects.

Ensure Project or System coordination to achieve all projects launch(es) in compliance with the company`s and Customer expectations.

ミッション：
プロジェクトの管理において、プロジェクトのパフォーマンス目標（品質、コスト、収益性、納期、タイミング）を確実に達成する。

Companyおよび顧客の期待に沿って、すべてのプロジェクトの立ち上げを達成するために、プロジェクトまたはシステムの調整を確実に行う。

Responsibilities：
Manage operationally and functionally the Projects he/she is assigned to

職務内容：
担当するプロジェクトの運営管理と機能管理

・Manage OEM/OES Projects (Component, System with known technology components, …)
OEM/OESプロジェクトの管理（コンポーネント、既知の技術部品を使用したシステム、...)
・Is responsible for the achievement of the Project KPI in terms of profitability (both product/development vs Development Activity Payback and Extended Margin), Quality and Production Preparation
プロジェクトの収益性（製品/開発対開発対開発活動のペイバック、拡張マージンの両方）、品質、生産準備などのKPI達成を担当します。
・Secure Project resources and control them
プロジェクトのリソースを確保し、管理する
・Solve all project issues requiring any type of support of all suitable functions via the Project Escalation
プロジェクトエスカレーションを通じ、あらゆる種類のサポートを必要とする全てのプロジェクト課題を、全ての適切な機能で解決する。
・Check and validate Project Team Members’ activities and proposes timing scenario to achieve milestones
プロジェクトチームメンバーの活動状況の確認と検証、マイルストーン達成のためのタイミングシナリオの提案
・Could conduct concept competitions to obtain customer orders (prefer: on case by case...)
顧客からの受注を得るためのコンセプトコンペを実施できる（できればケースバイケースで...）。
・Define and manage his/her budget including the budget of Projects part of his/her Project/System
プロジェクト・システムのプロジェクト部分の予算を含めた予算の策定・管理ができること。
・Define scope of projects
プロジェクトの範囲を明確にする
・Prepare decision making process for relevant committee and challenge his project team readiness
関連委員会の意思決定プロセスを準備し、プロジェクトチームの準備態勢を整える。
・Manage all project changes (internal and customer) and coordinates through his team
プロジェクトの変更（社内、顧客）を管理し、チームを通じた調整を行う。
・Is applying Design to Cost methodology
設計からコストまでの方法論を適用している
・Escalate at the right level and with relevant speed/anticipation the gaps versus targets
目標とのギャップを、適切なレベルで、適切なスピードで、予測しながら拡大していく。
・Lead appraisals and development of team members
チームメンバーの評価・育成をリードする。
・Is functionally responsible of all project team members, set project objectives, ensure appraisal
プロジェクトチームメンバー全員の機能的責任者として、プロジェクト目標の設定、評価の確認を行う。

Requirements

日本語：ネイティブレベル　Japanese mandatory
英語：ビジネスレベル　English mandatory

- Engineering degree
- Personal skills to manage functional organization
- Financial skills about Product cost structure, pay back, …
- エンジニアリング/修士号
- 機能的な組織を管理するための個人的なスキル
- 製品のコスト構造についての財務スキル、ペイバック、...

- Get successful development experience in Project development function (2/3 years)
- Experience in other development functions (Quality, Process, Sales, Purchasing), two at least
- Experience in automotive field is a plus
- Knowledge in embedded system and software development is a plus
- 商品開発プロセスの知識と実践（5年/7年

job.title: Technical Sales Manager
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for strategic planning of technical customer roadmap in alignment with our Product Planning strategy.
  • Understands and influences customer roadmaps and audio/active sound management product plans worldwide
  • Be the technical champion for the customer: develop compelling technical strategies that deliver market-leading customer value; create a plan for remarkable experiences with the right value proposition, that have customer and market appeal.
  • Identifies new business opportunities and recommends the right technical strategy to deliver growth
  • Establishes and builds relationships with OEM’s, partners and other key stakeholders.
  • Work with a cross-functional team to support new business pursuits and customer engagements
  • Identifies, formalizes, and communicates customer’s goals including technical specification and development timing
  • Identifies system level target pricing / costing in alignment with Business Team
  • Defines and initiates advance development studies/projects with customer in coordination and alignment with Division, customer account, and category team strategies / objectives
  • Ensures alignment with Product Line Manager (PLM), Engineering, and Customer Team organizations within Division
  • Plans and organizes project specific deliverables / technical submissions / presenting technical solutions in liaison with the customer and internal departments until system approval is achieved

Requirements

  • International Technical Sales Management and/or Commercial Account Management work experience within automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers (Infotainment / Content providers (i.e. Pandora, XM/Sirrius) is desired)
  • Strong customer orientation while having the ability to balance and execute Division strategies and objectives within the context of the Company essence and values
  • Extensive experience in automotive systems preferably electronics and / or software based

  • Has the ability to lead a team in support of the company’s initiatives, including using tools to plan, budget, and manage cross-functional Customer Team activities independent of OEM customer, product and /or geographic region (as necessary)

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a small-global Tier 1 automotive supplier with a strong commitment to JOEMs.

The function of this position is interface with the customer and interactive activities with Operation sites in foreign countries for all product quality related matters.

R&R:

・Manage quality risk in automotive systems within design and launch phase of projects.

・Communicate with internal team for quality tasks and lead to solve quality problems as necessary.

・Assist and support engineering team in tasks related to electronics.

・Monitoring of internal/external failures and respective corrective and preventive actions within multidisciplinary teams using suitable problem solving techniques.

・Responsible for process of customer complaint management and assisting customer in any quality related queries.

・Ensuring that all the relevant APQP Tasks are fully supported by the Product Quality Department

・Coach product quality personnel in responsible plants to define the necessary corrective actions as a result of testing and inspection data analysis.

・Protect customer from quality risk, lead initial flow inspection and sorting in Japan.

Requirements

・A bachelor's degree in engineering (Electronics is advantage) and 3 -7 years of automotive quality experience

・Fluency in speaking, reading and writing Japanese and English required.

・Experience to work with related technical and management functions

・Experience with APQP and PPAP

・8D problem solving, Root cause analysis, and C/A

・Milestone charts, timing charts and Gantt Charts and/or Program Gate tracking systems.

・Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with many different groups in the organization.

job.title: Supplier Quality Assurance - Interior
job.description:

From program development phase to launch he/she ensures robust application of APQP process. Criteria: High Complexity Programs (# of parts, spend, geographic scope, etc) including but not limited to global programs where he/she is the global lead ASQ.

The main missions of the role are:

o Deploys APQP related to development phase (or current production phase) of Bought out parts following Faurecia Purchasing requirements

o Trains the suppliers and makes sure that the defined standards are properly applied and on time delivered (APQP elements).

o Follows the APQP progress with the status report and make decisions in collaboration with the program team.

o Gives recommendations on technical choices to ensure the product/process robustness during program development (for both suppliers and Faurecia plant)

o Manages the process qualification at supplier (control plan and quality basics implementation, mass production trial & process Audit)

o Pronounces PPAP status and Ensures to deliver validated PPAP prior Start of Production (SOP) after SQA assembly trial & appearance approvals.

o Monitors PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) and S/R rate.
o Secures all Key characteristics (Safety and Regulations) during Program

phase.
o Manages progress/convergence plan with low performance suppliers

involved in program in collaboration with division SQD.

Requirements

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have/be:

Minimum Education Level: Bachelor Degree in Engineering or Business Administration

Experience:
o Minimum 5 years experience in an industrial environment including an

experience in a program team

Skills and competencies:
o Knowledge of Project Management methodology o APQP & PPAP validation process knowledge
o Supplier audit process knowledge.
o Fluent English
o Fluent Japanese
o Results oriented
o Ability to work in a matrix organization

Nice to have:
o Product knowledge

o Processes knowledge

job.title: Project Manager (Specialist)
job.description:
【メッセージ】
“Connectivity(接続)”ということがあらゆる分野で重要性を増しています。 自動車の分野においても、多様な機器の間を電気的に接続し、様々な情報や信号、エネルギーをやりとりすることにより、自動運転や電動化等の飛躍的な進歩が進もうとしています。 このような接続技術の中心的役割を担う電子部品として、我々の主力製品である“コネクタ”があります。 高速伝送、大電力伝送、小型高密度化など、その進化は止まりません。プロジェクトマネージャーとして、その進化を支えるコアとなり、多種多様なチャレンジを乗り越えて頂けるような、バイタリティ溢れる方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

【仕事内容】
自動車産業向け当社製品の新製品開発及び既存品の増設・リプレース・コストリダクションにおけるプロジェクトマネジメント業務全般をお任せします。
・ クロスファンクションチームを形成し、顧客要求確認から量産移行までのプロジェクト日程、タスクの管理
・ プロジェクト採算性評価と採算性改善の実施
・ 課題・問題解決に向けた関係部門及び生産工場との調整
・ マネジメントへのプロジェクト進捗報告と承認依頼、プレゼンテーションの実施

Requirements

【応募資格】
・高専・大学卒以上
・普通自動車運転免許
・語学：日本語 - 母国語レベル（ビジネス対話および資料作成が可能なレベル）
英語 - 中上級レベル以上（プロジェクトミーティングなどで、卒なくファシリテート、質疑応答の対応が可能なレベル）
※海外拠点と日常的にメールや電話による情報交換と会議の機会があるため。

【業務経験】
<必須条件>
・ 製造業（特に電子部品・自動車業界）のメーカーでのプロジェクトマネジメント系の業務経験者、または研究開発、製品開発のエンジニア（設計）としての業務経験がありプロジェクトマネジメント業務を実行できる能力のある方

・ 製造業（自動車業界、電子部品メーカー等）で設計・開発メインであるものの、プロジェクトメンバーとしてPJM業務を理解していて、PJMをやりたいと考えている方

・ 折衝/交渉やクロスコミュニケーションに自信のある方
・ 社内外関係部門と連携し積極的に業務遂行ができる方及び論理的思考能力
・ 変化を恐れずに、問題解決のための努力を惜しまない姿勢を持っている方

  • English and Japanese required

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
Join a leading industrial manufacturing with the automotive space.

The Finance Director is responsible for leading and coordinating all financial activities ensuring compliance, accuracy, and strategic alignment with Group policies. This role includes oversight of BAU, Program/R&D, and requires close collaboration with internal departments and external partners.

The main missions of the role are:
Financial Operations & Controlling
•    Coordinate budgeting and forecasting processes (SP, Budget, Forecast, MBR).
•    Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities, including accruals, reclassifications, and reconciliations.
•    Ensure accurate and timely reporting of financial results through METIS and other systems.
•    Manage inventory valuation, depreciation, and breakdown analysis.
•    Conduct margin analysis, P&L reviews, and balance sheet reviews.
•    Lead internal control activities, including score tracking and action plan updates.

Cash Flow & Treasury
•    Monitor and forecast operational cash flow, including capex and working capital.
•    Coordinate cash flow action plans across functions.
•    Consolidate and validate cash forecasts and perform direct cash analysis.
•    Support structural payment improvements for both customers and suppliers.

Program & R&D Controlling
•    Oversee program financials across multiple development programs.
•    Support BP simulations, gate reviews, and deliverable preparations.
•    Track R&D costs and compare against IBP, GR4, and budget.
•    Ensure reliability of R&D hourly rates and cost tracking.
•    Manage WBS creation, CATS analysis, and R&D cost control.

Compliance & Audit
•    Ensure compliance with Finance procedures and internal controls.
•    Provide necessary documentation and analysis for internal and external audits.

Systems & Tools
•    Participate in the definition and implementation of IT tools and ERP systems.
•    Ensure consistency and standardization of controlling processes.

Team Leadership
•    Manage and develop the controlling team.
•    Foster financial awareness across all functions; provide training and support to each function.
•    Interface with the Shared Service Center and other departments to ensure data integrity.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field.

Financial Operations & Controlling

  • Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

  • Hands-on expertise with monthly/quarterly/year-end closing.

  • Ability to perform accruals, reclassifications, reconciliations.

  • Experience with inventory valuation, depreciation, and margin/P&L analysis.

  • Strong understanding of balance sheet reviews and internal controls.

Cash Flow & Treasury Management

  • Ability to monitor, forecast, and analyze operational cash flow.

  • Experience managing capex and working capital.

  • Ability to coordinate cash flow action plans across cross-functional teams.

Program & R&D Controlling

  • Experience overseeing financials for multiple development programs.

  • Familiarity with BP simulations, gate reviews, and development deliverables.

Compliance & Audit

  • Strong knowledge of finance procedures, internal control frameworks, and audit requirements.

  • Ability to prepare documentation for internal/external audits.

Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Proven team leadership and development capabilities.

・お客様であるJ-OEM（日本の完成車メーカー）から当社は、単なる窓口ではなく、グローバルの様々なプロジェクトを設計・開発としてリードする重要な役割があり、お客様からの信頼を得ながら先進技術の提案や開発の取り纏めなどを行っております。
・入社されると、自動車の衝突安全に関する専門知識だけでなく、英語の実務能力も確実に身につけられます。「It starts with me.(まずは自分から始めましょう。）」を合言葉に主体的に行動していくことを大事にしている社風があり、キャリアの成長が図れます。

採用人数: 5

業務内容:

J-OEM(日本の完成車メーカー）向けの自動車用衝突安全製品であるエアバッグ、シートベルト、ステアリングホイールの各種プロジェクトの量産開発設計
【具体的には】
・新規製品の開発設計
・既存製品の仕様変更・改良
・各車両に合わせた設計提案
・設計プロジェクトに関する完成車メーカーとの各種説明や折衝
・仕様変更、改良、各車両に合わせた設計提案（コスト/性能の最適化）
・衝突テスト等による性能評価　など
　３DCADを使った図面作成はほんの一部で、お客様や社内部門と折衝を行いながら、量産開発プロジェクトを円滑に進めていくことが業務の中心になります。
　各車両の製品ごとのプロジェクトが立ち上がり、営業・購買・品質保証・生産管理・生産技術・工場などのメンバーがプロジェクトに加わり、プロジェクトを進めていきます。生産工場が海外拠点の場合は、海外のメンバーが参加することもあります。　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
※エアバッグ、シートベルト、ステアリングホイールの各完成車メーカーごとの製品プロジェクトチームに分かれて就業しています。

将来的なキャリアの方向性:

自動車をはじめとしたモビリティ安全エンジニアとしてスキルを高め、先行開発プロジェクトやグローバルプロジェクトリーダーなどへのステップアップが可能です。

・理系の大学、大学院、専門学校、高等専修学校を卒業されている方

・主体性を持ち自ら考え行動し、チーム志向で社内外の関係者を調整できる方【主体性、コミュニケーション能力、調整力、チーム志向】
・様々なストレス状況下でも、安定した思考と行動で対処できる方【環境適応力】
・当社のビジョン「より多くの命を守る」に共感し、新しいことに果敢に挑戦し、エンジニアとしてのプロ志向で成長できる方【チャレンジ意欲、目的意識、プロ志向】

job.title: EH&S Manager
job.description:
ミッション：
HSE分野のリスクを特定し、評価し、軽減する。また、現地の規制およびグループの指示を尊重し、労働疾病の予防、労働災害の減少、物的損害の回避、環境への影響の抑制、およびサイトのセキュリティ向上のために必要な行動計画を実行する。
Mission：
Identify hazard, evaluate, and mitigate the risks in the field of HSE, and implement required action plans to prevent occupational diseases, reduce the number of working accidents, avoid damage to property, limit environmental impacts, and improve site security, by respecting the local regulations, and Group directives
 

レスポンシビリティ：
HSEマネージャーの役割は、国の規制とグループの要求事項、および認証されたマネジメントシステムに従って、社内外のすべての資金、資材、人的資源を整理・管理し、次のことを行うことである。

Responsibilities：
In accordance with the country's regulations and company requirements, and certified Management System, his role of the HSE Manager is to organize and manage all internal and external, financial, material and human resources, in order to:

 

技術的な側面：

  • プロジェクト上流への参画、HSE仕様書の発行、受付、これらの手段の継続的な監査を通じて、サイトのすべての建物、工程、機器、機械、設備、すべての装置、材料、製品が最小限の危険性を持つことを継続的に保証すること。
  • 内部・外部監査、検査、ベストプラクティスの交換に基づき、技術分野におけるすべての是正・予防改善措置の計画、割り当て、予算化、実施状況の監視。

Technical aspects:

  • Ensure continuously that all buildings, processes, equipment, machines, installations, all devices, materials and products of the site present the minimum hazard, through his involvement upstream of the projects, the issuance of HSE specifications, reception and the audit of these means on a continuous basis.
  • Planning, assigning, budgeting and monitoring the implementation of all corrective or preventive improvement actions in the technical field following to internal/ external audits, inspections and exchange of best practices.

 

組織的な側面：

  • 組織面： ・事業所の法令順守を分析し、継続的に維持する。
  • 緊急事態、非定常／非計画作業（請負作業、非計画メンテナンス、検証済みプロセスの逸脱）を含むサイト内のすべてのHSE分野のリスク評価を実施し、各逸脱は逸脱リードタイムをカバーする最新の緩和計画とともにデータベースに取り込まれる。
  • 各エリアにおいて、マニュアル、手順書、指示書、視覚的基準、標識などを設定する。
  • 安全ツール、安全基準が適応され、周知され、理解され、適用され、管理者によって実施されていることを OJT により確認、監査する。
  • HSE 問題について社内（作業者、管理者、従業員代表）および社外（当局、検査官、近隣住民、他社など）とコミュ ニケーションをとること
  • 標準からの逸脱による安全リスクの評価と監視（逸脱データベース）。
  • QRQCとPDCA/FTAを用いた現場での事件・事故の監視。

Organizational aspects:

  • Analyze the regulatory compliance of its site and maintain it continuously.
  • Perform risk assessments for all HSE fields on the site, including emergency mode, non prescribed / unplanned work such as contractor works, unplanned maintenance, deviation to validated process, and each deviations is captured in database with an updated mitigation plan to cover deviation lead time.
  • In each area, set up manuals, procedures, instructions, visual standards, and signs
  • Ensure and audit by OJT that safety tools, safety standards are adapted, known, understood, applied, and enforced by management
  • Communicate internally (operators, managers, employee representatives) and externally (authorities, inspectors, neighbors, other companies, etc.) on HSE issues
  • Assess and monitor safety risks from deviations to standard.(Deviation Database)
  • Monitor incidents and accidents on the site using QRQC & PDCA/FTA tools


行動面：

  • 安全第一、リスクハンティング、PFMEA、セーフティトーク、セーフティブリーフィングなどのツールを用いて、管理者の安全スキルを向上させ、安全における認証と自律性を獲得する。
  • 緊急時や不測の事態に対応できる人材を育成する。
  • 人間工学に基づいたリスク回避と怪我防止のためのトレーニング
  • ワークコーディネーターの育成と認定

Behavioral aspects:

  • Develop manager Safety Skills using Safety first, Risk Hunting, PFMEA, Safety Talks and Safety Briefing tools to certified and autonomous in safety.
  • Train people to react in emergency and unexpected situation
  • Train people with Ergonomics to avoid risk and injury
  • Train people and certify for work coordinator

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree / Engineer
  • 5 years Experience in HSE scope and Industrial section
  • HSEスコープおよび産業部門における5年以上のご経験
  • 必須：日本語、および英語
    MUST: Japanese and English
  • Team Player / Result Oriented / Communication Skills / Ability to elaborate clear standard (Visual / Well described) Proactive and good accountability
    チームプレーヤー／成果主義／コミュニケーション能力／明確な基準を推敲する能力（ビジュアル／よく説明できること/積極的で責任感のある人

job.title: CES ATI
job.description:
Requirements

Position　Description- CES ATI Japan Senior Engineer:

Key Responsibilities:
 Obtains input and negotiates with stakeholders, such as team members, engineers from
other teams, technical managers, project leaders, product and manufacturing engineers,
and supplier partners and delivers information, guidance, and recommendations to
support and/or make project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis,
design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. 
 Makes decisions in the areas of short term project details, such as conducting analysis,
testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful
progression of projects at an impact level that is higher than for a senior or lead
engineer. 
 Applies and improves processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product
Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package
Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice
(FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Power, Fluent,
Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool
(CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic
Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS
ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality
decision making. 
 Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of
complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity
over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team.
Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and
systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. 
 Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a
functional discipline area within a business unit site. 
 Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees,
assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either
indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. 
 Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and
continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.
Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate
team.
*Qualifications and
Competencies

Competencies: 
 Applies Principles of Combustion and Emissions Science - Interprets and predicts the
performance of combustion systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive
comprehension of the conversion of chemical energy to heat by reacting a fuel with an
oxidizer, the formation of exhaust pollutants, modeling tools, controls, and experimental
tools to answer key questions about the system or component. 
 Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the
performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive
comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between
elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer
key questions about the system or component. 

 Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and
predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas
turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive
comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and
experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component. 
 Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by
identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors,
noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the
system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’
products. 
 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions
through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that
predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or
component level requirements. 
 Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the
customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions;
and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem
reoccurrence. 
 System Requirements Engineering  - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate
stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed;
establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and
negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses
the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and
resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts. 
 Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying
its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in
planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and
interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate
methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its
behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects. 
 Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and
outside the organization. 
 Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that
convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. 
 Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving
forward. 
 Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 
 Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes
contradictory information to effectively solve problems. 
 Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently. 
 Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring
to an organization. 
 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that
interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired
system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate
measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures
and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system
interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products. 
Education, Licenses, Certifications:
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM
field is required. 
 Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for
select roles. 
 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions
regulations. 

Experience: 
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is
required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality
decision making. 
 Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.
*Qualifications for Internal
Candidates

 Contribute to engineering activities for Cummins Emission Solutions (CES) aftertreatment
integration to engine (ATI) from Japan team. 
 Organize meeting of the area between customer and colleagues of ATI and other
engineers in other countries and find solution to meet development schedule.
 Engine control logic reading skill, Simulink experience, aftertreatment design skill are
preferred. 
 Communication with colleagues in other countries are also important for this role. 
 Being bridge between the company and customers is also important task.

The Systems Architect contributes to the definition of a Core architecture for Driver&In-Cabin Monitoring Systems and has the responsibility to develop a concept for Application projects.

This position requires interfacing with cross functional, global and regional Core development teams located in North America and Europe, as well as customers and technology partners.

Working in the Core team, the Systems Architect will be given the opportunity to make significant contributions to the creation and implementation of new active safety products.

Specific Duties

Define and design system architecture in accordance with and external standards.

Evaluate system architectures for L1-L4 systems based on market trends and input of Interior Sensing Core.

Establish and tailor architectural workflow together with other Cores (Night Vision, Radar, RCS) and external partners.

Management of architectural models and their relation to corresponding requirements using dedicated engineering tools (model-based and document-based).

Support in process definition and rollouts for ADAS systems and associated tools.

job.title: Regional Sales Manager
job.description:
Confidential – Regional Sales Manager, Japan

Global Cybersecurity Software Vendor / Tokyo

Position Overview

A fast-growing global cybersecurity company is looking for a Regional Sales Manager to support the continued expansion of its business in Japan.

This role will be responsible for developing and growing relationships with major enterprise customers in Japan, covering both new customer acquisition and expansion within existing strategic accounts.

Initially, this position will operate as an Individual Contributor, directly managing and closing large enterprise opportunities. As the Japan business continues to grow, there may be an opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibilities and potentially build and manage a sales team.

The company has already established a strong global customer base and is currently in an important growth phase in the Japanese market.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new business with large enterprise customers in Japan

  • Build and execute territory and strategic account plans

  • Engage with CIOs, CISOs, IT leaders, Security leaders, and other senior executives

  • Identify customer business and security challenges and provide consultative solutions

  • Manage complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through closing

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities

  • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Technical, Marketing, Partner, and Customer Success teams

  • Develop relationships with system integrators, distributors, and technology partners

  • Manage sales forecasting, pipeline reviews, and account planning

  • Collaborate with APAC and global teams

  • Provide market feedback and contribute to the Japan go-to-market strategy

  • Support the future expansion of the sales organization in Japan

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven enterprise sales experience within IT, Software, SaaS, or Cybersecurity

  • Experience selling directly to large enterprise accounts

  • Strong track record of developing new business and closing complex opportunities

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder enterprise sales processes

  • Ability to engage and influence C-level and senior executive stakeholders

  • Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets

  • Native-level Japanese

  • Business-level English sufficient for internal communication with regional and global teams

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be highly valued:

  • Cybersecurity

  • Cloud

  • SaaS

  • Data / Infrastructure Software

  • Network Security

  • Identity & Access Management

  • Endpoint / Cloud Security

  • Enterprise Software

Experience working for a global technology company or within a Japan market expansion / build-out environment would also be highly advantageous.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a proactive new-business hunter rather than purely an account manager

  • Can build trusted, long-term relationships with large enterprise customers

  • Can connect technology solutions to broader business and security challenges

  • Has experience strategically managing and closing large, complex enterprise deals

  • Can coordinate effectively across internal and external stakeholders

  • Is comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment

  • Can combine the agility of a growth-stage organization with disciplined enterprise sales execution

  • Has an interest in taking on broader leadership responsibilities as the Japan business expands

Why This Opportunity

1. Japan Business in Growth Mode

The company has an established global business, while Japan remains a significant growth market.

This is an opportunity to join at a stage where you can help shape the future of the Japan business rather than simply inherit an established territory and organization.

2. Strategic Enterprise Selling

The role focuses on major Japanese enterprises and involves strategic engagement with senior IT, Security, and executive stakeholders.

You will have the opportunity to work on large and complex enterprise opportunities rather than transactional sales.

3. High-Growth Cybersecurity Market

As organizations continue to adopt cloud technologies, AI, and increasingly complex digital environments, protecting critical corporate information remains a major strategic priority.

The company provides enterprise security solutions designed to address these increasingly important challenges.

4. Future Leadership Opportunity

This is not initially a traditional People Manager position.

The successful candidate will first establish themselves as a high-performing Enterprise Sales professional and contribute directly to revenue growth.

As the Japan organization expands, there may be an opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibilities and help build and lead the local sales organization.

Compensation

Highly Competitive Package

  • Base Salary + Sales Incentive

  • OTE determined based on experience and track record

  • Equity / RSU opportunities may be discussed during the interview process

  • Additional benefits provided in line with a global technology company

Location

Tokyo / Hybrid

The role will cover enterprise customers across Japan.

Domestic travel may be required depending on customer and business needs.

Hiring Background

This is a strategic hire driven by the continued expansion of the Japan business.

The company is looking for a core member who can contribute not only to immediate revenue growth, but also to the longer-term development of the business and sales organization in Japan.

job.title: Inside Sales Director
job.description:
Head of Inside Sales

Confidential – Japanese B2B SaaS Company

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing Japanese B2B SaaS company providing an integrated cloud platform that helps organizations streamline and automate workforce and back-office operations.

By consolidating business-critical information into a unified platform, the company enables customers to improve operational efficiency, strengthen data accuracy, and make better organizational decisions.

As the business enters its next stage of growth, the company is investing further in its go-to-market organization and strengthening its leadership team.

The Opportunity

The company is seeking a Head of Inside Sales to lead and further develop its large-scale Inside Sales organization.

This position goes beyond managing meeting-generation activities. The successful candidate will define how the company engages with prospective customers, translate corporate and business strategies into an effective Inside Sales model, and establish a scalable, data-driven revenue-generation organization.

The role will be responsible for strategy, organizational design, operational excellence, technology utilization, performance management, and leadership development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the mid- to long-term strategy and annual business plan for the Inside Sales organization
  • Align Inside Sales strategy with the company’s overall corporate and go-to-market strategy
  • Present strategic proposals and performance updates to the executive leadership team
  • Design and optimize customer-engagement strategies across different market segments
  • Establish scalable and repeatable processes for lead qualification and opportunity creation
  • Define KPIs and manage pipeline, forecasts, budgets, and overall business performance
  • Improve operational excellence through process standardization, automation, and continuous optimization
  • Maximize the use of CRM/SFA, marketing automation, engagement, and analytics platforms
  • Establish a data-driven decision-making culture across the organization
  • Analyze customer, market, and competitive data to identify growth opportunities
  • Design the future organizational structure and workforce plan required for continued business expansion
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and organizational development
  • Develop managers and emerging leaders within the Inside Sales organization
  • Collaborate closely with Field Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Product, and executive leadership
  • Lead organizational transformation and support the company’s next stage of growth

Requirements

Required Experience

  • At least three years of management experience within a B2B sales organization of more than 20 employees
  • Proven experience creating measurable business results through KPI design, pipeline management, forecasting, and budget management
  • Experience leading a sales organization through growth, transformation, or operational improvement
  • Strong experience using quantitative data to identify problems and develop practical solutions
  • Deep knowledge of CRM/SFA, marketing automation, and other sales technologies
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred Experience

  • At least five years of management experience within an Inside Sales organization
  • Experience developing strategies for multiple customer segments, from enterprise accounts to SMB customers
  • Experience within B2B SaaS, cloud software, HR technology, or a related industry
  • Experience managing a large and growing sales organization
  • Experience designing scalable processes in a high-growth business
  • Strong strategic thinking and the flexibility to adapt to a rapidly changing market
  • Experience developing managers and future business leaders

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • A strategic leader who can translate business objectives into executable sales plans
  • A hands-on executive who is comfortable moving between strategy and execution
  • Capable of leading an organization through the “1 to 100” growth stage
  • Able to drive transformation while maintaining strong day-to-day execution
  • Highly analytical and able to make rational, data-driven decisions
  • Comfortable working with speed in a changing business environment
  • Able to engage and influence a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  • Committed to building an organization that creates long-term value for customers
  • Passionate about coaching and developing managers and future leaders

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of a large and strategically important Inside Sales organization
  • Directly influence the company’s overall growth strategy
  • Work closely with the executive leadership team
  • Build a scalable and highly productive revenue-generation model
  • Lead the adoption of data, automation, and sales technology
  • Develop the next generation of sales leaders
  • Play a central role in the company’s next phase of expansion

Employment Details

  • Employment type: Permanent, full-time
  • Location: Central Tokyo
  • Working style: Hybrid office and remote working
  • Working hours: Flextime system
  • Probation period: Three months
  • Compensation: Negotiable OTE consisting of base salary and performance-based incentive
  • Compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, capabilities, and current package
  • Salary review: Twice annually

Benefits

  • Full social insurance coverage
  • Transportation allowance
  • Professional certification and learning support
  • Childcare and family support programs
  • Special leave for important family and school events
  • Annual paid leave
  • Summer and year-end holidays
  • Refresh leave
  • Employee discounts and benefit programs

Selection Process

  2. Two to three interviews
  3. Personality and work-style assessment
  4. Reference check
  5. Offer and offer meeting

job.description:
Confidential & Exclusive Opportunity – HEOR Specialist / Senior Specialist

Exclusive Search Managed by MLC Group

Position Summary

We are seeking a HEOR Specialist / Senior Specialist to support the design, execution, and management of research initiatives focused on Clinical Outcomes Research and Economic Outcomes Research (CORE). This position will play a key role in generating evidence from patient-related data to support healthcare decision-making, market access, and value demonstration activities.

The successful candidate will combine strong research capabilities with project management expertise, working across multiple stakeholders to deliver high-quality outcomes research projects.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical & Economic Outcomes Research (CORE)

  • Support the planning, execution, and delivery of Clinical Outcomes Research and Economic Outcomes Research projects.
  • Generate real-world evidence and patient-centered insights through structured research methodologies.
  • Analyze and interpret patient-related data to evaluate clinical, economic, and humanistic outcomes.
  • Contribute to evidence-generation strategies supporting healthcare and reimbursement decisions.

Requirements

Qualitative & Quantitative Research

  • Design and manage qualitative research activities, including interviews, focus groups, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Support quantitative research projects involving survey design, database analysis, and outcomes evaluation.
  • Synthesize research findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Develop reports, presentations, and scientific deliverables for internal and external stakeholders.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead and coordinate multiple research projects simultaneously, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are achieved.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, external research partners, academic institutions, and healthcare stakeholders.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans.
  • Support process improvements and best practices for research execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant field such as Life Sciences, Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Health Policy, Pharmacy, Statistics, Social Sciences, or related discipline.
  • Experience managing research projects involving qualitative and/or quantitative methodologies.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex research findings.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Fluent Japanese and business-level English preferred.

Preferred Experience

Candidates may come from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR)
  • Outcomes Research
  • Market Access
  • Healthcare Consulting
  • Academic Research Centers or Universities
  • Contract Research Organizations (CROs)
  • Public Health Research Institutes
  • Healthcare Data Analytics Organizations

Also Open To

Candidates from non-healthcare sectors may be considered if they possess:

  • Strong research project management experience.
  • Extensive qualitative and quantitative research expertise.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Experience delivering evidence-based insights and analytical studies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Experience across both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
  • Strong interest in patient-centered evidence generation and outcomes research.
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects in a dynamic environment.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to bridge research execution, stakeholder management, and strategic insight generation.

Seniority will be determined based on the candidate's experience and track record in research project leadership and outcomes research activities.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Join a European Tier 1, with big market share based on industry leading technology.

Product Engineer

■Job Overview

【Be Involved in Projects from Start to Finish】

The appeal of this position lies in being involved in all aspects of the work—from product planning and proposal to mass production launch—in addition to design. The broad scope of responsibilities allows you to acquire knowledge not only about specific parts but also their surrounding systems, enabling significant skill advancement.

【Work with Significant Autonomy】

Our company flexibly incorporates individual ideas, allowing you to proactively explore directions and take ownership of your work. The full-flex system makes time management easy and contributes to high productivity.

【Global Opportunities】

Daily interactions with overseas locations provide an environment for developing language skills. With English learning support available, many members have significantly improved their language abilities since joining and are now thriving.

As a global automotive parts supplier, operates 25 locations across 15 countries worldwide, including Europe. Why not advance your career to the next stage as a designer at our Japanese subsidiary?

■Job Description

You will be responsible for the design and development of automotive hinges, door checks, or power tailgates.

We take pride in our unique technologies and strengths not found in other suppliers, developing hinges, door checks, and power tailgates for various vehicle models.

With strong trust from domestic and international automakers, you will be involved consistently throughout the entire project lifecycle, from product planning and proposal to mass production launch.

【Specifically】

  • Proposals aligned with automaker requirements
  • Collaborative design with overseas locations
  • Prototyping and evaluation
  • Mass production launch

【Development Structure】
Project teams consist of approximately 5 to 6 members, including overseas personnel. We tackle challenges collaboratively as a team.

You will be involved in a wide range of responsibilities beyond design work, including cost considerations and schedule adjustments.

■ The Rewards of Manufacturing
In our door checkers, the “feel” when opening and closing doors is a crucial element. Depending on the situation, we may even prototype and test components in-house. 

In the mechatronics field, you'll work on designing cutting-edge technologies like power backdoors, which are rapidly gaining market share.


■ Languages Used
     Communication with Japanese automakers is in Japanese, while global teams use English. 

     ※You will collaborate with bases in Germany, North America, China, and other locations. This is an environment where you can utilize languages other than English, such as Chinese, German, and Spanish.


■ Training Provided
     We provide opportunities to learn our in-house design systems, technologies, and the manufacturing processes at each factory. An environment is also in place where you can attend external training if desired.

■ Team Structure Our Japan office operates with a lean team of 16 elite members! Responsibilities are divided by component focus. Communication with other teams is active, fostering a strong sense of unity and exceptional openness! Additionally, the office houses test fixtures, tools, and machine tools, enabling hands-on manufacturing within the workspace.

※Opportunities for overseas business trips available

Requirements

  • Bachelor degree: Mechanical Engineering or Electronics Engineering
  • Practical design experience using 3D CAD (CATIA/NX) 
  • Experience designing automotive parts
    • Experience in mechanical or electrical design
    • Experience designing resin or press-formed parts
    • Direct JOEM customer interface experience for design
  • Fluent Japanese speakers (Native level required)

job.title: BG Commodity Manager
job.description:
The BG Commodity Manager is responsible for Business Group commodity strategy, global supplier panel, deployment of commodity best practices and tools as well as budget achievement.  He/she defines innovation criteria to evaluate supplier innovation capabilities for the commodity, manages activities of Regional Commodity Buyers to leverage global purchasing spend, and leads negotiations with global suppliers as appropriate.

The Main Missions of the role are:

  • Carry out global scouting and supplier integration activities.
  • Define supplier convergence roadmap according to global and regional commodity strategy.
  • Accountable for management of global suppliers including risk management, propose supplier panel status accordingly.
  • Identify innovation capabilities of global suppliers and product/techno innovation.
  • Decide to launch new supplier integration activities accordingly.
  • Foster innovation by facilitating Regional Commodity Managers and Commodity Buyers efforts to identify breakthrough solutions from suppliers.
  • Define the SRM strategy and objectives (mid and long term) for the Commodity at global and regional level.
  • Manage directly strategic suppliers' relationships by negotiating and implementing frame contracts.
  • Consolidate budget and SP inputs from Regional managers and challenge them.
  • Propose commodity performance for each Division.
  • Converge with Purchasing Division Director to align commodity's performance with Division purchasing budget.
  • Analyze performance for their Commodity (global and regional scope).
  • Accountable for implementing budget, Cost savings, cash improvement, Quality and Delivery.
  • Negotiate sensitive / strategic contracts with global suppliers in coordination with commodity buyers and program team.
  • Ensure consistency between Commodity strategy and costing.
  • Challenge Commodity managers and Commodity buyers regarding their cost modelling inputs vs performance for panel competitiveness.
  • Develop more advanced cost modelling methodologies and inputs to Finance.
  • Ensure the deployment of Commodity strategy in Programs.
  • Validate Supplier Selection along with the BG Program Purchasing Director.
  • Contribute to Sourcing Nomination Committees for strategic programs.
  • Ensure the deployment of the BG or Group commodity strategy.
  • Support overall performance of purchasing productivity projects (internal and external).
  • Animate network and manage hierarchically the Commodity Managers & Buyers for their Commodity.
  • Manage the Commodity team and allocate suppliers to Commodity Managers / Buyers.
  • Provide expertise, share, and deploy best practices to commodity managers and buyers under their responsibility.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in engineering or business.
  • Nice to have: Professional Purchasing Qualification.
  • Minimum 8 years’ experience in Purchasing in an industrial environment, including a commodity buyer experience. 
  • Knowledge of Purchasing contractual and legal aspects.
  • Ability to formalize a global commodity strategy.
  • Financial Skills.
  • International minded.
  • Strong business understanding, negotiation skills and interpersonal skills.
  • Fluent in Japanese, English

job.title: Senior Sales Manager
